\[R_{\text{eq}} = \frac{R}{1 + \frac{R}{R'}} < R\]
Because \(\frac{R}{R'} \le \frac{R}{R_0} \ll 1\), \(R_{\text{eq}}\) stays very close to \(R\) for all values of \(R'\) from \(R_0\) to \(\infty\).
1. Potential drop across \(AB\): \(V_{AB} = \frac{V}{1 + \frac{r}{R_{\text{eq}}}} \approx \frac{V}{1 + \frac{r}{R}}\), which is nearly constant as \(R'\) is varied.
2. Current \(I\): Since \(R_{\text{eq}} \le R\) (approaching \(R\) as \(R' \to \infty\)), we always have \(r + R_{\text{eq}} \le r + R\), which gives:
\[I = \frac{V}{r + R_{\text{eq}}} \ge \frac{V}{r + R}\]
Also, \(I \approx \frac{V}{r + R}\) is insensitive to variations in \(R'\).
3. Current through \(R'\): \(I' = \frac{V_{AB}}{R'}\), which varies inversely with \(R'\) and drops from \(\approx \frac{V_{AB}}{R_0}\) to \(0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both statements are verified: the potential drop across \(AB\) is nearly constant as \(R'\) is varied, and \(I \ge \frac{V}{r + R}\) always.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
विद्युत वाहक बल \(V\) तथा आंतरिक प्रतिरोध \(r\) वाली एक बैटरी संधियों \(A\) तथा \(B\) के बीच समांतर क्रम में जुड़े एक नियत प्रतिरोध \(R\) तथा एक परिवर्ती प्रतिरोध \(R'\) के संयोजन को धारा \(I\) प्रदान करती है। \(R'\) का मान \(R_0 \le R' < \infty\) के बीच बदलता है, जहाँ \(r \ll R \ll R_0\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
संयोजक तार आदर्श हैं जिनका प्रतिरोध शून्य है। धारा \(I\) बैटरी के धनात्मक टर्मिनल से संधि \(A\) में प्रवाहित होकर \(R\) तथा \(R'\) में विभाजित होती है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
समांतर संयोजन \(R \parallel R'\) का तुल्य प्रतिरोध है:
\[R_{\text{eq}} = \frac{R R'}{R + R'}\]
बैटरी से प्रवाहित कुल धारा है:
\[I = \frac{V}{r + R_{\text{eq}}}\]
\(AB\) के सिरों पर विभव पतन है:
\[V_{AB} = I R_{\text{eq}} = \frac{V R_{\text{eq}}}{r + R_{\text{eq}}}\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
चूँकि \(R' \ge R_0 \gg R\), हम लिख सकते हैं:
\[R_{\text{eq}} = \frac{R}{1 + \frac{R}{R'}} < R\]
क्योंकि \(\frac{R}{R'} \le \frac{R}{R_0} \ll 1\), इसलिए \(R'\) के \(R_0\) से \(\infty\) तक के सभी मानों के लिए \(R_{\text{eq}}\) लगभग \(R\) के बराबर बना रहता है।
1. \(AB\) के सिरों पर विभव पतन: \(V_{AB} = \frac{V}{1 + \frac{r}{R_{\text{eq}}}} \approx \frac{V}{1 + \frac{r}{R}}\), जो \(R'\) बदलने पर लगभग नियत रहता है।
2. धारा \(I\): चूँकि \(R_{\text{eq}} \le R\) (\(R' \to \infty\) होने पर \(R\) की ओर अग्रसर), इसलिए सदैव \(r + R_{\text{eq}} \le r + R\) होता है, जिससे प्राप्त होता है:
\[I = \frac{V}{r + R_{\text{eq}}} \ge \frac{V}{r + R}\]
साथ ही, \(I \approx \frac{V}{r + R}\) का मान \(R'\) के परिवर्तन के प्रति असंवेदनशील रहता है।
3. \(R'\) से प्रवाहित धारा: \(I' = \frac{V_{AB}}{R'}\), जो \(R'\) के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होती है और \(\approx \frac{V_{AB}}{R_0}\) से घटकर \(0\) हो जाती है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
दोनों कथन सत्य हैं: \(R'\) के परिवर्तित होने पर \(AB\) के सिरों पर विभव पतन लगभग नियत रहता है, तथा सदैव \(I \ge \frac{V}{r + R}\) होता है।

answer.text: Potential drop across AB is nearly constant as \(R'\) is varied.
Current through \(R'\) is nearly a constant as \(R'\) is varied.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQII_CURRENTELECTRICITY_Q39 - Factors affecting temperature dependence of resistivity

questiontext.text:
Temperature dependence of resistivity \(\rho(T)\) of semiconductors, insulators and metals is significantly based on the following factors:

अर्धचालकों, विद्युतरोधियों तथा धातुओं की प्रतिरोधकता \(\rho(T)\) की ताप निर्भरता मुख्य रूप से निम्नलिखित कारकों पर आधारित होती है:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
From the Drude model of electrical conduction, the electrical resistivity \(\rho\) of a material is given by:
\[\rho = \frac{m}{n e^2 \tau}\]
where \(m\) is the mass of a charge carrier, \(e\) is its charge, \(n\) is the number density of free charge carriers, and \(\tau\) is the relaxation time (average time interval between two successive collisions).

Step 2: Evaluation
As temperature \(T\) changes, the carrier mass \(m\) and charge \(e\) remain constant. Furthermore, the resistivity \(\rho\) is an intensive material property independent of the macroscopic length of the specimen (and thermal expansion of length is negligible compared to changes in \(n\) and \(\tau\)).

Step 3: Application
- In metals, \(n\) is nearly independent of \(T\), while increased thermal agitation causes \(\tau\) to decrease significantly with increasing \(T\), so \(\rho\) increases with \(T\).
- In semiconductors and insulators, \(n\) increases exponentially with increasing \(T\), which dominates over the decrease in \(\tau\), causing \(\rho\) to decrease rapidly with \(T\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Thus, the temperature dependence of resistivity \(\rho(T)\) is significantly based on the fact that the number of charge carriers can change with temperature \(T\) and the time interval between two successive collisions can depend on \(T\).

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
विद्युत चालन के ड्रूड मॉडल के अनुसार, किसी पदार्थ की विद्युत प्रतिरोधकता \(\rho\) निम्न सूत्र से दी जाती है:
\[\rho = \frac{m}{n e^2 \tau}\]
जहाँ \(m\) आवेश वाहक का द्रव्यमान, \(e\) उसका आवेश, \(n\) मुक्त आवेश वाहकों का संख्या घनत्व, तथा \(\tau\) विश्रांति काल (दो क्रमागत टक्करों के बीच का औसत समय अंतराल) है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
ताप \(T\) में परिवर्तन होने पर आवेश वाहक का द्रव्यमान \(m\) तथा आवेश \(e\) नियत रहते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त, प्रतिरोधकता \(\rho\) पदार्थ का एक गहन (intensive) गुण है जो नमूने की स्थूल लंबाई से स्वतंत्र होता है (तथा \(n\) और \(\tau\) में परिवर्तन की तुलना में लंबाई का ऊष्मीय प्रसार नगण्य होता है)।

चरण 3: अनुप्रयोग
- धातुओं में \(n\) लगभग \(T\) से स्वतंत्र होता है, जबकि बढ़ते ऊष्मीय प्रक्षोभ के कारण \(T\) बढ़ने पर \(\tau\) में उल्लेखनीय कमी आती है, जिससे \(\rho\) बढ़ता है।
- अर्धचालकों तथा विद्युतरोधियों में \(T\) बढ़ने पर \(n\) चरघातांकी रूप से बढ़ता है, जो \(\tau\) में कमी की तुलना में अधिक प्रभावी होता है, जिससे \(\rho\) तेजी से घटता है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, प्रतिरोधकता \(\rho(T)\) की ताप निर्भरता मुख्य रूप से इस बात पर आधारित होती है कि आवेश वाहकों की संख्या ताप \(T\) के साथ बदल सकती है तथा दो क्रमागत टक्करों के बीच का समय अंतराल \(T\) पर निर्भर कर सकता है।

answer.text: number of charge carriers can change with temperature \(T\).
time interval between two successive collisions can depend on \(T\).
length of material can be a function of \(T\).
mass of carriers is a function of \(T\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQII_CURRENTELECTRICITY_Q310 - Measurement errors in Wheatstone bridge

questiontext.text:
The measurement of an unknown resistance \(R\) is to be carried out using Wheatstones bridge (see Fig. 3.25 of NCERT Book). Two students perform an experiment in two ways. The first students takes \(R_2 = 10\Omega\) and \(R_1 = 5\Omega\). The other student takes \(R_2 = 1000\Omega\) and \(R_1 = 500\Omega\). In the standard arm, both take \(R_3 = 5\Omega\).

Both find \(R = \frac{R_2}{R_1} R_3 = 10\Omega\) within errors.

व्हीटस्टोन सेतु (NCERT पुस्तक का चित्र 3.25 देखें) का उपयोग करके एक अज्ञात प्रतिरोध \(R\) का मापन किया जाना है। दो छात्र दो तरीकों से प्रयोग करते हैं। पहला छात्र \(R_2 = 10\Omega\) तथा \(R_1 = 5\Omega\) लेता है। दूसरा छात्र \(R_2 = 1000\Omega\) तथा \(R_1 = 500\Omega\) लेता है। मानक भुजा में दोनों \(R_3 = 5\Omega\) लेते हैं।

त्रुटियों की सीमा के भीतर दोनों को \(R = \frac{R_2}{R_1} R_3 = 10\Omega\) प्राप्त होता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Student 1: \(R_2 = 10\,\Omega\), \(R_1 = 5\,\Omega\), \(R_3 = 5\,\Omega\).
Student 2: \(R_2 = 1000\,\Omega\), \(R_1 = 500\,\Omega\), \(R_3 = 5\,\Omega\).
Both calculate \(R = \frac{R_2}{R_1} R_3 = 10\,\Omega\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The bridge is balanced using a galvanometer to detect the null point, and the resistors \(R_1, R_2, R_3\) have finite measurement tolerances.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
From the balanced Wheatstone bridge condition \(R = \frac{R_2}{R_1} R_3\), the fractional error in \(R\) is:
\[\frac{\Delta R}{R} = \frac{\Delta R_2}{R_2} + \frac{\Delta R_1}{R_1} + \frac{\Delta R_3}{R_3}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. The error in \(R\) directly depends on the accuracy (fractional uncertainties \(\frac{\Delta R_2}{R_2}\) and \(\frac{\Delta R_1}{R_1}\)) with which \(R_2\) and \(R_1\) can be measured. Thus, the Wheatstone bridge is not free of measurement errors, and the errors of the two students need not be the same.
2. In the second student's setup, \(R_1 = 500\,\Omega\) and \(R_2 = 1000\,\Omega\) are very large compared to \(R_3 = 5\,\Omega\) and \(R = 10\,\Omega\). Consequently, the currents through the arms (and through the galvanometer for a small imbalance) become very feeble, reducing the sensitivity of the bridge and making accurate determination of the null point more difficult.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, errors of measurement do depend on the accuracy with which \(R_2\) and \(R_1\) can be measured, and using large values of \(R_2\) and \(R_1\) makes the currents through the arms feeble, making accurate determination of the null point more difficult.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
छात्र 1: \(R_2 = 10\,\Omega\), \(R_1 = 5\,\Omega\), \(R_3 = 5\,\Omega\)।
छात्र 2: \(R_2 = 1000\,\Omega\), \(R_1 = 500\,\Omega\), \(R_3 = 5\,\Omega\)।
दोनों \(R = \frac{R_2}{R_1} R_3 = 10\,\Omega\) प्राप्त करते हैं।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
शून्य विक्षेप बिंदु ज्ञात करने के लिए धारामापी का उपयोग करके सेतु को संतुलित किया जाता है, तथा प्रतिरोधकों \(R_1, R_2, R_3\) में मापन की सीमित परिशुद्धता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
संतुलित व्हीटस्टोन सेतु की शर्त \(R = \frac{R_2}{R_1} R_3\) से, \(R\) में भिन्नात्मक त्रुटि है:
\[\frac{\Delta R}{R} = \frac{\Delta R_2}{R_2} + \frac{\Delta R_1}{R_1} + \frac{\Delta R_3}{R_3}\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
1. \(R\) में त्रुटि सीधे इस बात पर निर्भर करती है कि \(R_2\) और \(R_1\) को कितनी यथार्थता (भिन्नात्मक अनिश्चितताएँ \(\frac{\Delta R_2}{R_2}\) और \(\frac{\Delta R_1}{R_1}\)) से मापा जा सकता है। अतः व्हीटस्टोन सेतु मापन त्रुटियों से मुक्त नहीं है, और दोनों छात्रों की त्रुटियाँ समान होना आवश्यक नहीं है।
2. दूसरे छात्र की व्यवस्था में, \(R_3 = 5\,\Omega\) और \(R = 10\,\Omega\) की तुलना में \(R_1 = 500\,\Omega\) और \(R_2 = 1000\,\Omega\) बहुत बड़े हैं। परिणामस्वरूप, भुजाओं में (तथा थोड़े असंतुलन पर धारामापी में) प्रवाहित धाराएँ अत्यंत क्षीण हो जाती हैं, जिससे सेतु की सुग्राहिता घट जाती है और शून्य विक्षेप बिंदु का यथार्थ निर्धारण कठिन हो जाता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
अतः, मापन की त्रुटियाँ इस बात पर निर्भर करती हैं कि \(R_2\) और \(R_1\) को कितनी यथार्थता से मापा जा सकता है, तथा \(R_2\) और \(R_1\) के बड़े मान उपयोग करने पर भुजाओं में धाराएँ क्षीण हो जाती हैं, जिससे शून्य विक्षेप बिंदु का यथार्थ निर्धारण अधिक कठिन हो जाता है।

answer.text: The errors of measurement of the two students are the same.
Errors of measurement do depend on the accuracy with which \(R_2\) and \(R_1\) can be measured.
If the student uses large values of \(R_2\) and \(R_1\), the currents through the arms will be feeble. This will make determination of null point accurately more difficult.
Wheatstone bridge is a very accurate instrument and has no errors of measurement.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQII_CURRENTELECTRICITY_Q311 - Neutral point and current in meter bridge

questiontext.text:
In a meter bridge the point D is a neutral point (Fig 3.3).

एक मीटर सेतु में बिंदु D एक उदासीन बिंदु है (चित्र 3.3)।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
In the meter bridge circuit, resistor \(R\) is in the left gap between \(A\) and \(B\), and resistor \(S\) is in the right gap between \(B\) and \(C\). The positive terminal of the battery is connected to end \(A\) and the negative terminal to end \(C\). Point \(D\) on the \(100\text{ cm}\) uniform wire \(AC\) is the neutral (null) point at distance \(l_1\) from \(A\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The wire \(AC\) has uniform cross-section and resistivity, so electric potential decreases monotonically from \(A\) to \(C\). At the neutral point \(D\), no current flows through the galvanometer, so \(V_B = V_D\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
At balance:
\[\frac{R}{S} = \frac{l_1}{100 - l_1}\]
Conventional current through the galvanometer flows from higher potential to lower potential.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Since the potential along \(AC\) decreases strictly and monotonically from \(V_A\) to \(V_C\), there is only one point on \(AC\) whose potential equals \(V_B\). Hence, the meter bridge can have no other neutral point for this set of resistances.
2. When the jockey contacts a point \(P\) on the wire to the left of \(D\), \(P\) is closer to the positive end \(A\), so \(V_P > V_D = V_B\). Therefore, current flows from the wire to \(B\) through the galvanometer.
3. When the jockey contacts a point \(Q\) on the wire to the right of \(D\), \(Q\) is closer to the negative end \(C\), so \(V_Q < V_D = V_B\). Therefore, current flows from \(B\) to the wire through the galvanometer.
4. When \(R\) is increased, \(l_1 = \frac{100 R}{R + S}\) increases, so the neutral point shifts to the right (not to the left).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Thus, for this set of resistances there is no other neutral point; touching left of \(D\) sends current from the wire to \(B\); and touching right of \(D\) sends current from \(B\) to the wire through the galvanometer.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
मीटर सेतु परिपथ में, प्रतिरोधक \(R\) बाएँ रिक्त स्थान में \(A\) और \(B\) के बीच तथा प्रतिरोधक \(S\) दाएँ रिक्त स्थान में \(B\) और \(C\) के बीच जुड़ा है। बैटरी का धनात्मक टर्मिनल सिरे \(A\) से तथा ऋणात्मक टर्मिनल सिरे \(C\) से जुड़ा है। \(100\text{ cm}\) लंबे एकसमान तार \(AC\) पर बिंदु \(D\), सिरे \(A\) से \(l_1\) दूरी पर उदासीन (शून्य विक्षेप) बिंदु है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
तार \(AC\) की अनुप्रस्थ-काट और प्रतिरोधकता एकसमान है, इसलिए विद्युत विभव \(A\) से \(C\) की ओर एकदिष्ट रूप से घटता है। उदासीन बिंदु \(D\) पर धारामापी से कोई धारा प्रवाहित नहीं होती, अतः \(V_B = V_D\)।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
संतुलन की अवस्था में:
\[\frac{R}{S} = \frac{l_1}{100 - l_1}\]
धारामापी से होकर पारंपरिक धारा उच्च विभव से निम्न विभव की ओर प्रवाहित होती है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
1. चूँकि \(AC\) के अनुदिश विभव \(V_A\) से \(V_C\) तक एकदिष्ट रूप से घटता है, इसलिए \(AC\) पर केवल एक ही बिंदु ऐसा है जिसका विभव \(V_B\) के बराबर है। अतः प्रतिरोधों के इस समुच्चय के लिए मीटर सेतु का कोई अन्य उदासीन बिंदु नहीं हो सकता।
2. जब जॉकी तार पर \(D\) के बाईं ओर किसी बिंदु \(P\) को स्पर्श करती है, तो \(P\) धनात्मक सिरे \(A\) के अधिक निकट होता है, अतः \(V_P > V_D = V_B\)। इसलिए, धारामापी से होकर धारा तार से \(B\) की ओर प्रवाहित होती है।
3. जब जॉकी तार पर \(D\) के दाईं ओर किसी बिंदु \(Q\) को स्पर्श करती है, तो \(Q\) ऋणात्मक सिरे \(C\) के अधिक निकट होता है, अतः \(V_Q < V_D = V_B\)। इसलिए, धारामापी से होकर धारा \(B\) से तार की ओर प्रवाहित होती है।
4. जब \(R\) को बढ़ाया जाता है, तो \(l_1 = \frac{100 R}{R + S}\) बढ़ता है, इसलिए उदासीन बिंदु दाईं ओर खिसकता है (बाईं ओर नहीं)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
अतः, प्रतिरोधों के इस समुच्चय के लिए कोई अन्य उदासीन बिंदु नहीं हो सकता; \(D\) के बाईं ओर स्पर्श करने पर धारा तार से \(B\) की ओर प्रवाहित होती है; तथा \(D\) के दाईं ओर स्पर्श करने पर धारामापी से होकर धारा \(B\) से तार की ओर प्रवाहित होती है।

answer.text: The meter bridge can have no other neutral point for this set of resistances.
When the jockey contacts a point on meter wire left of D, current flows to B from the wire.
When the jockey contacts a point on the meter wire to the right of D, current flows from B to the wire through galvanometer.
When \(R\) is increased, the neutral point shifts to left.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q4_1 - Two charged particles traverse identical helical paths

questiontext.text: Two charged particles traverse identical helical paths in a completely opposite sense in a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\).

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When a charged particle of charge \(q\) and mass \(m\) enters a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\) with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\), the component of velocity parallel to the magnetic field (\(v_z\)) remains constant, while the perpendicular component (\(v_\perp\)) causes uniform circular motion due to the magnetic Lorentz force \(\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\). The resulting path is a helix.

Step 2: Evaluation of Helical Parameters
The radius of the helix is given by \(r = \frac{m v_\perp}{|q| B_0}\), the angular frequency is \(\omega = \frac{|q| B_0}{m}\), and the pitch is \(p = v_z T = \frac{2\pi m v_z}{|q| B_0}\). For two particles to traverse identical helical paths in a completely opposite sense, their radii, pitches, and angular speeds must have the same magnitudes, while their directions of rotation (senses) around the magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\) must be opposite.

Step 3: Application to Charge-to-Mass Ratio
The sense of rotation in a given magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is determined by the sign of the charge \(q\). Opposite senses of rotation imply that the two particles carry charges of opposite signs. Since the magnitudes of the radii and pitches are identical for the same field \(B_0\) and same \(v_\perp\) and \(v_z\), the magnitudes of their charge-to-mass ratios must be equal: \(\left|\frac{e}{m}\right|_1 = \left|\frac{e}{m}\right|_2\). Because their charges have opposite signs, their signed charge-to-mass ratios are equal in magnitude and opposite in sign, which gives \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\). Note that they do not necessarily have equal masses or equal charges individually, so they need not be a particle-antiparticle pair or have equal \(z\)-components of momenta.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The charge-to-mass ratios of the two particles satisfy \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q4_2 - Biot-Savart law for moving electrons

questiontext.text: Biot-Savart law indicates that the moving electrons (velocity \(\mathbf{v}\)) produce a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) such that

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to the Biot-Savart law, the magnetic field \(d\mathbf{B}\) produced by a current element \(I\,d\mathbf{l}\) at a position vector \(\mathbf{r}\) from the element is given by \(d\mathbf{B} = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} \frac{I\,(d\mathbf{l} \times \mathbf{r})}{r^3}\).

Step 2: Application to a Moving Charge
For a moving charge \(q\) with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\), the current element \(I\,d\mathbf{l}\) is equivalent to \(q\mathbf{v}\). Thus, the magnetic field produced by a moving electron (with \(q = -e\)) at a position \(\mathbf{r}\) is \(\mathbf{B} = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} \frac{q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r})}{r^3}\).

Step 3: Evaluation
By the properties of the vector cross product, \(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r}\) is perpendicular to both \(\mathbf{v}\) and \(\mathbf{r}\). Therefore, the magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is perpendicular to the velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) (and also perpendicular to \(\mathbf{r}\), obeying an inverse square law \(\frac{1}{r^2}\) rather than an inverse cube law).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) produced by moving electrons satisfies \(\mathbf{B} \perp \mathbf{v}\).

answer.text: it is along the line joining the electron and point of observation.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q4_3 - Magnetic moment of bent circular loop

questiontext.text: A current carrying circular loop of radius \(R\) is placed in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane with centre at the origin. Half of the loop with \(x > 0\) is now bent so that it now lies in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A circular loop of radius \(R\) carrying current \(I\) initially lies completely in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane, centred at the origin. Then the half of the loop with \(x > 0\) is bent by \(90^\circ\) so that it lies in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Treat the bent loop as the vector sum of two semicircular loops: one in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane and one in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane, both carrying the same current \(I\) (with the straight diameter along the \(y\)-axis cancelling out).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnetic dipole moment of a planar current loop is \(\mathbf{M} = I\mathbf{A}\), where \(\mathbf{A}\) is the area vector. For two non-coplanar loops, the net magnetic moment is \(\mathbf{M}_{\text{net}} = \mathbf{M}_1 + \mathbf{M}_2\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Initially, the full circular loop has area \(\pi R^2\), so its magnetic moment has magnitude \(M_0 = I\pi R^2\) directed along the \(z\)-axis. After bending, each semicircular half has area \(\frac{\pi R^2}{2}\). The half in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane has magnetic moment \(M_1 = \frac{I\pi R^2}{2}\) along the \(z\)-axis, and the half in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane has magnetic moment \(M_2 = \frac{I\pi R^2}{2}\) along the \(x\)-axis. Since these two vectors are perpendicular, the magnitude of the net magnetic moment is:
\[M_{\text{net}} = \sqrt{M_1^2 + M_2^2} = \sqrt{\left(\frac{M_0}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{M_0}{2}\right)^2} = \frac{M_0}{\sqrt{2}} \approx 0.707 M_0\]
Thus, \(M_{\text{net}} < M_0\). Also, at a distant point \((0, 0, z)\) with \(z \gg R\), the field is determined by the dipole components; since the \(z\)-component of the magnetic moment halves to \(\frac{M_0}{2}\) and the \(x\)-component contributes \(\frac{\mu_0}{4\pi}\frac{M_2}{z^3}\) (half the axial strength), the magnitude of \(\mathbf{B}\) at \((0,0,z)\) decreases: \(B_{\text{new}} = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi z^3}\sqrt{(2M_1)^2 + M_2^2} = \frac{\mu_0 M_0}{4\pi z^3}\sqrt{1 + \frac{1}{4}} = \frac{\sqrt{5}}{4}\frac{\mu_0 M_0}{\pi z^3} < \frac{2\mu_0 M_0}{4\pi z^3}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both the magnitude of the magnetic moment and the magnetic field at \((0, 0, z)\) for \(z \gg R\) decrease. Therefore, the magnitude of magnetic moment diminishes.

answer.text: The magnitude of magnetic moment now diminishes.
The magnitude of \(\mathbf{B}\) at \((0, 0, z)\), \(z \gg R\) increases.
The magnitude of \(\mathbf{B}\) at \((0, 0, z)\), \(z \gg R\) is unchanged.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q4_4 - Electron projected along axis of solenoid

questiontext.text: An electron is projected with uniform velocity along the axis of a current carrying long solenoid. Which of the following is true?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Inside a long current-carrying solenoid, the magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is uniform and directed along the axis of the solenoid.

Step 2: Evaluation
The magnetic Lorentz force on a charge \(q\) moving with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) in a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is given by \(\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\), whose magnitude is \(F = |q| v B \sin\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\mathbf{v}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\).

Step 3: Application
Since the electron is projected along the axis of the solenoid, its velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) is either parallel (\(\theta = 0^\circ\)) or antiparallel (\(\theta = 180^\circ\)) to the magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\). In either case, \(\sin\theta = 0\), so the magnetic force acting on the electron is zero (\(\mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}\)).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
With no net force acting on it, the electron will continue to move with uniform velocity along the axis of the solenoid.

answer.text: The electron will be accelerated along the axis.
The electron path will be circular about the axis.
The electron will experience a force at \(45^{\circ}\) to the axis and hence execute a helical path.
The electron will continue to move with uniform velocity along the axis of the solenoid.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q4_5 - Motion of charged particle in cyclotron

questiontext.text: In a cyclotron, a charged particle

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A cyclotron consists of two hollow D-shaped metallic chambers (dees) separated by a small gap, placed in a uniform perpendicular magnetic field, with an alternating electric field applied across the gap.

Step 2: Evaluation of Motion Inside the Dees
Inside the metallic dees, the electric field is shielded (zero), and only the perpendicular magnetic field acts on the charged particle. The magnetic force acts perpendicular to the velocity, providing centripetal force and causing the particle to move in a circular path at constant speed. Because the direction of velocity continuously changes, the particle has non-zero centripetal acceleration inside the dees.

Step 3: Evaluation of Motion Between the Dees
In the gap between the dees, the alternating electric field accelerates the charged particle tangentially, increasing its speed and kinetic energy.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Since the charged particle experiences tangential acceleration in the gap between the dees and centripetal acceleration inside the dees, it undergoes acceleration all the time.

answer.text: speeds up between the dees because of the magnetic field.
slows down within a dee and speeds up between dees.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q4_6 - Work done rotating circular current loop

questiontext.text: A circular current loop of magnetic moment \(M\) is in an arbitrary orientation in an external magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\). The work done to rotate the loop by \(30^{\circ}\) about an axis perpendicular to its plane is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A circular current loop has magnetic moment \(M\) in an external magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\). It is rotated by \(30^{\circ}\) about an axis perpendicular to the plane of the loop.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The magnetic dipole moment vector \(\mathbf{M}\) of a planar loop is directed perpendicular to the plane of the loop.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The potential energy of a magnetic dipole in an external magnetic field is \(U = -\mathbf{M} \cdot \mathbf{B} = -MB\cos\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\mathbf{M}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\). The work done in rotating the loop quasi-statically is \(W = \Delta U = U_f - U_i\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since the axis of rotation is perpendicular to the plane of the loop, the axis of rotation is parallel to the magnetic moment vector \(\mathbf{M}\). Rotating the loop by \(30^{\circ}\) about this axis does not change the orientation of \(\mathbf{M}\) in space. Therefore, the angle \(\theta\) between \(\mathbf{M}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) remains unchanged (\(\theta_f = \theta_i\)).
\[W = -MB\cos\theta_f - (-MB\cos\theta_i) = 0\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since the potential energy does not change, the work done to rotate the loop about an axis perpendicular to its plane is zero.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q4_7 - Gyromagnetic ratio of electron in H-atom

questiontext.text: The gyro-magnetic ratio of an electron in an H-atom, according to Bohr model, is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An electron of charge \(q = -e\) and mass \(m\) revolves in a circular Bohr orbit of radius \(r\) with speed \(v\) in a hydrogen atom.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The gyromagnetic ratio \(\gamma\) is defined as the ratio of the orbital magnetic dipole moment \(\boldsymbol{\mu}_l\) to the orbital angular momentum \(\mathbf{L}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For a revolving charge \(q\) in a circle of radius \(r\) with time period \(T = \frac{2\pi r}{v}\), the equivalent current is \(I = \frac{q}{T} = \frac{qv}{2\pi r}\), and the magnetic dipole moment is \(\boldsymbol{\mu}_l = I\mathbf{A} = \frac{q}{2m}\mathbf{L}\), where \(\mathbf{L} = m(\mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{v})\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting \(q = -e\) for the electron:
\[\boldsymbol{\mu}_l = -\frac{e}{2m}\mathbf{L}\]
Thus, the gyromagnetic ratio is:
\gamma = -\frac{e}{2m}\
This expression depends only on the charge \(-e\) and mass \(m\) of the electron. It does not contain the orbital radius \(r\), speed \(v\), or principal quantum number \(n\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Because \(e > 0\) and \(m > 0\), the gyromagnetic ratio of the electron is negative and independent of which orbit it is in.

answer.text: independent of which orbit it is in.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q4_8 - Work done by magnetic force on wire

questiontext.text: Consider a wire carrying a steady current, \(I\) placed in a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) perpendicular to its length. Consider the charges inside the wire. It is known that magnetic forces do no work. This implies that,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The magnetic Lorentz force on a moving charge \(q\) is \(\mathbf{F}_m = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\). Because \(\mathbf{F}_m\) is always perpendicular to the instantaneous velocity \(\mathbf{v}\), the rate of work done by the magnetic force on a free charge is \(\mathbf{F}_m \cdot \mathbf{v} = 0\).

Step 2: Evaluation of Charges Inside the Wire
Even though the magnetic force does no work on the mobile charge carriers, it still deflects them perpendicular to both their drift velocity and \(\mathbf{B}\) (Hall effect). As a result, some charges inside the wire move to the surface of the wire, creating a transverse Hall electric field until equilibrium is reached. Thus, the motion of charges is affected by \(\mathbf{B}\).

Step 3: Evaluation of Wire Motion
If the wire as a whole moves under the influence of the magnetic field, the macroscopic force \(\mathbf{F} = I(\mathbf{l} \times \mathbf{B})\) does positive work on the wire. However, the magnetic force on the stationary positive ions (assumed fixed within the wire lattice) does zero work directly, because the magnetic force on the electrons is transferred to the lattice via the Hall electric field and collisions, while the net magnetic force on any charge does zero work in total.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, some charges inside the wire move to the surface as a result of \(\mathbf{B}\), and if the wire moves under the influence of \(\mathbf{B}\), no work is done by the magnetic force on the ions assumed fixed within the wire.

answer.text: motion of charges inside the conductor is unaffected by \(\mathbf{B}\) since they do not absorb energy.
some charges inside the wire move to the surface as a result of \(\mathbf{B}\).
if the wire moves under the influence of \(\mathbf{B}\), no work is done by the force.
if the wire moves under the influence of \(\mathbf{B}\), no work is done by the magnetic force on the ions, assumed fixed within the wire.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q4_9 - Ampere circuital law for coaxial loops

questiontext.text: Two identical current carrying coaxial loops, carry current \(I\) in an opposite sense. A simple amperian loop passes through both of them once. Calling the loop as \(C\),

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to Ampere's circuital law, the line integral of the magnetic field around a closed Amperian loop \(C\) is \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 I_{\text{enc}}\), where \(I_{\text{enc}}\) is the net algebraic current enclosed by the surface bounded by \(C\).

Step 2: Evaluation of Enclosed Current
Since the Amperian loop \(C\) passes through both identical coaxial loops once, and the two loops carry equal currents \(I\) in opposite senses, one current enters the surface bounded by \(C\) while the other exits it. Hence, the net enclosed current is:
\[I_{\text{enc}} = I + (-I) = 0\]
Therefore, \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = 0\). Because the value is zero, it is independent of the sense of traversal of \(C\) (reversing the sense changes \(+0\) to \(-0\), which is still \(0\)).

Step 3: Evaluation of the Magnetic Field on \(C\)
Although the closed line integral \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l}\) is zero, the magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) does not vanish everywhere on \(C\). Furthermore, if the plane of the Amperian loop is oriented perpendicular to the planes of the coaxial coils, at points where \(C\) crosses the common axis of the coils, \(\mathbf{B}\) is directed along the axis while \(d\mathbf{l}\) can be perpendicular to the axis, so there may be a point on \(C\) where \(\mathbf{B}\) and \(d\mathbf{l}\) are perpendicular.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The value of \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l}\) is independent of the sense of \(C\), and there may be a point on \(C\) where \(\mathbf{B}\) and \(d\mathbf{l}\) are perpendicular.

answer.text: the value of \(\oint_c \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l}\) is independent of sense of \(C\).
there may be a point on \(C\) where \(\mathbf{B}\) and \(d\mathbf{l}\) are perpendicular.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q4_10 - Electron and positron in electric and magnetic fields

questiontext.text: A cubical region of space is filled with some uniform electric and magnetic fields. An electron enters the cube across one of its faces with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) and a positron enters via opposite face with velocity \(-\mathbf{v}\). At this instant,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An electron (charge \(-e\), mass \(m\)) has velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) and a positron (charge \(+e\), mass \(m\)) has velocity \(-\mathbf{v}\) in a region with uniform electric field \(\mathbf{E}\) and uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\).

Step 2: Evaluation of Electric Forces and Accelerations
The electric force on the electron is \(\mathbf{F}_{e1} = -e\mathbf{E}\), giving acceleration \(\mathbf{a}_{e1} = -\frac{e\mathbf{E}}{m}\). The electric force on the positron is \(\mathbf{F}_{e2} = +e\mathbf{E}\), giving acceleration \(\mathbf{a}_{e2} = +\frac{e\mathbf{E}}{m}\). Since these accelerations are in opposite directions, they are not identical.

Step 3: Evaluation of Magnetic Forces and Accelerations
The magnetic force on the electron is \(\mathbf{F}_{m1} = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\), and on the positron is \(\mathbf{F}_{m2} = +e(-\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B}) = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\). Since both particles have the same mass \(m\), the magnetic forces on both particles cause equal accelerations: \(\mathbf{a}_{m1} = \mathbf{a}_{m2} = -\frac{e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})}{m}\).

Step 4: Evaluation of Energy Gain/Loss and Centre of Mass Motion
Magnetic forces do no work. The rate of change of kinetic energy (power) due to the electric field is \(P = \mathbf{F}_e \cdot \mathbf{v}\). For the electron, \(P_1 = (-e\mathbf{E}) \cdot \mathbf{v} = -e(\mathbf{E} \cdot \mathbf{v})\). For the positron, \(P_2 = (+e\mathbf{E}) \cdot (-\mathbf{v}) = -e(\mathbf{E} \cdot \mathbf{v})\). Thus, both particles gain or lose energy at the same rate.
For the two-particle system, the net external electric force is \(\mathbf{F}_{e1} + \mathbf{F}_{e2} = -e\mathbf{E} + e\mathbf{E} = \mathbf{0}\), whereas the net magnetic force is \(\mathbf{F}_{m1} + \mathbf{F}_{m2} = -2e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\). Therefore, the motion of the centre of mass (CM) is determined by \(\mathbf{B}\) alone.

Step 5: Final Conclusion
The magnetic forces on both particles cause equal accelerations, both particles gain or lose energy at the same rate, and the motion of the centre of mass is determined by \(\mathbf{B}\) alone.

answer.text: the electric forces on both the particles cause identical accelerations.
the magnetic forces on both the particles cause equal accelerations.
both particles gain or loose energy at the same rate.
the motion of the centre of mass (CM) is determined by \(\mathbf{B}\) alone.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q4_11 - Constant velocity of charged particle in fields

questiontext.text: A charged particle would continue to move with a constant velocity in a region wherein,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
By Newton's first law of motion, a charged particle of charge \(q\) moving with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) continues to move with a constant velocity if and only if the net Lorentz force acting on it is zero:
\[\mathbf{F} = q\mathbf{E} + q(\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B}) = \mathbf{0}\]

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Field Configuration
1. When \(\mathbf{E} = \mathbf{0}\) and \(\mathbf{B} eq \mathbf{0}\): The net force is \(\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B})\). If the particle moves parallel or antiparallel to \(\mathbf{B}\), then \(\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B} = \mathbf{0}\), so \(\mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}\) and the particle continues with constant velocity.
2. When \(\mathbf{E} eq \mathbf{0}\) and \(\mathbf{B} eq \mathbf{0}\): The net force \(\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{E} + \mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B})\) can be zero if the electric force and magnetic force are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction (for example, in a velocity selector where \(\mathbf{E} = -\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B}\)).
3. When \(\mathbf{E} eq \mathbf{0}\) and \(\mathbf{B} = \mathbf{0}\): The net force is \(\mathbf{F} = q\mathbf{E} eq \mathbf{0}\), so the particle must accelerate and cannot move with constant velocity.
4. When \(\mathbf{E} = \mathbf{0}\) and \(\mathbf{B} = \mathbf{0}\): There are no electric or magnetic forces, so \(\mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}\) and the particle continues with constant velocity.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
A charged particle can continue to move with constant velocity when \(\mathbf{E} = \mathbf{0}, \mathbf{B} eq \mathbf{0}\); when \(\mathbf{E} eq \mathbf{0}, \mathbf{B} eq \mathbf{0}\); and when \(\mathbf{E} = \mathbf{0}, \mathbf{B} = \mathbf{0}\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q01 - Helical paths of two charged particles

questiontext.text:
4.1 Two charged particles traverse identical helical paths in a completely opposite sense in a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\).

৪.১ দুটি আহিত কণা একটি সুষম চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\)-এ সম্পূর্ণ বিপরীত দিকে অভিন্ন হেলিক্যাল (কুণ্ডলীকৃত) পথে পরিভ্রমণ করে।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When a charged particle of charge \(q\) and mass \(m\) enters a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\) with velocity components \(v_{\parallel}\) (parallel to \(\mathbf{B}\)) and \(v_{\perp}\) (perpendicular to \(\mathbf{B}\)), it follows a helical path.

Step 2: Formulae and Analysis
The radius of the circular projection is \(r = \frac{m v_{\perp}}{|q| B_0}\), the angular frequency is \(\omega = \frac{|q| B_0}{m}\), and the pitch is \(p = \frac{2\pi m v_{\parallel}}{|q| B_0}\). The sense of rotation (clockwise or anticlockwise) around the magnetic field axis is determined by the sign of the charge-to-mass ratio \(\frac{q}{m}\) (represented here with symbol \(e/m\)).

Step 3: Application to Identical Opposite Helices
For the two particles to traverse identical helical paths in completely opposite senses, the magnitudes of their charge-to-mass ratios must be equal so that the radius and pitch match for the same velocity components, while their signs must be opposite so that the Lorentz forces deflect them in opposite rotational senses. Thus, \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 = -\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2\), which gives \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The two particles do not need to have equal \(z\)-components of momenta, equal charges, or be a particle-antiparticle pair; it is sufficient and necessary that their charge-to-mass ratios satisfy \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\).

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
যখন \(q\) আধান ও \(m\) ভরবিশিষ্ট একটি আহিত কণা \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\) সুষম চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে ক্ষেত্রের সমান্তরাল বেগ উপাংশ \(v_{\parallel}\) এবং লম্ব বেগ উপাংশ \(v_{\perp}\) নিয়ে প্রবেশ করে, তখন কণাটি একটি হেলিক্যাল (কুণ্ডলীকৃত) পথে চলে।

ধাপ ২: সূত্র ও বিশ্লেষণ
বৃত্তাকার প্রক্ষেপের ব্যাসার্ধ \(r = \frac{m v_{\perp}}{|q| B_0}\), কৌণিক কম্পাঙ্ক \(\omega = \frac{|q| B_0}{m}\), এবং পিচ \(p = \frac{2\pi m v_{\parallel}}{|q| B_0}\)। চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রের অক্ষের চারপাশে ঘূর্ণনের দিক (দক্ষিণাবর্তী বা বামাবর্তী) আধান ও ভরের অনুপাত \(\frac{q}{m}\) (এখানে \(e/m\) প্রতীকে প্রকাশিত)-এর চিহ্নের ওপর নির্ভর করে।

ধাপ ৩: অভিন্ন কিন্তু বিপরীত হেলিক্সের ক্ষেত্রে প্রয়োগ
দুটি কণা সম্পূর্ণ বিপরীত দিকে অভিন্ন হেলিক্যাল পথে চলার জন্য, একই বেগ উপাংশের ক্ষেত্রে ব্যাসার্ধ ও পিচ সমান হতে তাদের আধান-ভর অনুপাতের মান সমান হতে হবে এবং বিপরীত দিকে ঘূর্ণনের জন্য চিহ্ন বিপরীত হতে হবে। সুতরাং, \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 = -\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2\), অর্থাৎ \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\)।

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
কণা দুটির ভরবেগের \(z\)-উপাংশ সমান হওয়া, আধান সমান হওয়া বা কণা-প্রতিকণা জোড় হওয়া আবশ্যক নয়; কেবল তাদের আধান ও ভরের অনুপাত \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\) শর্তটি মেনে চলা প্রয়োজন।

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q02 - Magnetic field direction by Biot-Savart law

questiontext.text:
4.2 Biot-Savart law indicates that the moving electrons (velocity \(\mathbf{v}\)) produce a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) such that

৪.২ বায়ো-সাভার্ট সূত্র নির্দেশ করে যে গতিশীল ইলেকট্রন (বেগ \(\mathbf{v}\)) এমন একটি চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B}\) উৎপন্ন করে যাতে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to the Biot-Savart law, a moving point charge \(q\) with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) produces a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) at a position vector \(\mathbf{r}\) relative to the charge.

Step 2: Formula and Direction Analysis
The magnetic field vector is given by \(\mathbf{B} = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} \frac{q (\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r})}{r^3}\). From the properties of the vector cross product, the vector \(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r}\) is perpendicular to the plane containing both \(\mathbf{v}\) and \(\mathbf{r}\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) produced by the moving electrons is always perpendicular to the velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) (that is, \(\mathbf{B} \perp \mathbf{v}\)), and its magnitude obeys an inverse square law (\(\propto 1/r^2\)), not an inverse cube law.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
বায়ো-সাভার্ট সূত্র অনুযায়ী, \(\mathbf{v}\) বেগে গতিশীল কোনো বিন্দু আধান \(q\) তার সাপেক্ষে \(\mathbf{r}\) অবস্থান ভেক্টরে একটি চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B}\) উৎপন্ন করে।

ধাপ ২: সূত্র ও দিক বিশ্লেষণ
চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র ভেক্টরটি হলো \(\mathbf{B} = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} \frac{q (\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r})}{r^3}\)। ভেক্টরের ক্রস গুণফলের ধর্ম অনুযায়ী, \(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r}\) ভেক্টরটি \(\mathbf{v}\) এবং \(\mathbf{r}\) উভয়ের সমতলের ওপর লম্ব হয়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, গতিশীল ইলেকট্রনের দ্বারা উৎপন্ন চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B}\) সর্বদা বেগ \(\mathbf{v}\)-এর সাথে লম্ব থাকে (অর্থাৎ \(\mathbf{B} \perp \mathbf{v}\)), এবং এর মান দূরত্বের ব্যস্তানুপাতিক বর্গ সূত্র (\(\propto 1/r^2\)) মেনে চলে, ব্যস্তানুপাতিক ঘন সূত্র নয়।

answer.text: it is along the line joining the electron and point of observation.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q03 - Magnetic moment of a bent circular loop

questiontext.text:
4.3 A current carrying circular loop of radius \(R\) is placed in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane with centre at the origin. Half of the loop with \(x > 0\) is now bent so that it now lies in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane.

৪.৩ \(R\) ব্যাসার্ধের একটি তড়িৎবাহী বৃত্তাকার লুপকে মূলবিন্দুতে কেন্দ্র রেখে \(x\)-\(y\) সমতলে স্থাপন করা হয়েছে। এখন \(x > 0\) অংশের অর্ধেক লুপকে বাঁকিয়ে \(y\)-\(z\) সমতলে আনা হলো।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A circular loop of radius \(R\) carrying current \(I\) initially lies entirely in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane. The half with \(x > 0\) is bent by \(90^{\circ}\) to lie in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane, while the other half (\(x < 0\)) remains in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane.

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnetic dipole moment of a planar loop is \(\mathbf{M} = I \mathbf{A}\). A bent loop can be treated as two semicircular loops sharing the diameter along the \(y\)-axis with equal and opposite currents along the imaginary shared diameter.

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Initially, the magnitude of the magnetic moment is \(M_0 = I \pi R^2\) directed along the \(z\)-axis. After bending, the two semicircular halves each have area \(A_1 = A_2 = \frac{\pi R^2}{2}\), so their magnetic moments are \(M_1 = \frac{1}{2} I \pi R^2\) (along the \(z\)-axis) and \(M_2 = \frac{1}{2} I \pi R^2\) (along the \(x\)-axis). Since these two vectors are perpendicular, the net magnetic moment magnitude is: \[M = \sqrt{M_1^2 + M_2^2} = \sqrt{\left(\frac{I\pi R^2}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{I\pi R^2}{2}\right)^2} = \frac{I\pi R^2}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{M_0}{\sqrt{2}}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Since \(\frac{M_0}{\sqrt{2}} < M_0\), the magnitude of the magnetic moment diminishes after bending. Moreover, at \((0, 0, z)\) for \(z \gg R\), the magnetic field behaves as that of a dipole and decreases rather than increasing or remaining unchanged. Thus, the magnitude of magnetic moment diminishes.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্ত
\(I\) তড়িৎপ্রবাহবাহী \(R\) ব্যাসার্ধের একটি বৃত্তাকার লুপ শুরুতে সম্পূর্ণরূপে \(x\)-\(y\) সমতলে ছিল। এর \(x > 0\) অর্ধাংশকে \(90^{\circ}\) বাঁকিয়ে \(y\)-\(z\) সমতলে আনা হয়েছে, যেখানে অপর অর্ধাংশ (\(x < 0\)) \(x\)-\(y\) সমতলেই রয়েছে।

ধাপ ২: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
একটি সমতলীয় লুপের চৌম্বক দ্বিমেরু ভ্রামক হলো \(\mathbf{M} = I \mathbf{A}\)। বাঁকানো লুপটিকে \(y\)-অক্ষ বরাবর সাধারণ ব্যাসযুক্ত দুটি অর্ধবৃত্তাকার লুপের সমষ্টি হিসেবে বিবেচনা করা যায়, যেখানে কাল্পনিক সাধারণ ব্যাস বরাবর সমান ও বিপরীত প্রবাহ রয়েছে।

ধাপ ৩: ধাপে ধাপে গণনা
শুরুতে চৌম্বক ভ্রামকের মান ছিল \(M_0 = I \pi R^2\) যা \(z\)-অক্ষ বরাবর ক্রিয়াশীল। বাঁকানোর পর দুটি অর্ধবৃত্তাকার অংশের প্রতিটির ক্ষেত্রফল \(A_1 = A_2 = \frac{\pi R^2}{2}\), তাই তাদের চৌম্বক ভ্রামক হলো \(M_1 = \frac{1}{2} I \pi R^2\) (\(z\)-অক্ষ বরাবর) এবং \(M_2 = \frac{1}{2} I \pi R^2\) (\(x\)-অক্ষ বরাবর)। যেহেতু এই দুটি ভেক্টর পরস্পর লম্ব, লব্ধি চৌম্বক ভ্রামকের মান: \[M = \sqrt{M_1^2 + M_2^2} = \sqrt{\left(\frac{I\pi R^2}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{I\pi R^2}{2}\right)^2} = \frac{I\pi R^2}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{M_0}{\sqrt{2}}\]

ধাপ ৪: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
যেহেতু \(\frac{M_0}{\sqrt{2}} < M_0\), তাই বাঁকানোর পর চৌম্বক ভ্রামকের মান হ্রাস পায়। তাছাড়া \((0, 0, z)\) বিন্দুতে (\(z \gg R\)) চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রের মান দ্বিমেরুর মতো আচরণ করে এবং বৃদ্ধি বা অপরিবর্তিত না থেকে হ্রাস পায়। সুতরাং, চৌম্বক ভ্রামকের মান হ্রাস পায়।

answer.text: The magnitude of magnetic moment now diminishes.
The magnitude of \(\mathbf{B}\) at \((0, 0, z)\), \(z \gg R\) increases.
The magnitude of \(\mathbf{B}\) at \((0, 0, z)\), \(z \gg R\) is unchanged.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q04 - Electron projected along axis of solenoid

questiontext.text:
4.4 An electron is projected with uniform velocity along the axis of a current carrying long solenoid. Which of the following is true?

৪.৪ একটি তড়িৎবাহী দীর্ঘ সলিনয়েডের অক্ষ বরাবর একটি ইলেকট্রনকে সুষম বেগে নিক্ষেপ করা হলো। নিচের কোনটি সত্য?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Inside a long current-carrying solenoid, the magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is uniform and directed along the axis of the solenoid.

Step 2: Force Calculation
The magnetic Lorentz force on an electron of charge \(-e\) moving with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) in a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is \(\mathbf{F} = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\). Its magnitude is \(F = e v B \sin\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\mathbf{v}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Since the electron is projected along the axis of the solenoid, \(\mathbf{v}\) is parallel or antiparallel to \(\mathbf{B}\) (\(\theta = 0^{\circ}\) or \(180^{\circ}\)), so \(\sin\theta = 0\) and \(\mathbf{F} = 0\). With zero net force acting on it, the electron will continue to move with uniform velocity along the axis of the solenoid.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
একটি দীর্ঘ তড়িৎবাহী সলিনয়েডের অভ্যন্তরে চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B}\) সুষম হয় এবং সলিনয়েডের অক্ষ বরাবর ক্রিয়া করে।

ধাপ ২: বলের গণনা
\(\mathbf{B}\) চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে \(\mathbf{v}\) বেগে গতিশীল \(-e\) আধানযুক্ত ইলেকট্রনের ওপর ক্রিয়াশীল চৌম্বক লরেঞ্জ বল হলো \(\mathbf{F} = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\)। এর মান \(F = e v B \sin\theta\), যেখানে \(\theta\) হলো \(\mathbf{v}\) এবং \(\mathbf{B}\)-এর মধ্যবর্তী কোণ।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
যেহেতু ইলেকট্রনটিকে সলিনয়েডের অক্ষ বরাবর নিক্ষেপ করা হয়েছে, তাই \(\mathbf{v}\) ও \(\mathbf{B}\) পরস্পর সমান্তরাল বা বিপরীত সমান্তরাল (\(\theta = 0^{\circ}\) বা \(180^{\circ}\)), ফলে \(\sin\theta = 0\) এবং \(\mathbf{F} = 0\) হয়। কোনো নিট বল ক্রিয়া না করায় ইলেকট্রনটি সলিনয়েডের অক্ষ বরাবর সুষম বেগে চলতে থাকবে।

answer.text: The electron will be accelerated along the axis.
The electron path will be circular about the axis.
The electron will experience a force at \(45^{\circ}\) to the axis and hence execute a helical path.
The electron will continue to move with uniform velocity along the axis of the solenoid.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q05 - Acceleration of charged particle in a cyclotron

questiontext.text:
4.5 In a cyclotron, a charged particle

৪.৫ একটি সাইক্লোট্রনে, একটি আহিত কণা

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A cyclotron consists of two hollow semicircular metal containers called dees placed in a perpendicular uniform magnetic field, with an alternating electric field applied across the gap between the dees.

Step 2: Motion Inside the Dees and Between the Dees
Inside each dee, the electric field is shielded (zero), and the perpendicular magnetic field bends the particle into a circular path at constant speed. Because the direction of velocity continuously changes, the particle experiences a non-zero centripetal acceleration \(a_c = \frac{v^2}{r}\) throughout its motion inside the dees. In the gap between the dees, the electric field accelerates the particle tangentially, increasing its speed.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Because the particle has centripetal acceleration inside the dees and tangential acceleration in the gap between the dees, it undergoes acceleration all the time.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
একটি সাইক্লোট্রনে দুটি ফাঁপা অর্ধবৃত্তাকার ধাতব পাত্র (যাদের ডি বলা হয়) একটি লম্ব সুষম চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে স্থাপিত থাকে এবং ডি-দুটির মধ্যবর্তী ফাঁকে একটি পরিবর্তী তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্র প্রয়োগ করা হয়।

ধাপ ২: ডি-এর ভেতরে এবং মধ্যবর্তী ফাঁকে গতি
প্রতিটি ডি-এর ভেতরে তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্র শূন্য থাকে এবং লম্ব চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র কণাটিকে সমদ্রুতিতে বৃত্তাকার পথে ঘোরায়। যেহেতু বেগের দিক ক্রমাগত পরিবর্তিত হয়, তাই ডি-এর ভেতরে চলার সময় কণাটি সর্বদা একটি অশূন্য অভিকেন্দ্র ত্বরণ \(a_c = \frac{v^2}{r}\) অনুভব করে। ডি-দুটির মধ্যবর্তী ফাঁকে তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্র কণাটিকে স্পর্শকীয়ভাবে ত্বরান্বিত করে, ফলে এর দ্রুতি বৃদ্ধি পায়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
যেহেতু ডি-এর ভেতরে অভিকেন্দ্র ত্বরণ এবং ডি-দুটির মধ্যবর্তী ফাঁকে স্পর্শকীয় ত্বরণ ক্রিয়া করে, তাই কণাটি সর্বদাই ত্বরণের অধীনে থাকে।

answer.text: speeds up between the dees because of the magnetic field.
slows down within a dee and speeds up between dees.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQI_Q06 - Work done rotating circular loop about normal axis

questiontext.text:
4.6 A circular current loop of magnetic moment \(M\) is in an arbitrary orientation in an external magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\). The work done to rotate the loop by \(30^{\circ}\) about an axis perpendicular to its plane is

৪.৬ \(M\) চৌম্বক ভ্রামকবিশিষ্ট একটি বৃত্তাকার তড়িৎ লুপ একটি বাহ্যিক চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B}\)-তে যেকোনো বিন্যাসে অবস্থিত। লুপটির তলের ওপর লম্ব একটি অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে একে \(30^{\circ}\) কোণে ঘোরাতে কৃতকার্য হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The magnetic potential energy of a magnetic dipole of moment \(\mathbf{M}\) in an external uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is \(U = -\mathbf{M} \cdot \mathbf{B} = -MB \cos\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\mathbf{M}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\).

Step 2: Orientation Analysis
The magnetic moment vector \(\mathbf{M}\) is perpendicular to the plane of the circular loop. When the loop is rotated by \(30^{\circ}\) about an axis perpendicular to its plane, the axis of rotation is parallel to \(\mathbf{M}\). Consequently, the direction of \(\mathbf{M}\) does not change, and the angle \(\theta\) between \(\mathbf{M}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) remains unchanged.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Since the initial and final potential energies are equal (\(W = \Delta U = MB(\cos\theta_1 - \cos\theta_2) = 0\)), the work done to rotate the loop is zero.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
বাহ্যিক সুষম চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B}\)-তে অবস্থিত \(\mathbf{M}\) চৌম্বক ভ্রামকবিশিষ্ট কোনো চৌম্বক দ্বিমেরুর স্থিতিশক্তি হলো \(U = -\mathbf{M} \cdot \mathbf{B} = -MB \cos\theta\), যেখানে \(\theta\) হলো \(\mathbf{M}\) এবং \(\mathbf{B}\)-এর মধ্যবর্তী কোণ।

ধাপ ২: বিন্যাস বিশ্লেষণ
চৌম্বক ভ্রামক ভেক্টর \(\mathbf{M}\) বৃত্তাকার লুপের তলের ওপর লম্বভাবে থাকে। যখন লুপটিকে তার তলের ওপর লম্ব একটি অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে \(30^{\circ}\) কোণে ঘোরানো হয়, তখন ঘূর্ণন অক্ষটি \(\mathbf{M}\)-এর সমান্তরাল হয়। এর ফলে \(\mathbf{M}\)-এর দিক পরিবর্তিত হয় না এবং \(\mathbf{M}\) ও \(\mathbf{B}\)-এর মধ্যবর্তী কোণ \(\theta\) অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
যেহেতু প্রাথমিক ও চূড়ান্ত স্থিতিশক্তি সমান (\(W = \Delta U = MB(\cos\theta_1 - \cos\theta_2) = 0\)), তাই লুপটিকে ঘোরাতে কৃতকার্য শূন্য।

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q07 - Gyromagnetic ratio of electron in Bohr atom

questiontext.text:
4.7 The gyro-magnetic ratio of an electron in an H-atom, according to Bohr model, is

৪.৭ বোর মডেল অনুযায়ী, একটি হাইড্রোজেন (H) পরমাণুতে ইলেকট্রনের জাইরোম্যাগনেটিক অনুপাত হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An electron of charge \(q = -e\) and mass \(m_e\) revolves in the \(n\)-th Bohr orbit of radius \(r\) with speed \(v\) in a hydrogen atom.

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The gyro-magnetic ratio \(\gamma\) is defined as the ratio of the orbital magnetic dipole moment \(\mathbf{M}\) to the orbital angular momentum \(\mathbf{L}\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
The equivalent current of the revolving electron is \(I = \frac{q}{T} = \frac{-ev}{2\pi r}\). The magnetic moment is: \[M = I A = \left(\frac{-ev}{2\pi r}\right)(\pi r^2) = -\frac{evr}{2}\] The magnitude of orbital angular momentum is \(L = m_e v r\). Taking the ratio gives: \[\gamma = \frac{M}{L} = \frac{-evr/2}{m_e v r} = -\frac{e}{2m_e}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
Since \(e\) and \(m_e\) are fundamental constants, the gyro-magnetic ratio is negative (because the electron has a negative charge, so \(\mathbf{M}\) and \(\mathbf{L}\) are oppositely directed) and is completely independent of the orbit quantum number \(n\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্ত
একটি হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণুতে \(-e\) আধান ও \(m_e\) ভরবিশিষ্ট একটি ইলেকট্রন \(r\) ব্যাসার্ধের \(n\)-তম বোর কক্ষপথে \(v\) দ্রুতিতে আবর্তন করছে।

ধাপ ২: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
জাইরোম্যাগনেটিক অনুপাত \(\gamma\) হলো কক্ষীয় চৌম্বক দ্বিমেরু ভ্রামক \(\mathbf{M}\) এবং কক্ষীয় কৌণিক ভরবেগ \(\mathbf{L}\)-এর অনুপাত।

ধাপ ৩: ধাপে ধাপে গণনা
আবর্তনশীল ইলেকট্রনের সমতুল্য তড়িৎপ্রবাহ \(I = \frac{q}{T} = \frac{-ev}{2\pi r}\)। চৌম্বক ভ্রামক হলো: \[M = I A = \left(\frac{-ev}{2\pi r}\right)(\pi r^2) = -\frac{evr}{2}\] কক্ষীয় কৌণিক ভরবেগের মান \(L = m_e v r\)। অনুপাত নিলে পাওয়া যায়: \[\gamma = \frac{M}{L} = \frac{-evr/2}{m_e v r} = -\frac{e}{2m_e}\]

ধাপ ৪: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
যেহেতু \(e\) এবং \(m_e\) মৌলিক ধ্রুবক, তাই জাইরোম্যাগনেটিক অনুপাত ঋণাত্মক (কারণ ইলেকট্রনের আধান ঋণাত্মক, ফলে \(\mathbf{M}\) ও \(\mathbf{L}\) বিপরীতমুখী) এবং এটি কোন কক্ষপথে আছে তার কোয়ান্টাম সংখ্যা \(n\)-এর ওপর নির্ভরশীল নয়।

answer.text: independent of which orbit it is in.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q08 - Magnetic force and work on current carrying wire

questiontext.text:
4.8 Consider a wire carrying a steady current, \(I\) placed in a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) perpendicular to its length. Consider the charges inside the wire. It is known that magnetic forces do no work. This implies that,

৪.৮ দৈর্ঘ্যের সাথে লম্বভাবে অবস্থিত একটি সুষম চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B}\)-তে স্থাপিত \(I\) স্থির তড়িৎপ্রবাহবাহী একটি তার বিবেচনা করো। তারের অভ্যন্তরের আধানগুলো বিবেচনা করো। জানা আছে যে চৌম্বক বল কোনো কার্য করে না। এটি নির্দেশ করে যে,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The magnetic Lorentz force on a moving charge \(q\) is \(\mathbf{F}_m = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\), which is always perpendicular to the instantaneous velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) of the charge and thus does zero work on the charge.

Step 2: Evaluation of Charge Motion Inside the Wire
Although the magnetic force does no work, it deflects the moving free electrons perpendicular to both their drift velocity and \(\mathbf{B}\), causing some charges inside the wire to move toward the surface of the conductor until a transverse Hall electric field balances the magnetic deflection.

Step 3: Evaluation of Work When the Wire Moves
If the wire moves sideways under the influence of the macroscopic magnetic force \(\mathbf{F} = I(\mathbf{l} \times \mathbf{B})\), the total work done by the magnetic force on the current-carrying wire is non-zero in the lab frame, or rather, the positive work done on the wire/ions is compensated by the negative work done by the induced EMF on the moving electrons; specifically, for the ions assumed fixed within the wire, the magnetic force on the ions is perpendicular to their velocity if we consider the net Lorentz force, Wait: more precisely, if the wire moves perpendicular to \(\mathbf{B}\) and its length, the ions move with velocity \(\mathbf{v}_{\text{wire}}\), so the magnetic force \(q_{\text{ion}}(\mathbf{v}_{\text{wire}} \times \mathbf{B})\) on the ions is perpendicular to \(\mathbf{v}_{\text{wire}}\) and therefore does no work on the ions assumed fixed within the wire!

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Thus, some charges inside the wire move to the surface as a result of \(\mathbf{B}\), and if the wire moves under the influence of \(\mathbf{B}\), no work is done by the magnetic force on the ions, assumed fixed within the wire.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
একটি গতিশীল আধান \(q\)-এর ওপর ক্রিয়াশীল চৌম্বক লরেঞ্জ বল হলো \(\mathbf{F}_m = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\), যা সর্বদা আধানটির তাৎক্ষণিক বেগ \(\mathbf{v}\)-এর সাথে লম্ব হয় এবং তাই আধানের ওপর কোনো কার্য করে না।

ধাপ ২: তারের অভ্যন্তরে আধানের গতির বিশ্লেষণ
যদিও চৌম্বক বল কোনো কার্য করে না, তবুও এটি গতিশীল মুক্ত ইলেকট্রনগুলোকে তাদের বিচলন বেগ ও \(\mathbf{B}\) উভয়ের সাথে লম্ব দিকে বিক্ষিপ্ত করে। এর ফলে তারের অভ্যন্তরের কিছু আধান পরিবাহীর পৃষ্ঠে সরে আসে যতক্ষণ না একটি অনুপ্রস্থ হল (Hall) তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্র চৌম্বকীয় বিক্ষেপণকে প্রতিহত করে।

ধাপ ৩: তার গতিশীল হলে কার্যের বিশ্লেষণ
যদি তারটি স্থূল চৌম্বক বল \(\mathbf{F} = I(\mathbf{l} \times \mathbf{B})\)-এর প্রভাবে সরে যায়, তবে তারের মধ্যে স্থির থাকা আয়নগুলোর বেগ \(\mathbf{v}_{\text{wire}}\) হয় এবং তাদের ওপর ক্রিয়াশীল চৌম্বক বল \(q_{\text{ion}}(\mathbf{v}_{\text{wire}} \times \mathbf{B})\) সর্বদা তাদের গতির দিকের সাথে লম্ব থাকে। ফলে তারের মধ্যে স্থির ধরে নেওয়া আয়নগুলোর ওপর চৌম্বক বল দ্বারা কোনো কার্য হয় না।

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, \(\mathbf{B}\)-এর প্রভাবে তারের ভেতরের কিছু আধান পৃষ্ঠে চলে আসে এবং \(\mathbf{B}\)-এর প্রভাবে তারটি সরে গেলে, তারের মধ্যে স্থির ধরে নেওয়া আয়নগুলোর ওপর চৌম্বক বল দ্বারা কোনো কার্য হয় না।

answer.text: motion of charges inside the conductor is unaffected by \(\mathbf{B}\) since they do not absorb energy.
some charges inside the wire move to the surface as a result of \(\mathbf{B}\).
if the wire moves under the influence of \(\mathbf{B}\), no work is done by the force.
if the wire moves under the influence of \(\mathbf{B}\), no work is done by the magnetic force on the ions, assumed fixed within the wire.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q09 - Ampere circuital law for opposite coaxial loops

questiontext.text:
4.9 Two identical current carrying coaxial loops, carry current \(I\) in an opposite sense. A simple amperian loop passes through both of them once. Calling the loop as \(C\),

৪.৯ দুটি অভিন্ন সমাক্ষীয় তড়িৎবাহী লুপ বিপরীত দিকে \(I\) তড়িৎপ্রবাহ বহন করছে। একটি সরল অ্যাম্পিয়ারীয় লুপ উভয় লুপের মধ্য দিয়ে একবার অতিক্রম করে। লুপটিকে \(C\) হিসেবে অভিহিত করলে,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to Ampere's circuital law, the line integral of the magnetic field around a closed Amperian loop \(C\) is \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 I_{\text{enc}}\), where \(I_{\text{enc}}\) is the net current threading the surface bounded by \(C\).

Step 2: Application to Opposite Currents
Since the Amperian loop \(C\) passes through both identical coaxial loops once and they carry equal currents \(I\) in opposite senses, one current enters the surface bounded by \(C\) while the other leaves it. Therefore, the net enclosed current is \(I_{\text{enc}} = I - I = 0\), which gives: \[\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = 0\] Reversing the sense of traversal of \(C\) simply changes the sign of \(0\), which remains \(0\). Hence, the value of \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l}\) is independent of the sense of \(C\).

Step 3: Magnetic Field Along the Loop
Although the line integral is zero, \(\mathbf{B}\) does not vanish everywhere on \(C\). Furthermore, if the Amperian loop \(C\) is chosen to lie in a plane perpendicular to the planes of the coils (for instance, passing along the axis), the magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) (directed along the axis) can be perpendicular to \(d\mathbf{l}\) at points where \(C\) crosses the coils or runs perpendicular to the axis.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Thus, the value of \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l}\) is independent of the sense of \(C\), and there may be a point on \(C\) where \(\mathbf{B}\) and \(d\mathbf{l}\) are perpendicular.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
অ্যাম্পিয়ারের বদ্ধপথ সূত্র অনুযায়ী, কোনো বদ্ধ অ্যাম্পিয়ারীয় লুপ \(C\) বরাবর চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রের রৈখিক সমাকলন হলো \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 I_{\text{enc}}\), যেখানে \(I_{\text{enc}}\) হলো \(C\) দ্বারা আবদ্ধ তলের মধ্য দিয়ে অতিক্রান্ত নিট তড়িৎপ্রবাহ।

ধাপ ২: বিপরীত প্রবাহের ক্ষেত্রে প্রয়োগ
যেহেতু অ্যাম্পিয়ারীয় লুপ \(C\) উভয় অভিন্ন সমাক্ষীয় লুপের মধ্য দিয়ে একবার করে অতিক্রম করে এবং তারা বিপরীত দিকে সমান প্রবাহ \(I\) বহন করে, তাই একটি প্রবাহ \(C\) দ্বারা আবদ্ধ তলে প্রবেশ করে এবং অন্যটি বেরিয়ে যায়। অতএব, নিট আবদ্ধ প্রবাহ \(I_{\text{enc}} = I - I = 0\), যার ফলে: \[\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = 0\] \(C\)-এর পরিভ্রমণের দিক উল্টে দিলেও শূন্যের মানের কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না। তাই \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l}\)-এর মান \(C\)-এর দিকের ওপর নির্ভরশীল নয়।

ধাপ ৩: লুপ বরাবর চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র
যদিও রৈখিক সমাকলন শূন্য, তবুও \(C\)-এর সর্বত্র \(\mathbf{B}\) শূন্য নয়। তদুপরি, অ্যাম্পিয়ারীয় লুপ \(C\)-কে কয়েলগুলোর তলের সাথে লম্বভাবে রাখলে, অক্ষ বরাবর বা বিশেষ কিছু বিন্দুতে \(\mathbf{B}\) এবং \(d\mathbf{l}\) পরস্পর লম্ব হতে পারে।

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, \(\oint_C \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l}\)-এর মান \(C\)-এর দিকের ওপর নির্ভরশীল নয় এবং \(C\)-এর ওপর এমন একটি বিন্দু থাকতে পারে যেখানে \(\mathbf{B}\) এবং \(d\mathbf{l}\) পরস্পর লম্ব।

answer.text: the value of \(\oint_c \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{l}\) is independent of sense of \(C\).
there may be a point on \(C\) where \(\mathbf{B}\) and \(d\mathbf{l}\) are perpendicular.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q10 - Electron and positron in uniform E and B fields

questiontext.text:
4.10 A cubical region of space is filled with some uniform electric and magnetic fields. An electron enters the cube across one of its faces with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) and a positron enters via opposite face with velocity \(-\mathbf{v}\). At this instant,

৪.১০ স্থানের একটি ঘনকাকার অঞ্চল সুষম তড়িৎ ও চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র দ্বারা পূর্ণ। একটি ইলেকট্রন \(\mathbf{v}\) বেগে ঘনকটির একটি তল দিয়ে প্রবেশ করে এবং একটি পজিট্রন \(-\mathbf{v}\) বেগে বিপরীত তল দিয়ে প্রবেশ করে। এই মুহূর্তে,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An electron has mass \(m\), charge \(-e\), and velocity \(\mathbf{v}\). A positron has the same mass \(m\), charge \(+e\), and velocity \(-\mathbf{v}\). Both are in the same uniform electric field \(\mathbf{E}\) and uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\).

Step 2: Electric and Magnetic Forces
The electric force on the electron is \(\mathbf{F}_{e1} = -e\mathbf{E}\), and on the positron is \(\mathbf{F}_{e2} = +e\mathbf{E}\). These are equal in magnitude but opposite in direction, so they do not cause identical accelerations. The magnetic force on the electron is \(\mathbf{F}_{m1} = (-e)(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B}) = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\), and on the positron is \(\mathbf{F}_{m2} = (+e)(-\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B}) = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\). Since both have the same mass \(m\), their magnetic accelerations are identical: \(\mathbf{a}_{m1} = \mathbf{a}_{m2} = -\frac{e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})}{m}\).

Step 3: Rate of Energy Change and Centre of Mass Motion
Magnetic forces do zero work. The rate of gain or loss of energy (power) is due to the electric force: \[P_{\text{electron}} = \mathbf{F}_{e1} \cdot \mathbf{v} = (-e\mathbf{E}) \cdot \mathbf{v} = -e(\mathbf{E} \cdot \mathbf{v})\] \[P_{\text{positron}} = \mathbf{F}_{e2} \cdot (-\mathbf{v}) = (+e\mathbf{E}) \cdot (-\mathbf{v}) = -e(\mathbf{E} \cdot \mathbf{v})\] Hence, both particles gain or lose energy at the same rate. For the two-particle system, the net external electric force is \(\mathbf{F}_{e1} + \mathbf{F}_{e2} = -e\mathbf{E} + e\mathbf{E} = 0\), while the net external magnetic force is \(\mathbf{F}_{m1} + \mathbf{F}_{m2} = -2e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\). Therefore, the motion of the centre of mass is determined by \(\mathbf{B}\) alone.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The magnetic forces on both particles cause equal accelerations, both particles gain or lose energy at the same rate, and the motion of the centre of mass is determined by \(\mathbf{B}\) alone.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্ত
একটি ইলেকট্রনের ভর \(m\), আধান \(-e\) এবং বেগ \(\mathbf{v}\)। একটি পজিট্রনের ভরও \(m\), আধান \(+e\) এবং বেগ \(-\mathbf{v}\)। উভয়ই একই সুষম তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{E}\) এবং সুষম চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B}\)-তে অবস্থিত।

ধাপ ২: তড়িৎ ও চৌম্বক বল
ইলেকট্রনের ওপর তড়িৎ বল \(\mathbf{F}_{e1} = -e\mathbf{E}\) এবং পজিট্রনের ওপর \(\mathbf{F}_{e2} = +e\mathbf{E}\)। এরা মানে সমান কিন্তু বিপরীতমুখী হওয়ায় অভিন্ন ত্বরণ সৃষ্টি করে না। ইলেকট্রনের ওপর চৌম্বক বল \(\mathbf{F}_{m1} = (-e)(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B}) = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\) এবং পজিট্রনের ওপর \(\mathbf{F}_{m2} = (+e)(-\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B}) = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\)। যেহেতু উভয়ের ভর \(m\) সমান, তাই তাদের চৌম্বকীয় ত্বরণ সমান: \(\mathbf{a}_{m1} = \mathbf{a}_{m2} = -\frac{e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})}{m}\)।

ধাপ ৩: শক্তি পরিবর্তনের হার ও ভরকেন্দ্রের গতি
চৌম্বক বল কোনো কার্য করে না। শক্তি অর্জন বা হারানোর হার (ক্ষমতা) কেবল তড়িৎ বলের কারণে ঘটে: \[P_{\text{electron}} = \mathbf{F}_{e1} \cdot \mathbf{v} = (-e\mathbf{E}) \cdot \mathbf{v} = -e(\mathbf{E} \cdot \mathbf{v})\] \[P_{\text{positron}} = \mathbf{F}_{e2} \cdot (-\mathbf{v}) = (+e\mathbf{E}) \cdot (-\mathbf{v}) = -e(\mathbf{E} \cdot \mathbf{v})\] সুতরাং, উভয় কণা একই হারে শক্তি অর্জন বা হারায়। দুই কণার সংস্থার ওপর নিট বাহ্যিক তড়িৎ বল \(\mathbf{F}_{e1} + \mathbf{F}_{e2} = -e\mathbf{E} + e\mathbf{E} = 0\), যেখানে নিট বাহ্যিক চৌম্বক বল \(\mathbf{F}_{m1} + \mathbf{F}_{m2} = -2e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\)। অতএব, ভরকেন্দ্রের (CM) গতি কেবল \(\mathbf{B}\) দ্বারাই নির্ধারিত হয়।

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
উভয় কণার ওপর চৌম্বক বল সমান ত্বরণ সৃষ্টি করে, উভয় কণা একই হারে শক্তি অর্জন বা হারায়, এবং ভরকেন্দ্রের গতি কেবল \(\mathbf{B}\) দ্বারা নির্ধারিত হয়।

answer.text: the electric forces on both the particles cause identical accelerations.
the magnetic forces on both the particles cause equal accelerations.
both particles gain or loose energy at the same rate.
the motion of the centre of mass (CM) is determined by \(\mathbf{B}\) alone.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQII_Q11 - Constant velocity of charged particle in E and B

questiontext.text:
4.11 A charged particle would continue to move with a constant velocity in a region wherein,

৪.১১ একটি আহিত কণা এমন একটি অঞ্চলে সমবেগে চলতে থাকবে যেখানে,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
For a charged particle of charge \(q\) moving with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) to continue moving with constant velocity, the net Lorentz force acting on it must be zero: \[\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{E} + \mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B}) = 0\]

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Field Configuration
1. When \(\mathbf{E} = 0\) and \(\mathbf{B} eq 0\): If the particle moves parallel or antiparallel to \(\mathbf{B}\), then \(\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B} = 0\), so \(\mathbf{F} = 0\) and velocity remains constant.
2. When \(\mathbf{E} eq 0\) and \(\mathbf{B} eq 0\): If \(\mathbf{E}\) and \(\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B}\) are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction (\(\mathbf{E} = -(\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B})\), as in a velocity selector), the net force \(\mathbf{F} = 0\) and velocity remains constant.
3. When \(\mathbf{E} eq 0\) and \(\mathbf{B} = 0\): The net force is \(\mathbf{F} = q\mathbf{E} eq 0\), so the particle must accelerate and cannot move with constant velocity.
4. When \(\mathbf{E} = 0\) and \(\mathbf{B} = 0\): The net force is automatically zero, so the particle continues with constant velocity.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
A charged particle can continue to move with a constant velocity in regions where \(\mathbf{E} = 0, \mathbf{B} eq 0\); \(\mathbf{E} eq 0, \mathbf{B} eq 0\); or \(\mathbf{E} = 0, \mathbf{B} = 0\).

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
\(\mathbf{v}\) বেগে গতিশীল \(q\) আধানযুক্ত কোনো কণা সমবেগে চলতে থাকার জন্য তার ওপর ক্রিয়াশীল নিট লরেঞ্জ বল শূন্য হতে হবে: \[\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{E} + \mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B}) = 0\]

ধাপ ২: প্রতিটি ক্ষেত্র-বিন্যাসের বিশ্লেষণ
১. যখন \(\mathbf{E} = 0\) এবং \(\mathbf{B} eq 0\): যদি কণাটি \(\mathbf{B}\)-এর সমান্তরাল বা বিপরীত সমান্তরাল দিকে চলে, তবে \(\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B} = 0\), ফলে \(\mathbf{F} = 0\) হয় এবং বেগ ধ্রুবক থাকে।
২. যখন \(\mathbf{E} eq 0\) এবং \(\mathbf{B} eq 0\): যদি \(\mathbf{E}\) এবং \(\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B}\) মানে সমান ও বিপরীতমুখী হয় (\(\mathbf{E} = -(\mathbf{v} imes \mathbf{B})\), যেমন বেগ নির্বাচকে ঘটে), তবে নিট বল \(\mathbf{F} = 0\) হয় এবং বেগ ধ্রুবক থাকে।
৩. যখন \(\mathbf{E} eq 0\) এবং \(\mathbf{B} = 0\): নিট বল \(\mathbf{F} = q\mathbf{E} eq 0\), তাই কণাটি অবশ্যই ত্বরান্বিত হবে এবং সমবেগে চলতে পারবে না।
৪. যখন \(\mathbf{E} = 0\) এবং \(\mathbf{B} = 0\): নিট বল স্বাভাবিকভাবেই শূন্য, তাই কণাটি সমবেগে চলতে থাকবে।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
একটি আহিত কণা সেই অঞ্চলে সমবেগে চলতে পারে যেখানে \(\mathbf{E} = 0, \mathbf{B} eq 0\); \(\mathbf{E} eq 0, \mathbf{B} eq 0\); অথবা \(\mathbf{E} = 0, \mathbf{B} = 0\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQ_Q01 - Helical paths of two charged particles

questiontext.text:
Two charged particles traverse identical helical paths in a completely opposite sense in a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\).

दो आवेशित कण एकसमान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\) में पूर्णतः विपरीत दिशाओं (सेंस) में समान कुंडलिनी (हेलिकल) पथों पर गति करते हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When a charged particle of charge \(q\) and mass \(m\) enters a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\) with velocity components \(v_\perp\) (perpendicular to \(\mathbf{B}\)) and \(v_\parallel\) (parallel to \(\mathbf{B}\)), it executes a helical path.

Step 2: Formulae for Helix Parameters
The radius of the circular projection is \(r = \frac{mv_\perp}{|q|B_0}\), the time period is \(T = \frac{2\pi m}{|q|B_0}\), and the pitch is \(p = v_\parallel T = \frac{2\pi m v_\parallel}{|q|B_0}\). The sense of rotation (clockwise or anticlockwise) is governed by the sign of \(q\mathbf{B}\), which depends on the sign of the charge-to-mass ratio \(\frac{q}{m}\).

Step 3: Evaluation
For both particles to traverse identical helical paths (same radius \(r\) and same pitch \(p\)) in completely opposite senses in the same magnetic field \(B_0\), they must have the same magnitude of charge-to-mass ratio \(\left|\frac{e}{m}\right|\) (along with equal \(v_\perp\) and \(v_\parallel\)), but opposite signs of \(\frac{e}{m}\). Therefore, \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\). Their masses need not be equal, so their \(z\)-components of momenta \(mv_\parallel\) need not be equal, nor must they have equal charges or form a particle-antiparticle pair.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The charge-to-mass ratios satisfy \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\).

चरण 1: सैद्धांतिक सिद्धांत
जब आवेश \(q\) और द्रव्यमान \(m\) का कोई आवेशित कण एकसमान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{B} = B_0 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\) में वेग के घटकों \(v_\perp\) (\(\mathbf{B}\) के लंबवत) और \(v_\parallel\) (\(\mathbf{B}\) के समांतर) के साथ प्रवेश करता है, तो वह कुंडलिनी (हेलिकल) पथ पर गति करता है।

चरण 2: कुंडलिनी के प्राचलों के सूत्र
वृत्ताकार प्रक्षेप की त्रिज्या \(r = \frac{mv_\perp}{|q|B_0}\), आवर्तकाल \(T = \frac{2\pi m}{|q|B_0}\), तथा पिच \(p = v_\parallel T = \frac{2\pi m v_\parallel}{|q|B_0}\) होती है। घूर्णन की दिशा (दक्षिणावर्त या वामावर्त) \(q\mathbf{B}\) के चिह्न द्वारा निर्धारित होती है, जो आवेश-द्रव्यमान अनुपात \(\frac{q}{m}\) के चिह्न पर निर्भर करती है।

चरण 3: मूल्यांकन
दोनों कणों द्वारा समान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(B_0\) में पूर्णतः विपरीत दिशाओं में समान कुंडलिनी पथ (समान त्रिज्या \(r\) और समान पिच \(p\)) तय करने के लिए, उनके आवेश-द्रव्यमान अनुपात का परिमाण \(\left|\frac{e}{m}\right|\) समान (तथा \(v_\perp\) और \(v_\parallel\) समान) होना चाहिए, किंतु \(\frac{e}{m}\) के चिह्न विपरीत होने चाहिए। अतः \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\) होगा। उनके द्रव्यमान समान होना आवश्यक नहीं है, इसलिए संवेग के \(z\)-घटक \(mv_\parallel\) समान होना आवश्यक नहीं है, और न ही उनके आवेश समान होना या उनका कण-प्रतिकण युग्म होना आवश्यक है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
आवेश-द्रव्यमान अनुपात \(\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0\) को संतुष्ट करते हैं।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQ_Q02 - Magnetic field due to moving electrons

questiontext.text:
Biot-Savart law indicates that the moving electrons (velocity \(\mathbf{v}\)) produce a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) such that

बायो-सावर्ट नियम दर्शाता है कि गतिमान इलेक्ट्रॉन (वेग \(\mathbf{v}\)) एक ऐसा चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{B}\) उत्पन्न करते हैं कि

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to the Biot-Savart law, a moving point charge \(q\) with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) produces a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) at a position vector \(\mathbf{r}\) from the charge.

Step 2: Relevant Formula
The magnetic field is given by \(\mathbf{B} = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} \frac{q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r})}{r^3}\).

Step 3: Evaluation
Because \(\mathbf{B}\) is proportional to the vector cross product \(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r}\), the magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is perpendicular to both the velocity vector \(\mathbf{v}\) and the position vector \(\mathbf{r}\) joining the electron and the point of observation. Moreover, the magnitude of \(\mathbf{B}\) varies as \(\frac{1}{r^2}\), so it obeys the inverse square law rather than the inverse cube law.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is perpendicular to the velocity \(\mathbf{v}\), i.e., \(\mathbf{B} \perp \mathbf{v}\).

चरण 1: सैद्धांतिक सिद्धांत
बायो-सावर्ट नियम के अनुसार, वेग \(\mathbf{v}\) से गतिमान एक बिंदु आवेश \(q\) अपने से स्थिति सदिश \(\mathbf{r}\) पर एक चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{B}\) उत्पन्न करता है।

चरण 2: संबंधित सूत्र
चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{B} = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} \frac{q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r})}{r^3}\) द्वारा दिया जाता है।

चरण 3: मूल्यांकन
चूँकि \(\mathbf{B}\) सदिश गुणनफल \(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{r}\) के समानुपाती है, अतः चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{B}\) वेग सदिश \(\mathbf{v}\) तथा इलेक्ट्रॉन और प्रेक्षण बिंदु को मिलाने वाले स्थिति सदिश \(\mathbf{r}\) दोनों के लंबवत होता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, \(\mathbf{B}\) का परिमाण \(\frac{1}{r^2}\) के अनुसार परिवर्तित होता है, इसलिए यह व्युत्क्रम वर्ग नियम का पालन करता है, न कि व्युत्क्रम घन नियम का।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{B}\) वेग \(\mathbf{v}\) के लंबवत होता है, अर्थात् \(\mathbf{B} \perp \mathbf{v}\)।

answer.text: it is along the line joining the electron and point of observation.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOVINGCHARGESANDMAGNETISM_MCQ_Q03 - Magnetic moment of bent circular loop

questiontext.text:
A current carrying circular loop of radius \(R\) is placed in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane with centre at the origin. Half of the loop with \(x > 0\) is now bent so that it now lies in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane.

त्रिज्या \(R\) का एक धारावाही वृत्ताकार लूप \(x\)-\(y\) तल में इस प्रकार रखा है कि उसका केंद्र मूल बिंदु पर है। \(x > 0\) वाले लूप के आधे भाग को अब मोड़कर \(y\)-\(z\) तल में कर दिया जाता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A circular loop of radius \(R\) carrying current \(I\) initially lies in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane centred at the origin. The half with \(x > 0\) is bent into the \(y\)-\(z\) plane.

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
The magnetic dipole moment of a planar current loop is \(\mathbf{M} = I\mathbf{A}\), directed perpendicular to its plane. A non-planar loop can be decomposed into two closed planar semicircular loops by imagining two equal and opposite currents along the common \(y\)-axis diameter, which cancel each other.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
Before bending, the magnetic moment has magnitude \(M_0 = I\pi R^2\) along the \(z\)-axis. After bending, the two semicircular halves have areas \(A_1 = A_2 = \frac{\pi R^2}{2}\) in the \(x\)-\(y\) and \(y\)-\(z\) planes respectively.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The magnetic moments of the two halves are \(\mathbf{M}_1 = \frac{1}{2}I\pi R^2 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\) and \(\mathbf{M}_2 = \frac{1}{2}I\pi R^2 \hat{\mathbf{i}}\) (or along \(-\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) depending on bending direction). The net magnetic moment is \(\mathbf{M}_{\text{net}} = \mathbf{M}_1 + \mathbf{M}_2\), whose magnitude is \(M_{\text{net}} = \sqrt{M_1^2 + M_2^2} = \sqrt{\left(\frac{M_0}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{M_0}{2}\right)^2} = \frac{M_0}{\sqrt{2}}\). Since \(\frac{M_0}{\sqrt{2}} < M_0\), the magnitude of the magnetic moment decreases. Also, at \((0, 0, z)\) for \(z \gg R\), the on-axis field is proportional to the \(z\)-component of the magnetic moment, which drops from \(M_0\) to \(M_0/2\), so \(\mathbf{B}\) decreases.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The magnitude of the magnetic moment diminishes by a factor of \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
त्रिज्या \(R\) और धारा \(I\) वाला एक वृत्ताकार लूप प्रारंभ में मूल बिंदु पर केंद्रित होकर \(x\)-\(y\) तल में स्थित है। \(x > 0\) वाले आधे भाग को मोड़कर \(y\)-\(z\) तल में कर दिया जाता है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और सिद्धांत
समतलीय धारा लूप का चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण \(\mathbf{M} = I\mathbf{A}\) होता है, जो उसके तल के लंबवत होता है। उभयनिष्ठ \(y\)-अक्ष व्यास के अनुदिश दो समान और विपरीत धाराओं की कल्पना करके असमतलीय लूप को दो बंद समतलीय अर्धवृत्ताकार लूपों में विभाजित किया जा सकता है, जो परस्पर निरस्त हो जाती हैं।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र
मोड़ने से पहले चुंबकीय आघूर्ण का परिमाण \(z\)-अक्ष के अनुदिश \(M_0 = I\pi R^2\) है। मोड़ने के बाद, दोनों अर्धवृत्ताकार भागों का क्षेत्रफल क्रमशः \(x\)-\(y\) और \(y\)-\(z\) तलों में \(A_1 = A_2 = \frac{\pi R^2}{2}\) है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
दोनों आधे भागों के चुंबकीय आघूर्ण \(\mathbf{M}_1 = \frac{1}{2}I\pi R^2 \hat{\mathbf{k}}\) और \(\mathbf{M}_2 = \frac{1}{2}I\pi R^2 \hat{\mathbf{i}}\) (या मोड़ने की दिशा के अनुसार \(-\hat{\mathbf{i}}\)) हैं। परिणामी चुंबकीय आघूर्ण \(\mathbf{M}_{\text{net}} = \mathbf{M}_1 + \mathbf{M}_2\) है, जिसका परिमाण \(M_{\text{net}} = \sqrt{M_1^2 + M_2^2} = \sqrt{\left(\frac{M_0}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{M_0}{2}\right)^2} = \frac{M_0}{\sqrt{2}}\) है। चूँकि \(\frac{M_0}{\sqrt{2}} < M_0\), अतः चुंबकीय आघूर्ण का परिमाण घट जाता है। साथ ही, \(z \gg R\) के लिए \((0, 0, z)\) पर अक्षीय क्षेत्र चुंबकीय आघूर्ण के \(z\)-घटक के समानुपाती होता है, जो \(M_0\) से घटकर \(M_0/2\) हो जाता है, अतः \(\mathbf{B}\) भी घटता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
