5.4 दो आदर्श निकायों पर विचार कीजिए: (i) बड़ी प्लेटों और कम दूरी वाला एक समांतर प्लेट संधारित्र तथा (ii) \(L \gg R\) लंबाई (जहाँ \(R\) अनुप्रस्थ काट की त्रिज्या है) की एक लंबी परिनालिका। (i) में \(\mathbf{E}\) को आदर्श रूप से प्लेटों के बीच नियत और बाहर शून्य माना जाता है। (ii) में चुंबकीय क्षेत्र को परिनालिका के भीतर नियत और बाहर शून्य माना जाता है। यद्यपि, ये आदर्श कल्पनाएँ निम्नलिखित मौलिक नियमों का उल्लंघन करती हैं:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
For an electrostatic field, the conservative nature requires \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = 0\) around any closed loop, and Gauss's law requires \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot d\mathbf{s} = rac{q}{\varepsilon_0}\). For a magnetic field, Gauss's law requires \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{s} = 0\) and Ampere's law for \(\mathbf{H}\) requires \(\oint \mathbf{H} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = I_{en}\).

Step 2: Evaluation
In case (i), if \(\mathbf{E}\) is constant between the plates and drops abruptly to zero outside, a rectangular loop crossing the edge of the capacitor has a non-zero line integral \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot d\mathbf{l} eq 0\), contradicting the conservative nature of electrostatics (it does not contradict Gauss's law for electrostatics). In case (ii), if \(\mathbf{B}\) is constant inside and zero outside, magnetic field lines would abruptly terminate at the ends, contradicting \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{s} = 0\)? Wait: for a finite solenoid of length \(L\), a rectangular Amperian loop placed near the end or outside cannot satisfy \(\oint \mathbf{H} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = I_{en}\) if the field is strictly zero everywhere outside, and furthermore, a rectangular loop enclosing the boundary of the solenoid at the ends contradicts \(\oint \mathbf{H} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = I_{en}\) when the field drops abruptly to zero outside at the ends without fringing. Specifically, for a rectangular loop straddling the side or ends, if \(\mathbf{B}\) is constant inside and zero outside, \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{s} eq 0\) at the ends AND \(\oint \mathbf{H} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = I_{en}\) is contradicted for loops at the ends where current is enclosed or not enclosed.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Case (ii) contradicts \(\oint \mathbf{H} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = I_{en}\).

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
स्थिरवैद्युत क्षेत्र के लिए, संरक्षी प्रकृति के अनुसार किसी भी बंद पाश के अनुदिश \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = 0\) होना चाहिए, और गाउस के नियम के अनुसार \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot d\mathbf{s} = rac{q}{\varepsilon_0}\) होना चाहिए। चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के लिए, गाउस के नियम के अनुसार \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{s} = 0\) और \(\mathbf{H}\) के लिए ऐम्पियर के नियम के अनुसार \(\oint \mathbf{H} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = I_{en}\) होना चाहिए।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
स्थिति (i) में, यदि प्लेटों के बीच \(\mathbf{E}\) नियत है और बाहर अचानक शून्य हो जाता है, तो संधारित्र के किनारे को पार करने वाले आयताकार पाश के लिए \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot d\mathbf{l} eq 0\) होगा, जो स्थिरवैद्युत क्षेत्र की संरक्षी प्रकृति का उल्लंघन करता है (यह स्थिरवैद्युतिकी के गाउस नियम का उल्लंघन नहीं करता)। स्थिति (ii) में, यदि परिनालिका के भीतर क्षेत्र नियत है और बाहर शून्य है, तो सिरों पर क्षेत्र रेखाएँ अचानक समाप्त हो जाएँगी और सिरों पर स्थित ऐम्पियरी पाशों के लिए \(\oint \mathbf{H} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = I_{en}\) का उल्लंघन होता है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
स्थिति (ii), \(\oint \mathbf{H} \cdot d\mathbf{l} = I_{en}\) का उल्लंघन करती है।

answer.text: case (i) contradicts Gauss's law for electrostatic fields.
case (ii) contradicts Gauss's law for magnetic fields.

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQI_MAGNETISMANDMATTER_Q55 - Magnetisation of a paramagnetic sample using Curie law

questiontext.text:
5.5 A paramagnetic sample shows a net magnetisation of \(8\text{ A m}^{-1}\) when placed in an external magnetic field of \(0.6\text{ T}\) at a temperature of \(4\text{ K}\). When the same sample is placed in an external magnetic field of \(0.2\text{ T}\) at a temperature of \(16\text{ K}\), the magnetisation will be

5.5 एक अनुचुंबकीय नमूना \(4\text{ K}\) ताप पर \(0.6\text{ T}\) के बाह्य चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में रखे जाने पर \(8\text{ A m}^{-1}\) का कुल चुंबकन दर्शाता है। जब इसी नमूने को \(16\text{ K}\) ताप पर \(0.2\text{ T}\) के बाह्य चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में रखा जाता है, तो चुंबकन होगा

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Initial magnetisation \(M_1 = 8\text{ A m}^{-1}\), initial magnetic field \(B_1 = 0.6\text{ T}\), initial temperature \(T_1 = 4\text{ K}\). Final magnetic field \(B_2 = 0.2\text{ T}\), final temperature \(T_2 = 16\text{ K}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The sample is paramagnetic and obeys Curie's law in the unsaturated regime.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
According to Curie's law, the magnetisation \(M\) of a paramagnetic material is directly proportional to the applied magnetic field \(B\) and inversely proportional to the absolute temperature \(T\):
\[M = C \frac{B}{T}\]
Hence,
\[\frac{M_2}{M_1} = \frac{B_2}{B_1} \times \frac{T_1}{T_2}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting the given values:
\[\frac{M_2}{8\text{ A m}^{-1}} = \frac{0.2\text{ T}}{0.6\text{ T}} \times \frac{4\text{ K}}{16\text{ K}}\]
\[\frac{M_2}{8\text{ A m}^{-1}} = \frac{1}{3} \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{1}{12}\]
\[M_2 = \frac{8}{12}\text{ A m}^{-1} = \frac{2}{3}\text{ A m}^{-1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both decreasing the magnetic field and increasing the temperature reduce the magnetisation, so \(M_2 < M_1\) is physically consistent and units are \(\text{A m}^{-1}\). The magnetisation will be \(\frac{2}{3}\text{ A m}^{-1}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
प्रारंभिक चुंबकन \(M_1 = 8\text{ A m}^{-1}\), प्रारंभिक चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(B_1 = 0.6\text{ T}\), प्रारंभिक ताप \(T_1 = 4\text{ K}\)। अंतिम चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(B_2 = 0.2\text{ T}\), अंतिम ताप \(T_2 = 16\text{ K}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
नमूना अनुचुंबकीय है और असंतृप्त अवस्था में क्यूरी के नियम का पालन करता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
क्यूरी के नियम के अनुसार, किसी अनुचुंबकीय पदार्थ का चुंबकन \(M\) आरोपित चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(B\) के अनुक्रमानुपाती और परम ताप \(T\) के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होता है:
\[M = C \frac{B}{T}\]
अतः,
\[\frac{M_2}{M_1} = \frac{B_2}{B_1} \times \frac{T_1}{T_2}\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
दिए गए मान रखने पर:
\[\frac{M_2}{8\text{ A m}^{-1}} = \frac{0.2\text{ T}}{0.6\text{ T}} \times \frac{4\text{ K}}{16\text{ K}}\]
\[\frac{M_2}{8\text{ A m}^{-1}} = \frac{1}{3} \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{1}{12}\]
\[M_2 = \frac{8}{12}\text{ A m}^{-1} = \frac{2}{3}\text{ A m}^{-1}\]

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
चुंबकीय क्षेत्र को कम करने और ताप को बढ़ाने दोनों से चुंबकन घटता है, अतः \(M_2 < M_1\) भौतिक रूप से संगत है और मात्रक \(\text{A m}^{-1}\) है। चुंबकन \(\frac{2}{3}\text{ A m}^{-1}\) होगा।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQII_MAGNETISMANDMATTER_Q56 - Continuity of B and H across material surface

questiontext.text:
5.6 \(S\) is the surface of a lump of magnetic material.

5.6 \(S\) किसी चुंबकीय पदार्थ के एक टुकड़े का पृष्ठ है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to Gauss's law for magnetism, \( abla \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0\) everywhere, meaning magnetic monopoles do not exist and lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) always form closed continuous loops. The magnetic intensity \(\mathbf{H}\) is related to \(\mathbf{B}\) and magnetisation \(\mathbf{M}\) by \(\mathbf{H} = rac{\mathbf{B}}{\mu_0} - \mathbf{M}\), so \( abla \cdot \mathbf{H} = - abla \cdot \mathbf{M}\).

Step 2: Evaluation
Because \( abla \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0\) across any boundary, the normal component of \(\mathbf{B}\) is continuous across \(S\), and lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) are necessarily continuous across \(S\). On the other hand, at the surface \(S\) of a magnetised material, \(\mathbf{M}\) changes abruptly from a non-zero value inside to zero outside. This produces an effective surface magnetic pole density, causing a discontinuity in the normal component of \(\mathbf{H}\). Therefore, lines of \(\mathbf{H}\) cannot all be continuous across \(S\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) are necessarily continuous across \(S\), and lines of \(\mathbf{H}\) cannot all be continuous across \(S\).

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
चुंबकत्व के लिए गाउस के नियम के अनुसार, हर स्थान पर \( abla \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0\) होता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि चुंबकीय एकध्रुव का अस्तित्व नहीं होता और \(\mathbf{B}\) की रेखाएँ सदैव बंद सतत पाश बनाती हैं। चुंबकीय तीव्रता \(\mathbf{H}\), \(\mathbf{B}\) और चुंबकन \(\mathbf{M}\) से \(\mathbf{H} = rac{\mathbf{B}}{\mu_0} - \mathbf{M}\) द्वारा संबंधित होती है, अतः \( abla \cdot \mathbf{H} = - abla \cdot \mathbf{M}\)।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
चूँकि किसी भी परिसीमा के पार \( abla \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0\) होता है, इसलिए \(S\) के पार \(\mathbf{B}\) का अभिलंब घटक सतत होता है और \(\mathbf{B}\) की रेखाएँ अनिवार्य रूप से \(S\) के पार सतत होती हैं। दूसरी ओर, चुंबकित पदार्थ के पृष्ठ \(S\) पर \(\mathbf{M}\) भीतर के अशून्य मान से बाहर शून्य मान तक अचानक बदलता है। इससे एक प्रभावी पृष्ठीय चुंबकीय ध्रुव घनत्व उत्पन्न होता है, जिसके कारण \(\mathbf{H}\) के अभिलंब घटक में असततता आ जाती है। अतः \(\mathbf{H}\) की सभी रेखाएँ \(S\) के पार सतत नहीं हो सकतीं।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
\(\mathbf{B}\) की रेखाएँ \(S\) के पार अनिवार्य रूप से सतत होती हैं, और \(\mathbf{H}\) की सभी रेखाएँ \(S\) के पार सतत नहीं हो सकतीं।

answer.text: Some lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) must be discontinuous across \(S\).
Lines of \(\mathbf{H}\) cannot all be continuous across \(S\).

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQII_MAGNETISMANDMATTER_Q57 - Primary origins of magnetism in matter

questiontext.text:
5.7 The primary origin(s) of magnetism lies in

5.7 चुंबकत्व का/के प्राथमिक उद्गम निहित है/हैं

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Magnetism in matter arises from the magnetic dipole moments associated with electrons in atoms.

Step 2: Evaluation
Each electron in an atom possesses two sources of magnetic moment: (1) its orbital motion around the nucleus, which constitutes a microscopic atomic current loop (atomic currents), and (2) its intrinsic spin angular momentum, which gives rise to an intrinsic spin magnetic moment. While the Pauli exclusion principle influences how electrons fill orbitals and thus affects net pairing, and polar nature relates to electric dipoles, the primary physical origins of magnetism itself are atomic currents and the intrinsic spin of the electron.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The primary origins of magnetism lie in atomic currents and the intrinsic spin of the electron.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
पदार्थ में चुंबकत्व परमाणुओं में उपस्थित इलेक्ट्रॉनों से संबद्ध चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव आघूर्णों के कारण उत्पन्न होता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
परमाणु में प्रत्येक इलेक्ट्रॉन के पास चुंबकीय आघूर्ण के दो स्रोत होते हैं: (1) नाभिक के चारों ओर उसकी कक्षीय गति, जो एक सूक्ष्म परमाण्विक धारा पाश (परमाण्विक धाराएँ) बनाती है, और (2) उसका नैज प्रचक्रण कोणीय संवेग, जो एक नैज प्रचक्रण चुंबकीय आघूर्ण उत्पन्न करता है। यद्यपि पाउली का अपवर्जन सिद्धांत यह प्रभावित करता है कि इलेक्ट्रॉन कक्षकों को कैसे भरते हैं और ध्रुवीय प्रकृति विद्युत द्विध्रुवों से संबंधित है, परंतु चुंबकत्व के प्राथमिक भौतिक उद्गम परमाण्विक धाराएँ और इलेक्ट्रॉन का नैज प्रचक्रण हैं।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
चुंबकत्व के प्राथमिक उद्गम परमाण्विक धाराओं और इलेक्ट्रॉन के नैज प्रचक्रण में निहित हैं।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQII_MAGNETISMANDMATTER_Q58 - Solenoid with soft iron core heated above Curie temperature

questiontext.text:
5.8 A long solenoid has \(1000\) turns per metre and carries a current of \(1\text{ A}\). It has a soft iron core of \(\mu_r = 1000\). The core is heated beyond the Curie temperature, \(T_c\).

5.8 एक लंबी परिनालिका में प्रति मीटर \(1000\) फेरे हैं और इसमें \(1\text{ A}\) की धारा प्रवाहित हो रही है। इसमें \(\mu_r = 1000\) वाला एक नर्म लोहे का क्रोड है। क्रोड को क्यूरी ताप \(T_c\) से अधिक ताप तक गर्म किया जाता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Number of turns per unit length \(n = 1000\text{ m}^{-1}\), current \(I = 1\text{ A}\), initial relative permeability of soft iron core \(\mu_r = 1000\). The core is heated beyond its Curie temperature \(T_c\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Above the Curie temperature \(T_c\), ferromagnetic soft iron undergoes a phase transition to a paramagnetic state with typical susceptibility \(\chi_{\text{para}} \sim 10^{-5}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Magnetic intensity: \(H = nI\)
Magnetic susceptibility: \(\chi = \mu_r - 1\)
Magnetisation: \(M = \chi H\)
Magnetic field: \(B = \mu_0 (H + M) = \mu_0 \mu_r H\)

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The \(\mathbf{H}\) field inside the long solenoid depends only on the free current and number of turns per unit length: \(H = nI = 1000 \times 1 = 1000\text{ A m}^{-1}\). Thus, \(\mathbf{H}\) remains nearly unchanged.
Before heating, \(\chi_1 = \mu_r - 1 = 999 \approx 10^3\), so \(M_1 \approx 10^3 H\) and \(B_1 = 1000 \mu_0 H\).
Above \(T_c\), soft iron becomes paramagnetic with \(\chi_2 \sim 10^{-5}\) and \(\mu_{r2} \approx 1\), so \(B_2 \approx \mu_0 H\), which decreases drastically (by a factor of about \(1000\)).
The magnetisation becomes \(M_2 = \chi_2 H \sim 10^{-5} H\), so the ratio is:
\[\frac{M_1}{M_2} \sim \frac{10^3 H}{10^{-5} H} = 10^8\]
Thus, the magnetisation diminishes by a factor of about \(10^8\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The \(\mathbf{H}\) field in the solenoid is nearly unchanged while the \(\mathbf{B}\) field decreases drastically, and the magnetisation in the core diminishes by a factor of about \(10^8\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
प्रति एकांक लंबाई फेरों की संख्या \(n = 1000\text{ m}^{-1}\), धारा \(I = 1\text{ A}\), नर्म लोहे के क्रोड की प्रारंभिक आपेक्षिक चुंबकशीलता \(\mu_r = 1000\)। क्रोड को उसके क्यूरी ताप \(T_c\) से अधिक तक गर्म किया जाता है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
क्यूरी ताप \(T_c\) के ऊपर, लौहचुंबकीय नर्म लोहा अनुचुंबकीय अवस्था में परिवर्तित हो जाता है जिसकी विशिष्ट चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति \(\chi_{\text{para}} \sim 10^{-5}\) होती है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
चुंबकीय तीव्रता: \(H = nI\)
चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति: \(\chi = \mu_r - 1\)
चुंबकन: \(M = \chi H\)
चुंबकीय क्षेत्र: \(B = \mu_0 (H + M) = \mu_0 \mu_r H\)

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
लंबी परिनालिका के भीतर \(\mathbf{H}\) क्षेत्र केवल मुक्त धारा और प्रति एकांक लंबाई फेरों की संख्या पर निर्भर करता है: \(H = nI = 1000 \times 1 = 1000\text{ A m}^{-1}\)। अतः \(\mathbf{H}\) लगभग अपरिवर्तित रहता है।
गर्म करने से पहले, \(\chi_1 = \mu_r - 1 = 999 \approx 10^3\), अतः \(M_1 \approx 10^3 H\) और \(B_1 = 1000 \mu_0 H\)।
\(T_c\) के ऊपर, नर्म लोहा \(\chi_2 \sim 10^{-5}\) और \(\mu_{r2} \approx 1\) के साथ अनुचुंबकीय बन जाता है, अतः \(B_2 \approx \mu_0 H\), जो अत्यधिक (लगभग \(1000\) के गुणक से) घट जाता है।
चुंबकन \(M_2 = \chi_2 H \sim 10^{-5} H\) हो जाता है, अतः अनुपात है:
\[\frac{M_1}{M_2} \sim \frac{10^3 H}{10^{-5} H} = 10^8\]
इस प्रकार, चुंबकन लगभग \(10^8\) के गुणक से कम हो जाता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
परिनालिका में \(\mathbf{H}\) क्षेत्र लगभग अपरिवर्तित रहता है परंतु \(\mathbf{B}\) क्षेत्र अत्यधिक घट जाता है, और क्रोड में चुंबकन लगभग \(10^8\) के गुणक से कम हो जाता है।

answer.text: The \(\mathbf{H}\) field in the solenoid is (nearly) unchanged but the \(\mathbf{B}\) field decreases drastically.
The \(\mathbf{H}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) fields in the solenoid are nearly unchanged.
The magnetisation in the core reverses direction.
The magnetisation in the core diminishes by a factor of about \(10^{8}\).

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQII_MAGNETISMANDMATTER_Q59 - Electrostatic shielding versus magnetostatic shielding

questiontext.text:
5.9 Essential difference between electrostatic shielding by a conducting shell and magnetostatic shielding is due to

5.9 किसी चालक खोल द्वारा स्थिरवैद्युत परिरक्षण और स्थिरचुंबकीय परिरक्षण के बीच मूलभूत अंतर का कारण है

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Electrostatic shielding relies on the redistribution of free charges on a conductor so that electric field lines terminate on surface charges and the interior field vanishes. Magnetostatic shielding relies on the absence of magnetic monopoles and the continuity of magnetic field lines.

Step 2: Evaluation
In electrostatics, field lines can start and end on isolated charges, and conductors possess free charges that rearrange to completely cancel the electric field inside a hollow conducting cavity. In magnetostatics, magnetic monopoles do not exist, so lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) cannot end on any material; therefore, perfect magnetostatic shielding is not possible by simply terminating field lines. Instead, shells made of high-permeability ferromagnetic materials (such as soft iron) are used to divert most of the lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) through the shell walls, keeping them away from the interior region.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Electrostatic field lines can end on charges and conductors have free charges; lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) cannot end on any material and perfect shielding is not possible; and shells of high permeability materials can be used to divert lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) from the interior region.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
स्थिरवैद्युत परिरक्षण किसी चालक पर मुक्त आवेशों के पुनर्वितरण पर निर्भर करता है जिससे विद्युत क्षेत्र रेखाएँ पृष्ठ आवेशों पर समाप्त हो जाती हैं और आंतरिक क्षेत्र शून्य हो जाता है। स्थिरचुंबकीय परिरक्षण चुंबकीय एकध्रुवों की अनुपस्थिति और चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाओं की सततता पर निर्भर करता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
स्थिरवैद्युतिकी में, क्षेत्र रेखाएँ विलगित आवेशों पर प्रारंभ और समाप्त हो सकती हैं, तथा चालकों में मुक्त आवेश होते हैं जो खोखली चालक गुहा के भीतर विद्युत क्षेत्र को पूर्णतः निरस्त करने के लिए पुनर्व्यवस्थित हो जाते हैं। स्थिरचुंबकिकी में, चुंबकीय एकध्रुवों का अस्तित्व नहीं होता, इसलिए \(\mathbf{B}\) की रेखाएँ किसी भी पदार्थ पर समाप्त नहीं हो सकतीं; अतः केवल क्षेत्र रेखाओं को समाप्त करके पूर्ण स्थिरचुंबकीय परिरक्षण संभव नहीं है। इसके बजाय, उच्च चुंबकशीलता वाले लौहचुंबकीय पदार्थों (जैसे नर्म लोहा) के खोल का उपयोग \(\mathbf{B}\) की अधिकांश रेखाओं को खोल की दीवारों से मोड़कर आंतरिक क्षेत्र से दूर रखने के लिए किया जाता है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
स्थिरवैद्युत क्षेत्र रेखाएँ आवेशों पर समाप्त हो सकती हैं और चालकों में मुक्त आवेश होते हैं; \(\mathbf{B}\) की रेखाएँ किसी भी पदार्थ पर समाप्त नहीं हो सकतीं और पूर्ण परिरक्षण संभव नहीं है; तथा उच्च चुंबकशीलता वाले पदार्थों के खोल का उपयोग \(\mathbf{B}\) की रेखाओं को आंतरिक क्षेत्र से मोड़ने के लिए किया जा सकता है।

answer.text: electrostatic field lines can end on charges and conductors have free charges.
lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) can also end but conductors cannot end them.
lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) cannot end on any material and perfect shielding is not possible.
shells of high permeability materials can be used to divert lines of \(\mathbf{B}\) from the interior region.

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQII_MAGNETISMANDMATTER_Q510 - Angle of dip along the geographical equator

questiontext.text:
5.10 Let the magnetic field on earth be modelled by that of a point magnetic dipole at the centre of earth. The angle of dip at a point on the geographical equator

5.10 मान लीजिए पृथ्वी पर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र को पृथ्वी के केंद्र पर स्थित एक बिंदु चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र द्वारा प्रतिरूपित किया गया है। भौगोलिक विषुवत वृत्त पर स्थित किसी बिंदु पर नति कोण

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In the dipole model of Earth's magnetism, the magnetic dipole axis is tilted at an angle of about \(11.3^\circ\) with respect to the Earth's geographic rotation axis. Consequently, the magnetic equator (where the angle of dip is zero) is tilted relative to the geographical equator.

Step 2: Evaluation
Because the magnetic equator and geographical equator are two distinct great circles inclined to each other, they intersect at exactly two antipodal points. Only at these two specific points of intersection on the geographical equator is the angle of dip zero (so it is not always zero). On one half of the geographical equator (lying in the magnetic northern hemisphere), the dip angle is positive, and on the other half (lying in the magnetic southern hemisphere), the dip angle is negative. Since the tilt angle is finite (\(11.3^\circ\)), the magnetic latitude along the geographical equator varies between \(-11.3^\circ\) and \(+11.3^\circ\), so the angle of dip is bounded.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The angle of dip at a point on the geographical equator can be zero at specific points, can be positive or negative, and is bounded.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
पृथ्वी के चुंबकत्व के द्विध्रुव मॉडल में, चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव अक्ष पृथ्वी के भौगोलिक घूर्णन अक्ष के सापेक्ष लगभग \(11.3^\circ\) के कोण पर झुका होता है। परिणामस्वरूप, चुंबकीय विषुवत वृत्त (जहाँ नति कोण शून्य होता है) भौगोलिक विषुवत वृत्त के सापेक्ष झुका होता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
चूँकि चुंबकीय विषुवत वृत्त और भौगोलिक विषुवत वृत्त एक-दूसरे से झुके हुए दो अलग-अलग वृहत् वृत्त हैं, इसलिए वे ठीक दो प्रतिध्रुवी बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं। भौगोलिक विषुवत वृत्त के केवल इन्हीं दो विशिष्ट प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदुओं पर नति कोण शून्य होता है (अतः यह सदैव शून्य नहीं होता)। भौगोलिक विषुवत वृत्त के एक अर्धभाग (जो चुंबकीय उत्तरी गोलार्ध में स्थित है) पर नति कोण धनात्मक होता है, और दूसरे अर्धभाग (जो चुंबकीय दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में स्थित है) पर नति कोण ऋणात्मक होता है। चूँकि झुकाव कोण परिमित (\(11.3^\circ\)) है, इसलिए भौगोलिक विषुवत वृत्त के अनुदिश चुंबकीय अक्षांश \(-11.3^\circ\) से \(+11.3^\circ\) के बीच रहता है, अतः नति कोण परिबद्ध होता है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
भौगोलिक विषुवत वृत्त पर स्थित किसी बिंदु पर नति कोण विशिष्ट बिंदुओं पर शून्य हो सकता है, धनात्मक या ऋणात्मक हो सकता है, और परिबद्ध होता है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q61 - Magnetic flux through a square in xy plane

questiontext.text: 6.1 A square of side \(L\) meters lies in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane in a region, where the magnetic field is given by \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\), where \(B_0\) is constant. The magnitude of flux passing through the square is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Side length of the square \(= L\text{ m}\).
The square lies in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane.
The magnetic field is \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\), where \(B_0\) is a constant.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Since the square lies in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane, its area vector \(\mathbf{A}\) is perpendicular to the \(x\)-\(y\) plane, i.e., along the \(z\)-axis (\(\hat{\mathbf{k}}\)). Because only the magnitude of the magnetic flux is required, we take \(\mathbf{A} = L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}}\text{ m}^2\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnetic flux \(\Phi\) passing through a flat surface of area vector \(\mathbf{A}\) in a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is given by:
\[\Phi = \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute \(\mathbf{B}\) and \(\mathbf{A}\) into the flux formula:
\[|\Phi| = \left| B_0(2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{k}}) \cdot (L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}}) \right|\]
Using \(\hat{\mathbf{i}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{k}} = 0\), \(\hat{\mathbf{j}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{k}} = 0\), and \(\hat{\mathbf{k}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{k}} = 1\):
\[|\Phi| = |B_0 L^2 (0 + 0 + 4)| = 4 B_0 L^2\text{ Wb}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The unit of \(\mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A}\) is \(\text{T}\cdot\text{m}^2 = \text{Wb}\), which matches the SI unit of magnetic flux. Only the \(z\)-component of the magnetic field contributes to the flux through a surface in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane. Thus, the magnitude of flux passing through the square is \(4 B_0 L^2\text{ Wb}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q62 - Magnetic flux through a nonplanar six-corner loop

questiontext.text: 6.2 A loop, made of straight edges has six corners at \(A(0,0,0)\), \(B(L,0,0)\), \(C(L,L,0)\), \(D(0,L,0)\), \(E(0,L,L)\) and \(F(0,0,L)\). A magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\) is present in the region. The flux passing through the loop \(ABCDEFA\) (in that order) is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Vertices of the loop \(ABCDEFA\) in order: \(A(0,0,0)\), \(B(L,0,0)\), \(C(L,L,0)\), \(D(0,L,0)\), \(E(0,L,L)\), \(F(0,0,L)\).
Magnetic field: \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The non-planar loop \(ABCDEFA\) can be decomposed into two planar square loops sharing the common edge \(AD\) traversed in opposite directions: loop \(ABCDA\) in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane (\(z = 0\)) and loop \(ADEFA\) in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane (\(x = 0\)). By the right-hand rule for the given traversal order, the outward normal directions determine the area vectors \(\mathbf{A}_1\) and \(\mathbf{A}_2\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For a closed loop composed of planar segments, the total area vector is the vector sum of the area vectors of the individual planar loops:
\[\mathbf{A} = \mathbf{A}_1 + \mathbf{A}_2\]
The magnetic flux through the loop is:
\[\Phi = \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For loop \(ABCDA\) in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane, \(\overrightarrow{AB} = L\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) and \(\overrightarrow{BC} = L\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). Using the right-hand rule:
\[\mathbf{A}_1 = \overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{BC} = (L\hat{\mathbf{i}}) \times (L\hat{\mathbf{j}}) = L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}}\]
For loop \(ADEFA\) in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane, \(\overrightarrow{DE} = L\hat{\mathbf{k}}\) and \(\overrightarrow{EF} = -L\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). Using the right-hand rule:
\[\mathbf{A}_2 = \overrightarrow{DE} \times \overrightarrow{EF} = (L\hat{\mathbf{k}}) \times (-L\hat{\mathbf{j}}) = L^2\hat{\mathbf{i}}\]
The total area vector of the loop \(ABCDEFA\) is:
\[\mathbf{A} = \mathbf{A}_1 + \mathbf{A}_2 = L^2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}}\]
Now calculate the magnetic flux:
\[\Phi = \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A} = B_0(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}}) \cdot (L^2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}}) = B_0 L^2 (1 + 1) = 2 B_0 L^2\text{ Wb}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both components of \(\mathbf{B}\) align positively with the respective planar area vectors, giving a positive sum with units \(\text{T}\cdot\text{m}^2 = \text{Wb}\). Thus, the flux passing through the loop \(ABCDEFA\) is \(2 B_0 L^2\text{ Wb}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q63 - Rotating cylindrical bar magnet about symmetry axis

questiontext.text: 6.3 A cylindrical bar magnet is rotated about its axis (Fig 6.1). A wire is connected from the axis and is made to touch the cylindrical surface through a contact. Then

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A cylindrical bar magnet rotates about its own longitudinal symmetry axis with angular speed \(\omega\). An external wire connects the axis of the magnet through an ammeter \(A\) to a sliding contact on the cylindrical surface.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The cylindrical bar magnet is assumed to have an axially symmetric magnetic field distribution about its axis of rotation, and the external circuit remains stationary.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
According to Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, the induced electromotive force \(\varepsilon\) in a closed circuit is equal to the negative rate of change of magnetic flux \(\Phi\) linked with the circuit:
\[\varepsilon = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt}\]
By Ohm's law, the induced current is \(I = \frac{\varepsilon}{R}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Because the cylindrical bar magnet is symmetric about its axis of rotation, rotating it about this axis leaves the magnetic field at every point in space unchanged with time. Consequently, the magnetic flux \(\Phi\) linked with the closed circuit remains constant:
\[\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0 \implies \varepsilon = 0\]
Therefore, the current through the ammeter is:
\[I = \frac{0}{R} = 0\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since there is no change in magnetic flux linked with the circuit, no e.m.f. is induced. Thus, no current flows through the ammeter \(A\).

answer.text: a direct current flows in the ammeter A.
no current flows through the ammeter A.
an alternating sinusoidal current flows through the ammeter A with a time period \(T = 2\pi /\omega\)
a time varying non-sinosoidal current flows through the ammeter A.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q64 - Induced current in stationary coil B due to moving coil A

questiontext.text: 6.4 There are two coils A and B as shown in Fig 6.2. A current starts flowing in B as shown, when A is moved towards B and stops when A stops moving. The current in A is counterclockwise. B is kept stationary when A moves. We can infer that

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two coplanar circular coils \(A\) and \(B\) are placed side by side. Coil \(B\) is stationary, and coil \(A\) moves towards \(B\) with velocity \(\mathbf{v}\). Current flows in \(B\) in the counterclockwise direction while \(A\) moves, and stops when \(A\) stops moving.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let the plane of the coils be the \(x\)-\(y\) plane, with the \(+z\) axis pointing out of the page. By the right-hand rule, a counterclockwise current produces a magnetic field pointing out of the page inside the coil and into the page outside the coil.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Faraday's law and Lenz's law state that an induced current flows in a coil only when the magnetic flux through it changes, and the direction of the induced current opposes the change in magnetic flux:
\[\varepsilon = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Since the current in \(B\) stops as soon as \(A\) stops moving, the magnetic flux through \(B\) does not change when \(A\) is stationary. This implies that the current in coil \(A\) must be constant (not time-varying).
2. In coil \(B\), the induced current is counterclockwise, which produces a magnetic field pointing out of the page inside \(B\). By Lenz's law, as \(A\) moves towards \(B\), the magnetic flux through \(B\) due to \(A\) is increasing, so the induced field in \(B\) must oppose the field from \(A\) at the location of \(B\). Therefore, the magnetic field at \(B\) due to \(A\) must be pointing into the page.
3. For a circular coil \(A\), the magnetic field outside the loop (at \(B\)) points into the page when the magnetic field inside \(A\) points out of the page. By the right-hand rule, an outward magnetic field inside \(A\) corresponds to a counterclockwise current in \(A\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
A constant current in \(A\) explains why induction ceases when motion stops, and a counterclockwise direction in \(A\) produces an inward external field at \(B\) whose increase is opposed by a counterclockwise induced current in \(B\). Hence, there is a constant current in the counterclockwise direction in \(A\).

answer.text: there is a constant current in the clockwise direction in A.
there is a varying current in A.
there is a constant current in the counterclockwise direction in A.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q65 - Induced current in stationary coil B due to rotating coil A

questiontext.text: 6.5 Same as problem 4 except the coil A is made to rotate about a vertical axis (Fig 6.3). No current flows in B if A is at rest. The current in coil A, when the current in B (at \(t = 0\)) is counterclockwise and the coil A is as shown at this instant, \(t = 0\), is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Coils \(A\) and \(B\) are initially coplanar at \(t = 0\). Coil \(B\) is stationary, and coil \(A\) rotates about a vertical axis in its plane with angular velocity \(\omega\). No current flows in \(B\) when \(A\) is at rest. At \(t = 0\), the induced current in \(B\) is counterclockwise.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Take the direction out of the page as positive (\(+z\)). A counterclockwise current produces an outward magnetic field inside the coil and an inward field outside the coil in the same plane; a clockwise current produces an inward field inside the coil and an outward field outside the coil in the same plane.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By Faraday's law and Lenz's law, the induced current in \(B\) opposes the change in magnetic flux through \(B\). When \(A\) rotates by an angle \(\theta = \omega t\) from the coplanar position, the magnetic flux through \(B\) due to \(A\) is proportional to \(\cos(\omega t)\), so its magnitude decreases as \(A\) rotates away from \(t = 0\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Since no current is induced in \(B\) when \(A\) is at rest, the current in \(A\) must be constant (steady).
2. At \(t = 0\), \(A\) begins to rotate away from the coplanar position, so the magnetic flux through \(B\) due to \(A\) decreases in magnitude.
3. The induced current in \(B\) at \(t = 0\) is counterclockwise, which produces an outward magnetic field inside \(B\). By Lenz's law, \(B\) generates this outward field to oppose a decrease in outward magnetic flux through \(B\).
4. Therefore, the magnetic field at \(B\) produced by coil \(A\) at \(t = 0\) must be pointing out of the page. For the field outside coil \(A\) (at \(B\)) to point out of the page, the field inside coil \(A\) must point into the page, which corresponds to a clockwise current in \(A\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
A steady clockwise current in \(A\) creates an outward flux at \(B\) that decreases upon rotation, inducing a counterclockwise current in \(B\) to oppose the decrease. Hence, there is a constant current clockwise in coil \(A\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q66 - Dependence of solenoid self inductance on length and area

questiontext.text: 6.6 The self inductance \(L\) of a solenoid of length \(l\) and area of cross-section \(A\), with a fixed number of turns \(N\) increases as

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A solenoid has length \(l\), cross-sectional area \(A\), and a fixed total number of turns \(N\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The solenoid is treated as a long air-core solenoid (or with a core of constant permeability \(\mu\)) so that edge effects are neglected.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The self-inductance \(L\) of a solenoid is given by:
\[L = \frac{\mu_0 N^2 A}{l}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(\mu_0\) and \(N\) are fixed constants, \(L\) is directly proportional to the cross-sectional area \(A\) and inversely proportional to the length \(l\):
\[L \propto \frac{A}{l}\]
Therefore, \(L\) increases when \(l\) decreases and \(A\) increases.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Decreasing \(l\) increases the turn density \(n = N/l\), and increasing \(A\) increases the magnetic flux linkage per unit current. Thus, \(L\) increases as \(l\) decreases and \(A\) increases.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q67 - Causes of heating in a metal plate

questiontext.text: 6.7 A metal plate is getting heated. It can be because

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A metal plate heats up when electrical energy is dissipated as thermal energy through Joule heating (\(P = I^2 R\)), either due to an externally driven electric current (direct or alternating) or due to induced eddy currents produced by a changing magnetic flux.

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Condition
1. Direct current passing through the plate: A steady direct current flowing through a conductor of non-zero resistance dissipates heat at the rate \(I^2 R\), so the plate gets heated.
2. Plate placed in a time-varying magnetic field: A time-varying magnetic field changes the magnetic flux through the plate, inducing circulating eddy currents inside the metal plate, which cause Joule heating.
3. Plate placed in a space-varying, time-independent magnetic field: If the plate is stationary in a magnetic field that varies only in space and not in time, the magnetic flux through any loop in the plate remains constant (\(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0\)). Hence, no eddy currents are induced and no heating occurs.
4. Either direct or alternating current passing through the plate: Both direct current and alternating current dissipate electrical energy as heat (\(I_{\text{rms}}^2 R\)) when passing through a resistive metal plate.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The metal plate can get heated when a direct current passes through it, when it is placed in a time-varying magnetic field, or when a current (either direct or alternating) passes through it.

answer.text: a direct current is passing through the plate.
it is placed in a time varying magnetic field.
it is placed in a space varying magnetic field, but does not vary with time.
a current (either direct or alternating) is passing through the plate.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q68 - Conditions for induced emf in an isolated coil

questiontext.text: 6.8 An e.m.f is produced in a coil, which is not connected to an external voltage source. This can be due to

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, an e.m.f. \(\varepsilon = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt}\) is induced in a coil whenever the magnetic flux \(\Phi = \int \mathbf{B} \cdot d\mathbf{A}\) linked with the coil changes with time.

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Condition
1. Coil in a time-varying magnetic field: As \(\mathbf{B}\) changes with time, the flux \(\Phi\) through the coil changes, inducing an e.m.f.
2. Coil moving in a time-varying magnetic field: Both the motion of the coil and the time variation of \(\mathbf{B}\) can change the magnetic flux \(\Phi\) through the coil, inducing an e.m.f.
3. Coil moving in a constant magnetic field: If the coil rotates in a uniform constant magnetic field (changing the orientation \(\theta\) between \(\mathbf{B}\) and \(\mathbf{A}\)) or translates into/out of a constant magnetic field region, the flux \(\Phi\) changes and an e.m.f. is induced.
4. Coil stationary in a spatially varying, time-independent magnetic field: If both the coil and the magnetic field at every point are stationary in time, the flux \(\Phi\) through the coil remains constant (\(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0\)), so no e.m.f. is induced.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
An e.m.f. can be produced in the coil when it is in a time-varying magnetic field, moving in a time-varying magnetic field, or moving in a constant magnetic field.

answer.text: the coil being in a time varying magnetic field.
the coil moving in a time varying magnetic field.
the coil moving in a constant magnetic field.
the coil is stationary in external spatially varying magnetic field, which does not change with time.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q69 - Properties of mutual inductance between two coils

questiontext.text: 6.9 The mutual inductance \(M_{12}\) of coil 1 with respect to coil 2

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Mutual inductance \(M_{12}\) between two coils is a purely geometric and medium-dependent quantity (determined by the number of turns, cross-sectional areas, separation, relative orientation, and magnetic permeability of the medium). By the reciprocity theorem, \(M_{12} = M_{21}\).

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Statement
1. Increases when they are brought nearer: Bringing the coils closer increases the magnetic flux linkage between them per unit current, so \(M_{12}\) increases.
2. Depends on the current passing through the coils: Since \(\Phi_{12} = M_{12} I_2\), the mutual inductance \(M_{12}\) is independent of the current in the coils (for a linear medium).
3. Increases when one of them is rotated about an axis: Rotating one coil changes the relative angle between their axes; depending on the initial orientation, \(M_{12}\) may decrease (for instance, from coaxial to perpendicular, where \(M_{12} = 0\)) or remain unchanged, so it does not necessarily increase.
4. Is the same as \(M_{21}\) of coil 2 with respect to coil 1: By the reciprocity theorem of mutual inductance, \(M_{12} = M_{21}\) always holds.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The mutual inductance \(M_{12}\) increases when the two coils are brought nearer and is equal to \(M_{21}\) of coil 2 with respect to coil 1.

answer.text: depends on the current passing through the coils.
increases when one of them is rotated about an axis.
is the same as \(M_{21}\) of coil 2 with respect to coil 1.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q610 - Expanding circular coil with zero induced emf

questiontext.text: 6.10 A circular coil expands radially in a region of magnetic field and no electromotive force is produced in the coil. This can be because

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
As the circular coil expands radially, its area \(A\) increases with time (\(\frac{dA}{dt} > 0\)). The magnetic flux through the coil is \(\Phi = B_\perp A\), where \(B_\perp\) is the component of the magnetic field perpendicular to the plane of the coil. For no e.m.f. to be induced, the rate of change of flux must be zero:
\[\varepsilon = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = -\left(B_\perp \frac{dA}{dt} + A \frac{dB_\perp}{dt}\right) = 0\]

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Condition
1. Magnetic field is constant: If a constant magnetic field has a non-zero perpendicular component \(B_\perp\), then \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = B_\perp \frac{dA}{dt} \neq 0\), which induces an e.m.f.
2. Magnetic field is in the same plane as the circular coil and may or may not vary: Here \(B_\perp = 0\) at all times, so \(\Phi = 0\) always and \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0\) regardless of whether the field varies.
3. Magnetic field has a perpendicular component whose magnitude is decreasing suitably: If \(B_\perp\) decreases such that \(B_\perp A = \text{constant}\) (i.e., \(B_\perp \frac{dA}{dt} + A \frac{dB_\perp}{dt} = 0\)), the net flux remains constant and no e.m.f. is induced.
4. Constant magnetic field in the perpendicular direction: Here \(B_\perp = \text{constant} \neq 0\), so \(\Phi = B_\perp A\) increases as \(A\) increases, inducing a non-zero e.m.f.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
No e.m.f. is produced in the expanding circular coil either when the magnetic field lies in the same plane as the coil (whether varying or not) or when the perpendicular component of the magnetic field decreases suitably so as to keep the magnetic flux constant.

answer.text: the magnetic field is in the same plane as the circular coil and it may or may not vary.
the magnetic field has a perpendicular (to the plane of the coil) component whose magnitude is decreasing suitably.
there is a constant magnetic field in the perpendicular (to the plane of the coil) direction.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q01 - Magnetic flux passing through a square

questiontext.text:
6.1 A square of side \(L\) meters lies in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane in a region, where the magnetic field is given by \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\), where \(B_0\) is constant. The magnitude of flux passing through the square is

6.1 \(L\) মিটার বাহুবিশিষ্ট একটি বর্গক্ষেত্র \(x\)-\(y\) তলে এমন একটি অঞ্চলে অবস্থিত, যেখানে চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\) দ্বারা প্রদত্ত, যেখানে \(B_0\) একটি ধ্রুবক। বর্গক্ষেত্রটির মধ্য দিয়ে অতিক্রান্ত চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্সের মান হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Side of the square \(= L\,\text{m}\). The square lies in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane. The magnetic field is \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\), where \(B_0\) is a constant.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The area vector \(\mathbf{A}\) of a planar surface is directed perpendicular to its plane. For a surface in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane, the unit normal is along the \(z\)-axis (\(\hat{\mathbf{k}}\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Magnetic flux \(\Phi\) through a flat surface of area vector \(\mathbf{A}\) in a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B}\) is given by \(\Phi = \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The area vector of the square is \(\mathbf{A} = L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}}\,\text{m}^2\).
Taking the dot product:
\(\Phi = B_0(2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{k}}) \cdot (L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}})\)
Since \(\hat{\mathbf{i}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{k}} = 0\), \(\hat{\mathbf{j}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{k}} = 0\), and \(\hat{\mathbf{k}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{k}} = 1\):
\(\Phi = 4 B_0 L^2\,\text{Wb}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The unit \(\text{T}\cdot\text{m}^2 = \text{Wb}\) is consistent for magnetic flux. Therefore, the magnitude of the magnetic flux passing through the square is \(4 B_0 L^2\,\text{Wb}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
বর্গক্ষেত্রের বাহু \(= L\,\text{m}\)। বর্গক্ষেত্রটি \(x\)-\(y\) তলে অবস্থিত। চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\), যেখানে \(B_0\) একটি ধ্রুবক।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
একটি সমতল পৃষ্ঠের ক্ষেত্রফল ভেক্টর \(\mathbf{A}\) তলটির সাথে লম্বভাবে থাকে। \(x\)-\(y\) তলের জন্য একক অভিলম্ব ভেক্টর \(z\)-অক্ষ বরাবর (\(\hat{\mathbf{k}}\))।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
সুষম চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B}\)-তে \(\mathbf{A}\) ক্ষেত্রফল ভেক্টরের একটি সমতল পৃষ্ঠের মধ্য দিয়ে অতিক্রান্ত চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্স \(\Phi = \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
বর্গক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল ভেক্টর \(\mathbf{A} = L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}}\,\text{m}^2\)।
ডট গুণফল নিয়ে:
\(\Phi = B_0(2\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 3\hat{\mathbf{j}} + 4\hat{\mathbf{k}}) \cdot (L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}})\)
যেহেতু \(\hat{\mathbf{i}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{k}} = 0\), \(\hat{\mathbf{j}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{k}} = 0\), এবং \(\hat{\mathbf{k}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{k}} = 1\):
\(\Phi = 4 B_0 L^2\,\text{Wb}\)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্সের একক \(\text{T}\cdot\text{m}^2 = \text{Wb}\) সঠিক। সুতরাং, বর্গক্ষেত্রটির মধ্য দিয়ে অতিক্রান্ত চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্সের মান \(4 B_0 L^2\,\text{Wb}\)।

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q02 - Magnetic flux through a six-corner loop

questiontext.text:
6.2 A loop, made of straight edges has six corners at \(A(0,0,0)\), \(B(L,0,0)\), \(C(L,L,0)\), \(D(0,L,0)\), \(E(0,L,L)\) and \(F(0,0,L)\). A magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\) is present in the region. The flux passing through the loop \(ABCDEFA\) (in that order) is

6.2 সরলরেখা দ্বারা গঠিত একটি লুপের ছয়টি কোণা \(A(0,0,0)\), \(B(L,0,0)\), \(C(L,L,0)\), \(D(0,L,0)\), \(E(0,L,L)\) এবং \(F(0,0,L)\) বিন্দুতে অবস্থিত। ওই অঞ্চলে \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\) চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র উপস্থিত আছে। \(ABCDEFA\) লুপের (এই ক্রমে) মধ্য দিয়ে অতিক্রান্ত ফ্লাক্স হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Corners of the closed loop \(ABCDEFA\) are \(A(0,0,0)\), \(B(L,0,0)\), \(C(L,L,0)\), \(D(0,L,0)\), \(E(0,L,L)\), and \(F(0,0,L)\). Uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The non-planar closed loop \(ABCDEFA\) can be decomposed into two planar square loops sharing the edge \(AD\): loop \(ABCDA\) in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane and loop \(ADEFA\) in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane. The direction of each area vector is determined by the right-hand curl rule following the traversal order.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Total magnetic flux \(\Phi = \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A}_{\text{total}} = \mathbf{B} \cdot (\mathbf{A}_1 + \mathbf{A}_2)\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For loop \(ABCDA\) in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane, \(\overrightarrow{AB} = L\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) and \(\overrightarrow{BC} = L\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), so \(\mathbf{A}_1 = \overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{BC} = L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}}\).
For loop \(ADEFA\) in the \(y\)-\(z\) plane, \(\overrightarrow{AD} = L\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\overrightarrow{DE} = L\hat{\mathbf{k}}\), so \(\mathbf{A}_2 = \overrightarrow{AD} \times \overrightarrow{DE} = L^2\hat{\mathbf{i}}\).
Thus, the net area vector is \(\mathbf{A}_{\text{total}} = L^2(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}})\).
Calculating the flux:
\(\Phi = B_0(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}}) \cdot L^2(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}}) = B_0 L^2(1 + 1) = 2 B_0 L^2\,\text{Wb}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both planar components contribute positively and equally to the flux, giving \(2 B_0 L^2\,\text{Wb}\) with proper dimensions of magnetic flux.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
বদ্ধ লুপ \(ABCDEFA\)-এর কোণাগুলি হলো \(A(0,0,0)\), \(B(L,0,0)\), \(C(L,L,0)\), \(D(0,L,0)\), \(E(0,L,L)\) এবং \(F(0,0,L)\)। সুষম চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B} = B_0(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}})\,\text{T}\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
অসমতলীয় বদ্ধ লুপ \(ABCDEFA\)-কে সাধারণ বাহু \(AD\) বরাবর দুটি সমতল বর্গাকার লুপে ভাগ করা যায়: \(x\)-\(y\) তলে \(ABCDA\) লুপ এবং \(y\)-\(z\) তলে \(ADEFA\) লুপ। ডান-হাতের নিয়ম অনুসারে প্রতিটি ক্ষেত্রফল ভেক্টরের দিক নির্ণীত হয়।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
মোট চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্স \(\Phi = \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A}_{\text{total}} = \mathbf{B} \cdot (\mathbf{A}_1 + \mathbf{A}_2)\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(x\)-\(y\) তলে \(ABCDA\) লুপের জন্য, \(\overrightarrow{AB} = L\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) এবং \(\overrightarrow{BC} = L\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), সুতরাং \(\mathbf{A}_1 = \overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{BC} = L^2\hat{\mathbf{k}}\)।
\(y\)-\(z\) তলে \(ADEFA\) লুপের জন্য, \(\overrightarrow{AD} = L\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) এবং \(\overrightarrow{DE} = L\hat{\mathbf{k}}\), সুতরাং \(\mathbf{A}_2 = \overrightarrow{AD} \times \overrightarrow{DE} = L^2\hat{\mathbf{i}}\)।
অতএব, লব্ধি ক্ষেত্রফল ভেক্টর \(\mathbf{A}_{\text{total}} = L^2(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}})\)।
ফ্লাক্স গণনা করে পাই:
\(\Phi = B_0(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}}) \cdot L^2(\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{k}}) = B_0 L^2(1 + 1) = 2 B_0 L^2\,\text{Wb}\)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
উভয় সমতল অংশই ফ্লাক্সে সমান ধনাত্মক অবদান রাখে, যার ফলে সঠিক এককসহ মোট চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্স \(2 B_0 L^2\,\text{Wb}\) পাওয়া যায়।

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q03 - Rotating cylindrical bar magnet current

questiontext.text:
6.3 A cylindrical bar magnet is rotated about its axis (Fig 6.1). A wire is connected from the axis and is made to touch the cylindrical surface through a contact. Then

6.3 একটি চোঙাকৃতি দণ্ড চুম্বককে তার নিজের অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে ঘোরানো হচ্ছে (চিত্র 6.1)। অক্ষ থেকে একটি তার যুক্ত করে একটি স্পর্শকের মাধ্যমে চোঙটির পৃষ্ঠতলে স্পর্শ করানো হলো। তাহলে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A cylindrical bar magnet rotates with angular velocity \(\omega\) about its symmetry axis. A stationary external circuit containing an ammeter A connects the axis to the curved cylindrical surface via a sliding contact.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The magnetic field of a cylindrical bar magnet is axially symmetric around its axis of rotation.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, the induced electromotive force in a closed circuit is \(\varepsilon = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt}\), where \(\Phi\) is the magnetic flux linked with the circuit.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
As the magnet rotates about its own symmetry axis, its magnetic field configuration at every point in space remains unchanged with time. Consequently, the magnetic flux \(\Phi\) linked with the stationary closed loop (axis wire, ammeter, sliding contact, and magnet body) does not change with time (\(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0\)).
Therefore, no emf is induced (\(\varepsilon = 0\)), and the current is \(I = \frac{\varepsilon}{R} = 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since there is no change in magnetic flux through the circuit, no current flows through the ammeter A.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
একটি চোঙাকৃতি দণ্ড চুম্বক তার প্রতিসাম্য অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে \(\omega\) কৌণিক বেগে ঘুরছে। অ্যামিটার A যুক্ত একটি স্থির বহিঃস্থ বর্তনী অক্ষটিকে একটি চলমান স্পর্শকের মাধ্যমে চোঙের বক্রপৃষ্ঠের সাথে যুক্ত করে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
একটি চোঙাকৃতি দণ্ড চুম্বকের চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র তার ঘূর্ণন অক্ষের চারদিকে অক্ষীয়ভাবে প্রতিসম।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ফ্যারাডের তড়িৎচুম্বকীয় আবেশের সূত্র অনুসারে, কোনো বদ্ধ বর্তনীতে আবিষ্ট তড়িচ্চালক বল \(\varepsilon = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt}\), যেখানে \(\Phi\) হলো বর্তনীর সাথে জড়িত চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্স।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
চুম্বকটি তার নিজের প্রতিসাম্য অক্ষের চারদিকে ঘোরার সময় স্থানের প্রতিটি বিন্দুতে এর চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রের বিন্যাস সময়ের সাথে অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। ফলে স্থির বদ্ধ লুপের সাথে জড়িত চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্স \(\Phi\) সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হয় না (\(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0\))।
অতএব, কোনো তড়িচ্চালক বল আবিষ্ট হয় না (\(\varepsilon = 0\)), এবং তড়িৎপ্রবাহ \(I = \frac{\varepsilon}{R} = 0\)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
যেহেতু বর্তনীর মধ্য দিয়ে চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্সের কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না, তাই অ্যামিটার A-এর মধ্য দিয়ে কোনো তড়িৎ প্রবাহিত হয় না।

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q04 - Induced current between moving coils A and B

questiontext.text:
6.4 There are two coils A and B as shown in Fig 6.2. A current starts flowing in B as shown, when A is moved towards B and stops when A stops moving. The current in A is counterclockwise. B is kept stationary when A moves. We can infer that

6.4 চিত্র 6.2-এ প্রদর্শিত দুটি কুণ্ডলী A এবং B রয়েছে। A-কে B-এর দিকে সরালে চিত্রানুযায়ী B-তে তড়িৎপ্রবাহ শুরু হয় এবং A স্থির হলে প্রবাহ বন্ধ হয়ে যায়। A-তে তড়িৎপ্রবাহ ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে। A চলার সময় B স্থির থাকে। আমরা সিদ্ধান্তে আসতে পারি যে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two coils A and B are placed near each other. B is stationary. When A moves towards B, a current flows in B; when A stops moving, the current in B stops. The current in A is counterclockwise.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
An induced current in B arises only when the magnetic flux linked with B changes with time.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By Faraday's law, \(\varepsilon_B = -\frac{d\Phi_B}{dt}\), where \(\Phi_B = M I_A\). Here \(M\) is the mutual inductance (which depends on the separation between A and B) and \(I_A\) is the current in A.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since the current in B stops immediately when A stops moving (so \(\frac{dM}{dt} = 0\)), the magnetic flux through B must not be changing when A is at rest. This implies \(\frac{dI_A}{dt} = 0\), meaning the current \(I_A\) in coil A must be constant in magnitude. (If \(I_A\) were varying, an emf would be induced in B even when A is stationary.) Furthermore, the problem states that the current in A is in the counterclockwise direction and nonzero (since motion produces flux change in B).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Combining these conditions, there is a constant current in the counterclockwise direction in coil A.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
দুটি কুণ্ডলী A এবং B কাছাকাছি অবস্থিত। B স্থির আছে। A-কে B-এর দিকে সরালে B-তে তড়িৎ প্রবাহিত হয় এবং A থেমে গেলে প্রবাহ বন্ধ হয়। A-তে তড়িৎপ্রবাহ ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
B কুণ্ডলীর সাথে জড়িত চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্স সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হলেই কেবল B-তে আবিষ্ট তড়িৎপ্রবাহ সৃষ্টি হয়।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ফ্যারাডের সূত্রানুসারে, \(\varepsilon_B = -\frac{d\Phi_B}{dt}\), যেখানে \(\Phi_B = M I_A\)। এখানে \(M\) হলো পারস্পরিক আবেশাঙ্ক (যা A ও B-এর দূরত্বের ওপর নির্ভরশীল) এবং \(I_A\) হলো A-তে তড়িৎপ্রবাহ।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
A স্থির হওয়ার সাথে সাথেই যেহেতু B-তে তড়িৎপ্রবাহ বন্ধ হয়ে যায় (যখন \(\frac{dM}{dt} = 0\)), তাই A স্থির থাকলে B-এর মধ্য দিয়ে ফ্লাক্সের কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না। এর অর্থ \(\frac{dI_A}{dt} = 0\), অর্থাৎ A কুণ্ডলীর তড়িৎপ্রবাহ \(I_A\) অবশ্যই ধ্রুবক। (যদি \(I_A\) পরিবর্তনশীল হতো, তবে A স্থির থাকলেও B-তে তড়িচ্চালক বল আবিষ্ট হতো।) এছাড়াও, প্রশ্নে বলা হয়েছে যে A-তে তড়িৎপ্রবাহ ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে এবং অশূন্য।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
এই শর্তগুলি একত্রিত করে বলা যায় যে, কুণ্ডলী A-তে ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে একটি ধ্রুব তড়িৎপ্রবাহ রয়েছে।

answer.text: there is a constant current in the clockwise direction in A.
there is a varying current in A.
there is a constant current in the counterclockwise direction in A.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q05 - Induced current when coil A rotates

questiontext.text:
6.5 Same as problem 4 except the coil A is made to rotate about a vertical axis (Fig 6.3). No current flows in B if A is at rest. The current in coil A, when the current in B (at \(t = 0\)) is counterclockwise and the coil A is as shown at this instant, \(t = 0\), is

6.5 প্রশ্ন 4-এর অনুরূপ, তবে এখানে A কুণ্ডলীটিকে একটি উল্লম্ব অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে ঘোরানো হচ্ছে (চিত্র 6.3)। A স্থির থাকলে B-তে কোনো তড়িৎ প্রবাহিত হয় না। \(t = 0\) মুহূর্তে B-তে তড়িৎপ্রবাহ ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে হলে এবং ওই \(t = 0\) মুহূর্তে A কুণ্ডলীটি চিত্রানুযায়ী অবস্থিত থাকলে, A কুণ্ডলীতে তড়িৎপ্রবাহ হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Coil A rotates about a vertical axis in its plane. No current flows in stationary coil B when A is at rest. At \(t = 0\), the induced current in B is counterclockwise.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
By Lenz's law, the induced current in B opposes the change in magnetic flux through B caused by the rotation of A.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Faraday's law and Lenz's law: \(\varepsilon_B = -\frac{d\Phi_B}{dt}\), where \(\Phi_B = M(t) I_A\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Because no current flows in B when A is at rest, the current \(I_A\) in coil A must be constant (not varying with time).
When coil A rotates from its position at \(t = 0\), the magnetic flux passing through B decreases in magnitude. Since the induced current in B at \(t = 0\) is counterclockwise, its induced magnetic field points out of the plane of the paper to oppose the decrease in outward flux (or reinforce an outward field). By Lenz's law, to produce a counterclockwise current in B, the steady current in coil A must be in the clockwise direction.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, coil A carries a constant current in the clockwise direction.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
A কুণ্ডলীটি তার তলের একটি উল্লম্ব অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে ঘুরছে। A স্থির থাকলে স্থির কুণ্ডলী B-তে কোনো তড়িৎ প্রবাহিত হয় না। \(t = 0\) মুহূর্তে B-তে আবিষ্ট তড়িৎপ্রবাহ ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
লেঞ্জের সূত্রানুসারে, A-এর ঘূর্ণনের কারণে B-এর মধ্য দিয়ে চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্সের যে পরিবর্তন হয়, B-তে আবিষ্ট তড়িৎপ্রবাহ সেই পরিবর্তনের বিরোধিতা করে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ফ্যারাডের সূত্র ও লেঞ্জের সূত্র: \(\varepsilon_B = -\frac{d\Phi_B}{dt}\), যেখানে \(\Phi_B = M(t) I_A\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
যেহেতু A স্থির থাকলে B-তে কোনো তড়িৎ প্রবাহিত হয় না, তাই A কুণ্ডলীর তড়িৎপ্রবাহ \(I_A\) অবশ্যই ধ্রুবক (সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তনশীল নয়)।
\(t = 0\) অবস্থান থেকে A কুণ্ডলীটি ঘুরতে শুরু করলে B-এর মধ্য দিয়ে অতিক্রান্ত চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্স হ্রাস পায়। \(t = 0\) মুহূর্তে B-তে আবিষ্ট প্রবাহ ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে হওয়ায়, এর আবিষ্ট চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র কাগজের তল থেকে বাইরের দিকে ক্রিয়া করে। লেঞ্জের সূত্র অনুযায়ী, B-তে ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীতমুখী প্রবাহ সৃষ্টি করতে A কুণ্ডলীতে ধ্রুব তড়িৎপ্রবাহ অবশ্যই ঘড়ির কাঁটার দিকে হতে হবে।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
অতএব, A কুণ্ডলীতে ঘড়ির কাঁটার দিকে একটি ধ্রুব তড়িৎপ্রবাহ রয়েছে।

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQ1_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q06 - Self inductance of a solenoid

questiontext.text:
6.6 The self inductance \(L\) of a solenoid of length \(l\) and area of cross-section \(A\), with a fixed number of turns \(N\) increases as

6.6 নির্দিষ্ট সংখ্যক পাক \(N\) বিশিষ্ট \(l\) দৈর্ঘ্য এবং \(A\) প্রস্থচ্ছেদের ক্ষেত্রফলযুক্ত একটি সলিনয়েডের স্বাবেশাঙ্ক \(L\) বৃদ্ধি পায় যখন

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A solenoid has length \(l\), cross-sectional area \(A\), and a fixed number of turns \(N\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The solenoid is assumed to be long and air-cored (or having a uniform core of constant permeability \(\mu_0\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The self-inductance of a long solenoid is given by \(L = \frac{\mu_0 N^2 A}{l}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(\mu_0\) and \(N\) are constant:
\(L \propto \frac{A}{l}\)
Thus, \(L\) is directly proportional to the cross-sectional area \(A\) and inversely proportional to the length \(l\). Therefore, \(L\) increases when \(l\) decreases and \(A\) increases.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Dimensionally, \([\mu_0 A / l] = \text{H}\), which matches inductance. Hence, the self-inductance \(L\) increases as \(l\) decreases and \(A\) increases.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
একটি সলিনয়েডের দৈর্ঘ্য \(l\), প্রস্থচ্ছেদের ক্ষেত্রফল \(A\) এবং পাকসংখ্যা \(N\) নির্দিষ্ট।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
সলিনয়েডটি দীর্ঘ এবং বায়ু-মজ্জাবিশিষ্ট (বা ধ্রুবক ভেদ্যতা \(\mu_0\) যুক্ত সুষম মজ্জাবিশিষ্ট) বলে ধরা হয়েছে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
একটি দীর্ঘ সলিনয়েডের স্বাবেশাঙ্কের সূত্র হলো \(L = \frac{\mu_0 N^2 A}{l}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
যেহেতু \(\mu_0\) এবং \(N\) ধ্রুবক:
\(L \propto \frac{A}{l}\)
সুতরাং, \(L\) প্রস্থচ্ছেদের ক্ষেত্রফল \(A\)-এর সমানুপাতিক এবং দৈর্ঘ্য \(l\)-এর ব্যস্তানুপাতিক। অতএব, \(l\) হ্রাস পেলে এবং \(A\) বৃদ্ধি পেলে \(L\) বৃদ্ধি পায়।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
মাত্রাগতভাবে \([\mu_0 A / l] = \text{H}\), যা আবেশাঙ্কের এককের সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ। সুতরাং, \(l\) কমলে এবং \(A\) বাড়লে স্বাবেশাঙ্ক \(L\) বৃদ্ধি পায়।

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQ2_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q07 - Heating of a metal plate

questiontext.text:
6.7 A metal plate is getting heated. It can be because

6.7 একটি ধাতব পাত উত্তপ্ত হচ্ছে। এর কারণ হতে পারে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A metal plate heats up due to Joule heating (\(P = I^2 R\)) whenever an electric current flows through it. This current may be supplied directly (direct or alternating current) or induced inside the plate as eddy currents due to a changing magnetic flux.

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Mechanism
1. When a direct current passes through the plate, it dissipates thermal energy at the rate \(I^2 R\), heating the plate.
2. When any current (either direct or alternating) passes through the plate, Joule heating occurs (\(I^2 R\) for DC or \(I_{\text{rms}}^2 R\) for AC).
3. When the plate is placed in a time-varying magnetic field, the magnetic flux linked with the plate changes with time (\(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} \neq 0\)), inducing circulating eddy currents that heat the plate.
4. When a stationary plate is placed in a magnetic field that varies in space but does not vary with time, \(\frac{\partial \mathbf{B}}{\partial t} = 0\) and there is no motion, so \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0\). Hence, no eddy currents are induced and no heating occurs.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, a metal plate can get heated when a direct current passes through it, when it is placed in a time-varying magnetic field, or when either a direct or alternating current passes through it.

ধাপ ১: ধারণাগত নীতি
একটি ধাতব পাতের মধ্য দিয়ে যখনই তড়িৎ প্রবাহিত হয়, তখন জুলের তাপীয় ক্রিয়া (\(P = I^2 R\))-এর কারণে পাতটি উত্তপ্ত হয়। এই প্রবাহ সরাসরি (সমপ্রবাহ বা পরিবর্তী প্রবাহ) সরবরাহ করা হতে পারে অথবা পরিবর্তনশীল চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্সের কারণে পাতের মধ্যে ঘূর্ণি প্রবাহ (eddy current) হিসেবে আবিষ্ট হতে পারে।

ধাপ ২: প্রতিটি প্রক্রিয়ার মূল্যায়ন
১. পাতের মধ্য দিয়ে সমপ্রবাহ (DC) প্রবাহিত হলে \(I^2 R\) হারে তাপ উৎপন্ন হয় এবং পাতটি উত্তপ্ত হয়।
২. পাতের মধ্য দিয়ে যেকোনো প্রবাহ (সমপ্রবাহ বা পরিবর্তী প্রবাহ) চললে জুলের তাপীয় ক্রিয়া ঘটে (DC-র জন্য \(I^2 R\) বা AC-র জন্য \(I_{\text{rms}}^2 R\))।
৩. পাতটিকে সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তনশীল চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে রাখলে পাতের সাথে জড়িত চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্স সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হয় (\(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} \neq 0\)), যার ফলে আবিষ্ট ঘূর্ণি প্রবাহ পাতটিকে উত্তপ্ত করে।
৪. একটি স্থির পাতকে এমন চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে রাখা হলে যা স্থানে পরিবর্তিত হয় কিন্তু সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হয় না, তখন \(\frac{\partial \mathbf{B}}{\partial t} = 0\) এবং কোনো গতি না থাকায় \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0\)। ফলে কোনো ঘূর্ণি প্রবাহ আবিষ্ট হয় না এবং তাপ উৎপন্ন হয় না।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, ধাতব পাতটি উত্তপ্ত হতে পারে যদি এর মধ্য দিয়ে সমপ্রবাহ চলে, এটি সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তনশীল চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে থাকে, অথবা এর মধ্য দিয়ে সমপ্রবাহ বা পরিবর্তী প্রবাহ যেকোনো একটি প্রবাহিত হয়।

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQ2_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q08 - Causes of induced emf in a coil

questiontext.text:
6.8 An e.m.f is produced in a coil, which is not connected to an external voltage source. This can be due to

6.8 কোনো বহিঃস্থ ভোল্টেজ উৎসের সাথে যুক্ত নয় এমন একটি কুণ্ডলীতে তড়িচ্চালক বল (e.m.f) উৎপন্ন হয়। এর কারণ হতে পারে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, an emf \(\varepsilon = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt}\) is induced in a coil whenever the magnetic flux \(\Phi = \int \mathbf{B}\cdot d\mathbf{A}\) linked with the coil changes with time.

Step 2: Evaluation of Cases
1. When the coil is in a time-varying magnetic field, \(\mathbf{B}\) changes with time, so \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} \neq 0\) and an emf is induced.
2. When the coil is moving in a time-varying magnetic field, both the field and the coil's position/orientation can change, causing \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} \neq 0\) and inducing an emf.
3. When the coil is moving in a constant (uniform or non-uniform) magnetic field—for example, rotating or translating across a boundary or through a non-uniform region—the magnetic flux linked with it can change with time, inducing an emf.
4. When the coil is stationary in an external spatially varying magnetic field that does not change with time, neither \(\mathbf{B}\) nor \(\mathbf{A}\) nor their relative orientation changes with time, so \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0\) and no emf is produced.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Thus, an emf can be produced when the coil is in a time-varying magnetic field, moving in a time-varying magnetic field, or moving in a constant magnetic field.

ধাপ ১: ধারণাগত নীতি
ফ্যারাডের তড়িৎচুম্বকীয় আবেশের সূত্রানুসারে, একটি কুণ্ডলীর সাথে জড়িত চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্স \(\Phi = \int \mathbf{B}\cdot d\mathbf{A}\) সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হলেই তাতে তড়িচ্চালক বল \(\varepsilon = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt}\) আবিষ্ট হয়।

ধাপ ২: প্রতিটি ক্ষেত্রের মূল্যায়ন
১. কুণ্ডলীটি সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তনশীল চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে থাকলে \(\mathbf{B}\) সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হয়, ফলে \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} \neq 0\) এবং তড়িচ্চালক বল আবিষ্ট হয়।
২. কুণ্ডলীটি সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তনশীল চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে গতিশীল থাকলে ক্ষেত্র এবং কুণ্ডলীর অবস্থান বা অভিমুখ পরিবর্তনের ফলে \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} \neq 0\) হয় ও তড়িচ্চালক বল আবিষ্ট হয়।
৩. কুণ্ডলীটি ধ্রুবক চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে গতিশীল থাকলে (যেমন ঘূর্ণন বা অসম ক্ষেত্র বা ক্ষেত্রের সীমানা অতিক্রম করা), কুণ্ডলীর সাথে জড়িত ফ্লাক্স সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হতে পারে, ফলে তড়িচ্চালক বল আবিষ্ট হয়।
৪. কুণ্ডলীটি এমন একটি বাহ্যিক স্থানে-পরিবর্তনশীল চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে স্থির থাকলে যা সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হয় না, তবে \(\mathbf{B}\), \(\mathbf{A}\) বা তাদের মধ্যবর্তী কোণ কোনোটিই সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হয় না। ফলে \(\frac{d\Phi}{dt} = 0\) এবং কোনো তড়িচ্চালক বল উৎপন্ন হয় না।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, কুণ্ডলীটি সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তনশীল চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে থাকলে, সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তনশীল চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে গতিশীল থাকলে, অথবা ধ্রুবক চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে গতিশীল থাকলে তড়িচ্চালক বল উৎপন্ন হতে পারে।

answer.text: the coil being in a time varying magnetic field.

the coil moving in a constant magnetic field.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQ2_ELECTROMAGNETICINDUCTION_MCQ_Q09 - Properties of mutual inductance M12

questiontext.text:
6.9 The mutual inductance \(M_{12}\) of coil 1 with respect to coil 2

6.9 কুণ্ডলী 2-এর সাপেক্ষে কুণ্ডলী 1-এর পারস্পরিক আবেশাঙ্ক \(M_{12}\)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Mutual inductance between two coils depends solely on their geometry (number of turns, area, shape), the relative separation and orientation between them, and the magnetic permeability of the intervening medium. It satisfies the reciprocity theorem: \(M_{12} = M_{21}\).

Step 2: Evaluation of Properties
1. When two coils are brought nearer, a larger fraction of the magnetic flux produced by one coil links with the other, so \(M_{12}\) increases.
2. Mutual inductance is a geometric/material constant of the pair of coils and does not depend on the current passing through the coils.
3. Rotating one coil about an axis generally changes the angle between the coils (and could increase, decrease, or leave the flux linkage unchanged depending on the initial and final orientations), so it does not necessarily increase.
4. By the reciprocity theorem of mutual inductance, \(M_{12}\) of coil 1 with respect to coil 2 is always equal to \(M_{21}\) of coil 2 with respect to coil 1.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, \(M_{12}\) increases when the coils are brought nearer and is the same as \(M_{21}\) of coil 2 with respect to coil 1.

ধাপ ১: ধারণাগত নীতি
দুটি কুণ্ডলীর মধ্যে পারস্পরিক আবেশাঙ্ক শুধুমাত্র তাদের জ্যামিতিক গঠন (পাকসংখ্যা, ক্ষেত্রফল, আকৃতি), তাদের মধ্যবর্তী আপেক্ষিক দূরত্ব ও অভিমুখ এবং মধ্যবর্তী মাধ্যমের চৌম্বক ভেদ্যতার ওপর নির্ভর করে। এটি পারস্পরিকতা উপপাদ্য (reciprocity theorem) মেনে চলে: \(M_{12} = M_{21}\)।

ধাপ ২: বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলির মূল্যায়ন
১. দুটি কুণ্ডলীকে কাছাকাছি আনা হলে একটি কুণ্ডলী দ্বারা সৃষ্ট চৌম্বক ফ্লাক্সের বৃহত্তর অংশ অপরটির সাথে জড়িত হয়, তাই \(M_{12}\) বৃদ্ধি পায়।
২. পারস্পরিক আবেশাঙ্ক কুণ্ডলী-যুগলের একটি জ্যামিতিক ও উপাদানগত ধ্রুবক এবং এটি কুণ্ডলীগুলির মধ্য দিয়ে প্রবাহিত তড়িতের ওপর নির্ভর করে না।
৩. একটি কুণ্ডলীকে কোনো অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে ঘোরালে তাদের মধ্যবর্তী কোণ পরিবর্তিত হয়, যার ফলে আবেশাঙ্ক বাড়তে, কমতে বা অপরিবর্তিত থাকতে পারে—তাই এটি সর্বদা বৃদ্ধি পায় না।
৪. পারস্পরিকতা উপপাদ্য অনুযায়ী, কুণ্ডলী 2-এর সাপেক্ষে কুণ্ডলী 1-এর পারস্পরিক আবেশাঙ্ক \(M_{12}\) সর্বদা কুণ্ডলী 1-এর সাপেক্ষে কুণ্ডলী 2-এর পারস্পরিক আবেশাঙ্ক \(M_{21}\)-এর সমান।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, কুণ্ডলী দুটিকে কাছাকাছি আনলে \(M_{12}\) বৃদ্ধি পায় এবং এটি কুণ্ডলী 2-এর \(M_{21}\)-এর সমান।
