चित्र 10.1 में दर्शाए अनुसार वायु से काँच की पट्टिका पर ब्रूस्टर कोण पर आपतित एक प्रकाश पुंज पर विचार कीजिए।

बिंदु \(P\) पर निर्गत किरण के पथ में एक पोलेरॉइड रखा जाता है तथा इसे इसके केंद्र से गुजरने वाले और पोलेरॉइड के तल के लंबवत अक्ष के परितः घुमाया जाता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When an unpolarised light beam is incident on a transparent medium (glass) from air at Brewster's angle, the reflected ray is completely plane polarised with vibrations perpendicular to the plane of incidence, while the refracted ray inside the slab is partially polarised.

Step 2: Evaluation
Upon emerging from the parallel-sided glass slab into air at point \(P\), the emergent ray remains partially polarised (it contains both parallel and perpendicular components of the electric field, though with unequal amplitudes). When a polaroid is placed in the path of partially polarised light and rotated through one complete revolution (\(360^\circ\)) about an axis perpendicular to its plane, the transmitted intensity varies between a maximum value and a non-zero minimum value. The intensity reaches this non-zero minimum twice during one full rotation (at two orientations separated by \(180^\circ\) where the pass axis is aligned with the weaker component).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the intensity of light as seen through the polaroid goes through a minimum, but not zero, for two orientations of the polaroid.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
जब अध्रुवित प्रकाश पुंज वायु से किसी पारदर्शी माध्यम (काँच) पर ब्रूस्टर कोण पर आपतित होता है, तो परावर्तित किरण आपतन तल के लंबवत कंपनों के साथ पूर्णतः समतल ध्रुवित होती है, जबकि पट्टिका के भीतर अपवर्तित किरण आंशिक रूप से ध्रुवित होती है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
समांतर फलकों वाली काँच की पट्टिका से वायु में बिंदु \(P\) पर निर्गत होने पर, निर्गत किरण आंशिक रूप से ध्रुवित बनी रहती है (इसमें विद्युत क्षेत्र के समांतर तथा लंबवत दोनों घटक उपस्थित होते हैं, यद्यपि उनके आयाम असमान होते हैं)। जब आंशिक रूप से ध्रुवित प्रकाश के पथ में एक पोलेरॉइड रखकर उसे उसके तल के लंबवत अक्ष के परितः एक पूर्ण चक्कर (\(360^\circ\)) घुमाया जाता है, तो पारगमित तीव्रता एक अधिकतम मान और एक अशून्य न्यूनतम मान के बीच परिवर्तित होती है। एक पूर्ण घूर्णन में तीव्रता दो बार (एक-दूसरे से \(180^\circ\) पर स्थित दो अभिविन्यासों पर, जहाँ संचरण अक्ष दुर्बल घटक के अनुदिश होता है) इस अशून्य न्यूनतम मान पर पहुँचती है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, पोलेरॉइड से देखने पर प्रकाश की तीव्रता पोलेरॉइड के दो अभिविन्यासों के लिए न्यूनतम (परंतु शून्य नहीं) होती है।

answer.text: For a particular orientation there shall be darkness as observed through the polaroid.
The intensity of light as seen through the polaroid shall be independent of the rotation.
The intensity of light as seen through the Polaroid shall go through a minimum but not zero for two orientations of the polaroid.
The intensity of light as seen through the polaroid shall go through a minimum for four orientations of the polaroid.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_WAVEOPTICS_MCQ_Q102 - Sunlight incident on a narrow slit

questiontext.text:
Consider sunlight incident on a slit of width \(10^4\text{ \AA}\). The image seen through the slit shall

\(10^4\text{ \AA}\) चौड़ाई की एक झिर्री पर आपतित सूर्य के प्रकाश पर विचार कीजिए। झिर्री से देखा गया प्रतिबिंब

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Visible sunlight consists of wavelengths ranging approximately from \(4000\text{ \AA}\) (violet) to \(8000\text{ \AA}\) (red). Diffraction effects depend on the ratio of the wavelength \(\lambda\) to the slit width \(a\).

Step 2: Evaluation
The given slit width is \(a = 10^4\text{ \AA} = 10000\text{ \AA}\), which is slightly larger than (and comparable to) the wavelengths of visible light. At the centre of the pattern (\(\theta = 0\)), the path difference between secondary wavelets from all parts of the slit is zero for every wavelength. Consequently, all colours of sunlight interfere constructively at the centre, producing a fine sharp slit that is white in colour at the centre.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the image seen through the slit shall be a fine sharp slit white in colour at the center.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
दृश्य सूर्य के प्रकाश में लगभग \(4000\text{ \AA}\) (बैंगनी) से \(8000\text{ \AA}\) (लाल) तक की तरंगदैर्ध्य होती हैं। विवर्तन प्रभाव तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda\) और झिर्री की चौड़ाई \(a\) के अनुपात पर निर्भर करते हैं।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
दी गई झिर्री की चौड़ाई \(a = 10^4\text{ \AA} = 10000\text{ \AA}\) है, जो दृश्य प्रकाश की तरंगदैर्ध्य से थोड़ी बड़ी (तथा तुलनीय) है। प्रतिरूप के केंद्र (\(\theta = 0\)) पर प्रत्येक तरंगदैर्ध्य के लिए झिर्री के सभी भागों से आने वाली द्वितीयक तरंगिकाओं के बीच पथांतर शून्य होता है। परिणामस्वरूप, सूर्य के प्रकाश के सभी रंग केंद्र पर संपोषी व्यतिकरण करते हैं, जिससे केंद्र पर श्वेत रंग की एक सूक्ष्म तीक्ष्ण झिर्री दिखाई देती है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, झिर्री से देखा गया प्रतिबिंब केंद्र पर श्वेत रंग की एक सूक्ष्म तीक्ष्ण झिर्री होगी।

answer.text: be a fine sharp slit white in colour at the center.
a bright slit white at the center diffusing to zero intensities at the edges.
a bright slit white at the center diffusing to regions of different colours.
only be a diffused slit white in colour.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_WAVEOPTICS_MCQ_Q103 - Phase difference between reflected rays in slab

questiontext.text:
Consider a ray of light incident from air onto a slab of glass (refractive index \(n\)) of width \(d\), at an angle \(\theta\). The phase difference between the ray reflected by the top surface of the glass and the bottom surface is

वायु से \(n\) अपवर्तनांक तथा \(d\) चौड़ाई की काँच की पट्टिका पर \(\theta\) कोण पर आपतित प्रकाश की एक किरण पर विचार कीजिए। काँच के ऊपरी पृष्ठ और निचले पृष्ठ द्वारा परावर्तित किरणों के बीच कलांतर है

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Refractive index of the glass slab \(= n\), refractive index of air \(= 1\), thickness (width) of the slab \(= d\), angle of incidence in air \(= \theta\), and wavelength of light in air \(= \lambda\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Reflection at a rarer-to-denser interface (air to glass at the top surface) introduces an additional phase shift of \(\pi\) radians (equivalent to an optical path difference of \(\frac{\lambda}{2}\)). Reflection at a denser-to-rarer interface (glass to air at the bottom surface) introduces no additional phase shift.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By Snell's law, \(\sin\theta = n\sin r\), where \(r\) is the angle of refraction inside the glass slab. The phase difference corresponding to a path difference \(\Delta x\) is \(\Delta\phi = \frac{2\pi}{\lambda}\Delta x + \pi\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
From Snell's law:
\(\sin r = \frac{\sin\theta}{n}\)
Using \(\cos r = \sqrt{1 - \sin^2 r}\):
\(\cos r = \left(1 - \frac{1}{n^2}\sin^2\theta\right)^{1/2}\)
The path difference term due to propagation inside the slab of thickness \(d\) yields the phase term \(\frac{4\pi d}{\lambda}\cos r = \frac{4\pi d}{\lambda}\left(1 - \frac{1}{n^2}\sin^2\theta\right)^{1/2}\) (following the convention of the given expressions). Adding the phase change of \(\pi\) arising from reflection at the denser air–glass top surface gives the total phase difference:
\(\Delta\phi = \frac{4\pi d}{\lambda}\left(1 - \frac{1}{n^2}\sin^2\theta\right)^{1/2} + \pi\)

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The phase difference includes the \(\pi\) term from the air-to-glass reflection. Hence, the phase difference between the two reflected rays is \(\frac{4\pi d}{\lambda}\left(1 - \frac{1}{n^2}\sin^2\theta\right)^{1/2} + \pi\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
काँच की पट्टिका का अपवर्तनांक \(= n\), वायु का अपवर्तनांक \(= 1\), पट्टिका की मोटाई (चौड़ाई) \(= d\), वायु में आपतन कोण \(= \theta\), तथा वायु में प्रकाश की तरंगदैर्ध्य \(= \lambda\) है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
विरल से सघन माध्यम के अंतरापृष्ठ (ऊपरी पृष्ठ पर वायु से काँच) पर परावर्तन से \(\pi\) रेडियन का अतिरिक्त कला विस्थापन उत्पन्न होता है (जो \(\frac{\lambda}{2}\) के प्रकाशिक पथांतर के तुल्य है)। सघन से विरल माध्यम के अंतरापृष्ठ (निचले पृष्ठ पर काँच से वायु) पर परावर्तन से कोई अतिरिक्त कला विस्थापन उत्पन्न नहीं होता।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
स्नेल के नियम से, \(\sin\theta = n\sin r\), जहाँ \(r\) काँच की पट्टिका के भीतर अपवर्तन कोण है। पथांतर \(\Delta x\) के संगत कलांतर \(\Delta\phi = \frac{2\pi}{\lambda}\Delta x + \pi\) होता है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
स्नेल के नियम से:
\(\sin r = \frac{\sin\theta}{n}\)
\(\cos r = \sqrt{1 - \sin^2 r}\) का उपयोग करने पर:
\(\cos r = \left(1 - \frac{1}{n^2}\sin^2\theta\right)^{1/2}\)
\(d\) मोटाई की पट्टिका के भीतर संचरण के कारण प्राप्त कला पद \(\frac{4\pi d}{\lambda}\cos r = \frac{4\pi d}{\lambda}\left(1 - \frac{1}{n^2}\sin^2\theta\right)^{1/2}\) प्राप्त होता है (दिए गए व्यंजकों की परिपाटी के अनुसार)। ऊपरी वायु–काँच सघन पृष्ठ से परावर्तन के कारण उत्पन्न \(\pi\) कला परिवर्तन को जोड़ने पर कुल कलांतर प्राप्त होता है:
\(\Delta\phi = \frac{4\pi d}{\lambda}\left(1 - \frac{1}{n^2}\sin^2\theta\right)^{1/2} + \pi\)

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
कलांतर में वायु-से-काँच परावर्तन के कारण \(\pi\) पद सम्मिलित होता है। अतः, दोनों परावर्तित किरणों के बीच कलांतर \(\frac{4\pi d}{\lambda}\left(1 - \frac{1}{n^2}\sin^2\theta\right)^{1/2} + \pi\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_WAVEOPTICS_MCQ_Q104 - Young double slit with red and blue filters

questiontext.text:
In a Young's double slit experiment, the source is white light. One of the holes is covered by a red filter and another by a blue filter. In this case

यंग के द्वि-झिर्री प्रयोग में स्रोत श्वेत प्रकाश है। एक छिद्र को लाल फिल्टर से तथा दूसरे को नीले फिल्टर से ढक दिया जाता है। इस स्थिति में

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
To observe a sustained interference pattern in Young's double-slit experiment, the two interfering light waves must be coherent—meaning they must have the same frequency (and wavelength) and maintain a constant phase difference over time.

Step 2: Evaluation
One slit transmits only red light and the other slit transmits only blue light. Since red and blue light have different wavelengths and different frequencies, the waves emerging from the two slits are incoherent and their phase difference varies rapidly and randomly with time.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Consequently, no sustained interference pattern is produced on the screen, so there shall be no interference fringes.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
यंग के द्वि-झिर्री प्रयोग में स्थायी व्यतिकरण प्रतिरूप देखने के लिए, दोनों व्यतिकारी प्रकाश तरंगों का कला-संबद्ध होना आवश्यक है—अर्थात् उनकी आवृत्ति (और तरंगदैर्ध्य) समान होनी चाहिए तथा उनके बीच कलांतर समय के साथ नियत रहना चाहिए।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
एक झिर्री केवल लाल प्रकाश पारगमित करती है तथा दूसरी झिर्री केवल नीला प्रकाश पारगमित करती है। चूँकि लाल और नीले प्रकाश की तरंगदैर्ध्य तथा आवृत्तियाँ भिन्न-भिन्न होती हैं, इसलिए दोनों झिर्रियों से निकलने वाली तरंगें कला-असंबद्ध होती हैं और उनके बीच का कलांतर समय के साथ तेजी से तथा अनियमित रूप से बदलता है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
परिणामस्वरूप, पर्दे पर कोई स्थायी व्यतिकरण प्रतिरूप नहीं बनता है, अतः कोई व्यतिकरण फ्रिंज नहीं बनेंगी।

answer.text: there shall be alternate interference patterns of red and blue.
there shall be an interference pattern for red distinct from that for blue.
there shall be an interference pattern for red mixing with one for blue.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_WAVEOPTICS_MCQ_Q105 - Second double slit behind minimum point P2

questiontext.text:
Figure 10.2 shows a standard two slit arrangement with slits \(S_1, S_2\). \(P_1, P_2\) are the two minima points on either side of \(P\) (Fig. 10.2).

At \(P_2\) on the screen, there is a hole and behind \(P_2\) is a second 2-slit arrangement with slits \(S_3, S_4\) and a second screen behind them.

चित्र 10.2 में झिर्रियों \(S_1, S_2\) वाली एक मानक द्वि-झिर्री व्यवस्था दर्शाई गई है। \(P\) के दोनों ओर \(P_1, P_2\) दो निम्निष्ठ बिंदु हैं (चित्र 10.2)।

पर्दे पर \(P_2\) पर एक छिद्र है तथा \(P_2\) के पीछे झिर्रियों \(S_3, S_4\) वाली एक दूसरी द्वि-झिर्री व्यवस्था है और उनके पीछे एक दूसरा पर्दा रखा है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
By Huygens' principle, every point on a wavefront acts as a source of secondary wavelets. In a double-slit arrangement, destructive interference at a minimum point \(P_2\) means that the two coherent waves from \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) arrive at \(P_2\) with a phase difference of \(\pi\) (or an odd multiple of \(\pi\)) and cancel each other locally at \(P_2\), not that the waves cease to exist beyond \(P_2\).

Step 2: Evaluation
When a small hole is made at \(P_2\), the wavefronts from \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) pass through the hole, and the hole acts as a source of coherent secondary wavelets for each wave component. These coherent waves diverge behind \(P_2\) and illuminate the second pair of slits \(S_3\) and \(S_4\). Because \(S_3\) and \(S_4\) receive coherent light from the same primary source \(S\), they act as coherent secondary sources.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, there would be a regular two slit interference pattern on the second screen.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
हाइगेन्स के सिद्धांत के अनुसार, तरंगाग्र का प्रत्येक बिंदु द्वितीयक तरंगिकाओं के स्रोत के रूप में कार्य करता है। द्वि-झिर्री व्यवस्था में, निम्निष्ठ बिंदु \(P_2\) पर विनाशी व्यतिकरण का अर्थ है कि \(S_1\) और \(S_2\) से आने वाली दो कला-संबद्ध तरंगें \(P_2\) पर \(\pi\) (या \(\pi\) के विषम गुणज) के कलांतर के साथ पहुँचती हैं और \(P_2\) पर स्थानीय रूप से एक-दूसरे को निरस्त करती हैं, न कि यह कि \(P_2\) के आगे तरंगों का अस्तित्व समाप्त हो जाता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
जब \(P_2\) पर एक छोटा छिद्र बनाया जाता है, तो \(S_1\) और \(S_2\) से आने वाले तरंगाग्र छिद्र से होकर गुजरते हैं, और छिद्र प्रत्येक तरंग घटक के लिए कला-संबद्ध द्वितीयक तरंगिकाओं के स्रोत के रूप में कार्य करता है। ये कला-संबद्ध तरंगें \(P_2\) के पीछे अपसरित होकर झिर्रियों \(S_3\) और \(S_4\) के दूसरे युग्म को प्रदीप्त करती हैं। चूँकि \(S_3\) और \(S_4\) को एक ही प्राथमिक स्रोत \(S\) से कला-संबद्ध प्रकाश प्राप्त होता है, इसलिए वे कला-संबद्ध द्वितीयक स्रोतों की भाँति व्यवहार करती हैं।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, दूसरे पर्दे पर एक नियमित द्वि-झिर्री व्यतिकरण प्रतिरूप प्राप्त होगा।

answer.text: There would be no interference pattern on the second screen but it would be lighted.
The second screen would be totally dark.
There would be a single bright point on the second screen.
There would be a regular two slit pattern on the second screen.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_WAVEOPTICS_MCQ_Q106 - Intensity distribution of two interfering sources

questiontext.text:
Two source \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) of intensity \(I_1\) and \(I_2\) are placed in front of a screen [Fig. 10.3 (a)]. The pattern of intensity distribution seen in the central portion is given by Fig. 10.3 (b).

In this case which of the following statements are true.

तीव्रता \(I_1\) और \(I_2\) के दो स्रोत \(S_1\) और \(S_2\) एक पर्दे के सामने रखे गए हैं [चित्र 10.3 (a)]। केंद्रीय भाग में देखा गया तीव्रता वितरण प्रतिरूप चित्र 10.3 (b) में दिया गया है।

इस स्थिति में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सत्य हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
For two interfering light waves of intensities \(I_1\) and \(I_2\), the resultant minimum intensity is \(I_{\min} = (\sqrt{I_1} - \sqrt{I_2})^2\). A steady interference pattern with well-defined maxima and minima requires coherent sources of the same wavelength and a constant phase difference.

Step 2: Evaluation
1. From the intensity distribution graph, the minima touch zero intensity (\(I_{\min} = 0\)). Thus, \((\sqrt{I_1} - \sqrt{I_2})^2 = 0\), which implies \(I_1 = I_2\), so \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) have the same intensities.
2. Since a stable interference pattern is formed, the two sources must be coherent, meaning \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) have a constant phase difference and the same wavelength.
3. Furthermore, at the symmetric centre \(x = 0\) (where the geometric path difference between \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) is zero), the intensity is a maximum. This shows that the initial phase difference between the two sources is zero, meaning \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) have the same phase.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, all four conditions hold: \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) have the same intensities, a constant phase difference, the same phase, and the same wavelength.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
तीव्रता \(I_1\) और \(I_2\) वाली दो व्यतिकारी प्रकाश तरंगों के लिए, परिणामी न्यूनतम तीव्रता \(I_{\min} = (\sqrt{I_1} - \sqrt{I_2})^2\) होती है। सुस्पष्ट उच्चिष्ठ और निम्निष्ठ वाले स्थायी व्यतिकरण प्रतिरूप के लिए समान तरंगदैर्ध्य तथा नियत कलांतर वाले कला-संबद्ध स्रोतों का होना आवश्यक है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
1. तीव्रता वितरण ग्राफ से, निम्निष्ठ शून्य तीव्रता (\(I_{\min} = 0\)) को स्पर्श करते हैं। अतः, \((\sqrt{I_1} - \sqrt{I_2})^2 = 0\), जिससे \(I_1 = I_2\) प्राप्त होता है, अर्थात् \(S_1\) और \(S_2\) की तीव्रताएँ समान हैं।
2. चूँकि एक स्थायी व्यतिकरण प्रतिरूप बनता है, इसलिए दोनों स्रोत कला-संबद्ध होने चाहिए, जिसका अर्थ है कि \(S_1\) और \(S_2\) के बीच कलांतर नियत है और उनकी तरंगदैर्ध्य समान है।
3. इसके अतिरिक्त, सममित केंद्र \(x = 0\) पर (जहाँ \(S_1\) और \(S_2\) के बीच ज्यामितीय पथांतर शून्य है), तीव्रता अधिकतम है। यह दर्शाता है कि दोनों स्रोतों के बीच प्रारंभिक कलांतर शून्य है, अर्थात् \(S_1\) और \(S_2\) की कला समान है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, चारों स्थितियाँ सत्य हैं: \(S_1\) और \(S_2\) की तीव्रताएँ समान हैं, उनके बीच कलांतर नियत है, उनकी कला समान है, तथा उनकी तरंगदैर्ध्य समान है।

answer.text: \(S_1\) and \(S_2\) have a constant phase difference.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_WAVEOPTICS_MCQ_Q107 - Sunlight incident on a very small pinhole

questiontext.text:
Consider sunlight incident on a pinhole of width \(10^3\text{ \AA}\). The image of the pinhole seen on a screen shall be

\(10^3\text{ \AA}\) चौड़ाई के एक पिनहोल (सूक्ष्म छिद्र) पर आपतित सूर्य के प्रकाश पर विचार कीजिए। पर्दे पर देखा गया पिनहोल का प्रतिबिंब होगा

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When light passes through an aperture whose size is smaller than or comparable to its wavelength, significant diffraction occurs, causing the light to spread out rather than form a sharp geometrical shadow or image.

Step 2: Evaluation
The width of the pinhole is \(10^3\text{ \AA} = 1000\text{ \AA}\), which is smaller than the wavelengths of visible sunlight (\(4000\text{ \AA}\) to \(8000\text{ \AA}\)). Consequently, sunlight undergoes strong diffraction at the pinhole, and the image formed on the screen is completely different from a geometrical image. At the centre of the diffraction pattern, all wavelengths interfere constructively to form a sharp central white spot, while away from the centre, different colours spread out at different angles to form a diffused coloured region around the central white spot.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the image of the pinhole seen on the screen shall be different from a geometrical image and consist of a diffused coloured region around a sharp central white spot.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
जब प्रकाश ऐसे द्वारक से गुजरता है जिसका आकार उसकी तरंगदैर्ध्य से छोटा या उसके तुलनीय हो, तो सार्थक विवर्तन होता है, जिससे प्रकाश तीक्ष्ण ज्यामितीय छाया या प्रतिबिंब बनाने के बजाय फैल जाता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
पिनहोल की चौड़ाई \(10^3\text{ \AA} = 1000\text{ \AA}\) है, जो दृश्य सूर्य के प्रकाश की तरंगदैर्ध्य (\(4000\text{ \AA}\) से \(8000\text{ \AA}\)) से छोटी है। परिणामस्वरूप, पिनहोल पर सूर्य के प्रकाश का प्रबल विवर्तन होता है, और पर्दे पर बना प्रतिबिंब ज्यामितीय प्रतिबिंब से पूर्णतः भिन्न होता है। विवर्तन प्रतिरूप के केंद्र पर सभी तरंगदैर्ध्य संपोषी व्यतिकरण करके एक तीक्ष्ण केंद्रीय श्वेत बिंदु बनाती हैं, जबकि केंद्र से दूर विभिन्न रंग अलग-अलग कोणों पर फैलकर केंद्रीय श्वेत बिंदु के चारों ओर एक विसरित रंगीन क्षेत्र बनाते हैं।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, पर्दे पर देखा गया पिनहोल का प्रतिबिंब ज्यामितीय प्रतिबिंब से भिन्न होगा तथा एक तीक्ष्ण केंद्रीय श्वेत बिंदु के चारों ओर विसरित रंगीन क्षेत्र के रूप में होगा।

answer.text: a diffused central spot, white in colour.
diffused coloured region around a sharp central white spot.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_WAVEOPTICS_MCQ_Q108 - Effect of increasing pinhole size on diffraction

questiontext.text:
Consider the diffraction pattern for a small pinhole. As the size of the hole is increased

एक छोटे पिनहोल के लिए विवर्तन प्रतिरूप पर विचार कीजिए। जैसे-जैसे छिद्र का आकार बढ़ाया जाता है

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
For Fraunhofer diffraction at a circular aperture (pinhole) of diameter \(d\), the angular radius of the central bright disc (Airy disc) is given by \(\theta \approx \frac{1.22\lambda}{d}\), where \(\lambda\) is the wavelength of light.

Step 2: Evaluation
As the size (diameter \(d\)) of the pinhole is increased, the angular spread \(\theta\) decreases, so the size of the diffraction pattern on the screen decreases. Simultaneously, a larger hole allows a greater amount of light energy to pass through per unit time and concentrates it into a smaller area on the screen, so the intensity of the pattern increases.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, as the size of the hole is increased, the size of the diffraction pattern decreases and the intensity increases.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
\(d\) व्यास के एक वृत्ताकार द्वारक (पिनहोल) पर फ्रॉनहोफर विवर्तन के लिए, केंद्रीय दीप्त डिस्क (एयरी डिस्क) की कोणीय त्रिज्या \(\theta \approx \frac{1.22\lambda}{d}\) द्वारा दी जाती है, जहाँ \(\lambda\) प्रकाश की तरंगदैर्ध्य है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
जैसे-जैसे पिनहोल का आकार (व्यास \(d\)) बढ़ाया जाता है, कोणीय फैलाव \(\theta\) घटता है, इसलिए पर्दे पर विवर्तन प्रतिरूप का आकार घटता है। साथ ही, बड़ा छिद्र प्रति एकांक समय में अधिक प्रकाश ऊर्जा को गुजरने देता है और उसे पर्दे के छोटे क्षेत्रफल में केंद्रित करता है, इसलिए प्रतिरूप की तीव्रता बढ़ती है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, जैसे-जैसे छिद्र का आकार बढ़ाया जाता है, प्रतिरूप का आकार घटता है और तीव्रता बढ़ती है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_WAVEOPTICS_MCQ_Q109 - Wavefront and intensity from a point source

questiontext.text:
For light diverging from a point source

एक बिंदु स्रोत से अपसरित हो रहे प्रकाश के लिए

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A wavefront is the locus of all points in a medium that vibrate in the same phase at a given instant. In an isotropic medium, light waves travel with the same speed in all directions from a point source.

Step 2: Evaluation
Since the speed of light is uniform in all directions, all points at a fixed radial distance \(r\) from the point source have the same phase. Thus, the wavefront is spherical with the point source at its centre. Furthermore, if the point source emits total power \(P\) uniformly in all directions, this power spreads over the surface area \(4\pi r^2\) of the spherical wavefront of radius \(r\). Hence, the intensity at distance \(r\) is \(I = \frac{P}{4\pi r^2} \propto \frac{1}{r^2}\), meaning the intensity decreases in proportion to the distance squared.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, for light diverging from a point source, the wavefront is spherical and the intensity decreases in proportion to the distance squared.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
तरंगाग्र किसी माध्यम में उन सभी बिंदुओं का बिंदुपथ है जो किसी दिए गए क्षण पर समान कला में कंपन करते हैं। किसी समदैशिक माध्यम में, प्रकाश तरंगें एक बिंदु स्रोत से सभी दिशाओं में समान चाल से चलती हैं।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
चूँकि सभी दिशाओं में प्रकाश की चाल एकसमान होती है, इसलिए बिंदु स्रोत से एक निश्चित त्रिज्यीय दूरी \(r\) पर स्थित सभी बिंदुओं की कला समान होती है। अतः, तरंगाग्र गोलीय होता है जिसका केंद्र बिंदु स्रोत पर होता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, यदि बिंदु स्रोत सभी दिशाओं में एकसमान रूप से कुल शक्ति \(P\) उत्सर्जित करता है, तो यह शक्ति \(r\) त्रिज्या के गोलीय तरंगाग्र के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(4\pi r^2\) पर फैल जाती है। अतः, \(r\) दूरी पर तीव्रता \(I = \frac{P}{4\pi r^2} \propto \frac{1}{r^2}\) होती है, अर्थात् तीव्रता दूरी के वर्ग के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती रूप से घटती है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, एक बिंदु स्रोत से अपसरित हो रहे प्रकाश के लिए, तरंगाग्र गोलीय होता है और तीव्रता दूरी के वर्ग के अनुपात में घटती है।

answer.text: the intensity decreases in proportion to the distance squared.
the intensity at the wavefront does not depend on the distance.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_1 - De Broglie wavelength of falling particle

questiontext.text: 11.1 A particle is dropped from a height \(H\). The de Broglie wavelength of the particle as a function of height is proportional to

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A particle of mass \(m\) is dropped from rest (initial speed \(u = 0\)) from a height \(H\) under uniform gravitational acceleration \(g\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Air resistance is neglected and the motion is non-relativistic, with downward displacement taken as positive.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For free fall from rest through a height \(H\), the speed \(v\) is given by the kinematic relation \(v^2 = u^2 + 2gH\). The de Broglie wavelength \(\lambda\) of a particle of momentum \(p = mv\) is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{mv}\), where \(h\) is Planck's constant.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting \(u = 0\) into the kinematic equation gives \(v = \sqrt{2gH}\). Substituting this speed into the de Broglie relation yields \(\lambda = \frac{h}{m\sqrt{2gH}} = \left(\frac{h}{m\sqrt{2g}}\right) H^{-1/2}\). Since \(h\), \(m\), and \(g\) are constants for the given particle, \(\lambda \propto H^{-1/2}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Dimensionally, as \(H\) increases, the speed increases and the de Broglie wavelength decreases, consistent with a negative exponent. Therefore, the de Broglie wavelength is proportional to \(H^{-1/2}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_2 - Photon wavelength to remove bound proton

questiontext.text: 11.2 The wavelength of a photon needed to remove a proton from a nucleus which is bound to the nucleus with \(1\text{ MeV}\) energy is nearly

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Binding energy of the proton in the nucleus, \(E = 1\text{ MeV} = 10^{6}\text{ eV}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The minimum energy required by the photon to just remove the proton is equal to the binding energy \(E\). Standard constant values are \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\), \(c = 3 \times 10^{8}\text{ m/s}\), and \(1\text{ eV} = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}\text{ J}\), giving \(hc \approx 1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The energy of a photon of wavelength \(\lambda\) is \(E = \frac{hc}{\lambda}\), so \(\lambda = \frac{hc}{E}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting the given energy: \(\lambda = \frac{1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}}{10^{6}\text{ eV}} = 1.24 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm} \approx 1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
A \(1\text{ MeV}\) photon lies in the gamma-ray region, which has wavelengths on the order of \(10^{-3}\text{ nm}\) (\(10^{-12}\text{ m}\)). Thus, the required wavelength is nearly \(1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_3 - Electron beam incident on metal surface

questiontext.text: 11.3 Consider a beam of electrons (each electron with energy \(E_0\)) incident on a metal surface kept in an evacuated chamber. Then

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When an energetic beam of electrons strikes a metal surface, the incident electrons interact with the free and bound electrons of the metal through elastic and inelastic collisions, causing back-scattering of primary electrons and ejection of secondary electrons.

Step 2: Evaluation
Unlike photons in the photoelectric effect (where a photon is completely absorbed and the maximum kinetic energy of an emitted electron is \(h\nu - \phi\)), an incident electron is not absorbed as a whole; it can scatter elastically from the surface retaining virtually all of its initial energy \(E_0\), or it can lose any fraction of its energy in inelastic collisions before emerging or knocking out secondary electrons.

Step 3: Application
Because electrons can undergo any number of collisions and lose varying amounts of energy, the emitted electrons (both scattered primary and secondary electrons) can emerge with a continuous range of energies from zero up to the maximum possible value \(E_0\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, electrons can be emitted with any energy, with a maximum of \(E_0\).

answer.text: no electrons will be emitted as only photons can emit electrons.
electrons can be emitted but all with an energy, \(E_0\).
electrons can be emitted with any energy, with a maximum of \(E_0 - \phi\) (\(\phi\) is the work function).
electrons can be emitted with any energy, with a maximum of \(E_0\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_4 - Davisson Germer diffraction angle with voltage

questiontext.text: 11.4 Consider Fig. 11.7 in the NCERT text book of physics for Class XII. Suppose the voltage applied to A is increased. The diffracted beam will have the maximum at a value of \(\theta\) that

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In the Davisson–Germer experiment (Fig. 11.7 of the NCERT Class XII Physics textbook), electrons are accelerated through a potential difference \(V\) applied to the accelerating anode and diffracted by a nickel crystal, with diffraction maxima governed by Bragg's law.

Step 2: Evaluation
The de Broglie wavelength of electrons accelerated through potential \(V\) is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2meV}}\), so increasing \(V\) decreases \(\lambda\). According to the diffraction condition \(D \sin\theta = n\lambda\) (or \(2d \sin\alpha = n\lambda\), where the scattering angle \(\theta\) increases with \(\lambda\)), \(\sin\theta\) is directly proportional to \(\lambda\).

Step 3: Application
When the voltage applied is increased, \(\lambda\) decreases, which in turn decreases \(\sin\theta\) and therefore decreases the angle \(\theta\) (in the first quadrant) at which the diffraction maximum occurs.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Hence, the diffracted beam will have the maximum at a value of \(\theta\) that will be less than the earlier value.

answer.text: will be larger than the earlier value.
will be the same as the earlier value.
will be less than the earlier value.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_5 - De Broglie wavelengths at same energy

questiontext.text: 11.5 A proton, a neutron, an electron and an \(\alpha\)-particle have same energy. Then their de Broglie wavelengths compare as

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A proton (\(\mathrm{p}\)), a neutron (\(\mathrm{n}\)), an electron (\(\mathrm{e}\)), and an \(\alpha\)-particle (\(\alpha\)) all have the same kinetic energy \(K\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The particles are non-relativistic, and the masses of the proton and neutron are taken as approximately equal (\(m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}}\)), while \(m_{\mathrm{e}} \ll m_{\mathrm{p}}\) and \(m_{\alpha} \approx 4m_{\mathrm{p}}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The de Broglie wavelength of a particle of mass \(m\) and kinetic energy \(K\) is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2mK}}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(K\) is identical for all four particles, \(\lambda \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{m}}\). Ordering the masses gives \(m_{\mathrm{e}} < m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}} < m_{\alpha}\). Taking the inverse square roots reverses the inequality: \(\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The \(\alpha\)-particle has the largest mass and therefore the shortest de Broglie wavelength, the proton and neutron have equal masses and equal wavelengths, and the electron has the smallest mass and longest wavelength. (Note: the source paper prints the inequality with a typographical reversal on the electron term in \(\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} > \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\), which corresponds to the intended ordering \(\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\).)

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_6 - Electron de Broglie wavelength in magnetic field

questiontext.text: 11.6 An electron is moving with an initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) and is in a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0\mathbf{j}\). Then it's de Broglie wavelength

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A charged particle moving in a uniform magnetic field experiences the Lorentz magnetic force \(\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\), which is always perpendicular to the instantaneous velocity \(\mathbf{v}\).

Step 2: Evaluation
Because the magnetic force is perpendicular to the velocity, the instantaneous power delivered is \(P = \mathbf{F} \cdot \mathbf{v} = 0\). Hence, the magnetic field does no work on the electron, and its kinetic energy and speed \(|\mathbf{v}| = v_0\) remain constant.

Step 3: Application
The de Broglie wavelength depends on the magnitude of momentum \(p = mv_0\) via \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{mv_0}\). Since \(m\) and \(v_0\) do not change with time, \(\lambda\) does not change with time.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the de Broglie wavelength of the electron remains constant.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_7 - Electron de Broglie wavelength in parallel electric field

questiontext.text: 11.7 An electron (mass \(m\)) with an initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)) is in an electric field \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 = \text{constant} > 0\)). It's de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is given by

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An electron of mass \(m\) and charge \(-e\) has initial velocity \(\mathbf{v}(0) = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)) and moves in a uniform electric field \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 > 0\)). Its initial de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The motion is non-relativistic and one-dimensional along the \(x\)-axis, with \(\mathbf{i}\) as the unit vector in the positive direction.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The electric force on the electron is \(\mathbf{F} = -e\mathbf{E}\), acceleration is \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{\mathbf{F}}{m}\), velocity at time \(t\) is \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{v}(0) + \mathbf{a}t\), and the de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{m|\mathbf{v}(t)|}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The force is \(\mathbf{F} = (-e)(-E_0\mathbf{i}) = eE_0\mathbf{i}\), so the acceleration is \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{eE_0}{m}\mathbf{i}\). Thus, the velocity at time \(t\) is \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \left(v_0 + \frac{eE_0}{m}t\right)\mathbf{i} = v_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0 t}{mv_0}\right)\mathbf{i}\). Substituting the speed \(v(t)\) into the de Broglie relation gives \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0 t}{mv_0}\right)} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At \(t = 0\), \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\), and as \(t\) increases, the electron accelerates and its wavelength decreases. Thus, the de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is \(\frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_8 - Electron de Broglie wavelength in perpendicular electric field

questiontext.text: 11.8 An electron (mass \(m\)) with an initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0 \hat{\mathbf{i}}\) is in an electric field \(\mathbf{E} = E_0 \hat{\mathbf{j}}\). If \(\lambda_0 = h/mv_0\), it's de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is given by

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An electron of mass \(m\) and charge \(-e\) has initial velocity \(\mathbf{v}(0) = v_0 \hat{\mathbf{i}}\) and moves in a uniform transverse electric field \(\mathbf{E} = E_0 \hat{\mathbf{j}}\), with \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The motion is non-relativistic in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane, with orthogonal unit vectors \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) and \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The electric force is \(\mathbf{F} = -e\mathbf{E}\), the acceleration is \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{\mathbf{F}}{m}\), the velocity vector is \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{v}(0) + \mathbf{a}t\), and the de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{m|\mathbf{v}(t)|}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The force on the electron is \(\mathbf{F} = -eE_0 \hat{\mathbf{j}}\), giving acceleration \(\mathbf{a} = -\frac{eE_0}{m}\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). Therefore, the velocity at time \(t\) is \(\mathbf{v}(t) = v_0 \hat{\mathbf{i}} - \frac{eE_0 t}{m}\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). Its magnitude is \(|\mathbf{v}(t)| = \sqrt{v_0^2 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2}} = v_0 \sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}\). Substituting this speed into the de Broglie formula yields \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At \(t = 0\), \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\), and as \(t\) increases, the transverse speed grows so \(\lambda(t)\) decreases. Thus, the de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is \(\frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_9 - Relativistic corrections for electron de Broglie wavelength

questiontext.text: 11.9 Relativistic corrections become necessary when the expression for the kinetic energy \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2\), becomes comparable with \(mc^2\), where \(m\) is the mass of the particle. At what de Broglie wavelength will relativistic corrections become important for an electron?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
For an electron, \(m = 9.11 \times 10^{-31}\text{ kg}\), \(c = 3 \times 10^{8}\text{ m/s}\), and \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\). Candidate wavelengths are \(10\text{ nm}\), \(10^{-3}\text{ nm}\), \(10^{-4}\text{ nm}\), and \(10^{-6}\text{ nm}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Relativistic corrections become important when the classical speed \(v = \frac{h}{m\lambda}\) becomes comparable to or exceeds \(c\) (so \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2\) is comparable to or exceeds \(mc^2\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
From the de Broglie relation \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\), the non-relativistic speed estimate is \(v = \frac{h}{m\lambda}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Computing \(v\) for each wavelength:
- For \(\lambda = 10\text{ nm} = 10^{-8}\text{ m}\): \(v = \frac{6.626 \times 10^{-34}}{9.11 \times 10^{-31} \times 10^{-8}} \approx 7.3 \times 10^{4}\text{ m/s} \ll c\) (non-relativistic).
- For \(\lambda = 10^{-3}\text{ nm} = 10^{-12}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{8}\text{ m/s}\), which is on the order of \(c\) (boundary regime, whereas the Compton wavelength is \(\lambda_C = \frac{h}{mc} \approx 2.4 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\)).
- For \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm} = 10^{-13}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{9}\text{ m/s} \gg c\).
- For \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm} = 10^{-15}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{11}\text{ m/s} \gg c\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since no particle can exceed \(c\), classical formulas break down completely at \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm}\) and \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm}\) (well below the Compton wavelength). Therefore, relativistic corrections are definitely important at \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm}\) and \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_10 - Particles of different masses with same de Broglie wavelength

questiontext.text: 11.10 Two particles \(A_1\), and \(A_2\) of masses \(m_1, m_2\) (\(m_1 > m_2\)) have the same de Broglie wavelength. Then

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two particles \(A_1\) and \(A_2\) have masses \(m_1\) and \(m_2\) with \(m_1 > m_2\), and equal de Broglie wavelengths \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = \lambda\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Both particles are non-relativistic, so kinetic energy is \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The de Broglie relation gives momentum \(p = \frac{h}{\lambda}\), and kinetic energy in terms of momentum is \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2\), their momenta are \(p_1 = \frac{h}{\lambda_1} = \frac{h}{\lambda_2} = p_2\), so their momenta are the same. For the same momentum \(p\), the kinetic energy is \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m} \propto \frac{1}{m}\). Because \(m_1 > m_2\), it follows that \(E_1 < E_2\), meaning the energy of \(A_1\) is less than the energy of \(A_2\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both conclusions follow directly from \(p = h/\lambda\) and \(E = p^2/(2m)\). Therefore, their momenta are the same, and the energy of \(A_1\) is less than the energy of \(A_2\).

answer.text: energy of \(A_1\) is less than the energy of \(A_2\).
energy of \(A_1\) is more than the energy of \(A_2\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_11 - Photon and electron de Broglie wavelength comparison

questiontext.text: 11.11 The de Broglie wavelength of a photon is twice the de Broglie wavelength of an electron. The speed of the electron is \(v_e = \frac{c}{100}\). Then

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The photon wavelength \(\lambda_p\) and electron de Broglie wavelength \(\lambda_e\) satisfy \(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e\). The electron speed is \(v_e = \frac{c}{100}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Since \(v_e = 0.01c \ll c\), the electron is non-relativistic, so \(p_e = m_e v_e\) and its kinetic energy is \(E_e = \frac{1}{2}m_e v_e^2\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The de Broglie relation gives \(p = \frac{h}{\lambda}\). For a photon, \(E_p = p_p c = \frac{hc}{\lambda_p}\). For the electron, \(E_e = \frac{1}{2}m_e v_e^2 = \frac{1}{2}p_e v_e\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
First, the electron momentum ratio is \(\frac{p_e}{m_e c} = \frac{m_e v_e}{m_e c} = \frac{v_e}{c} = \frac{1}{100} = 10^{-2}\). Second, since \(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e\), the photon momentum is \(p_p = \frac{h}{\lambda_p} = \frac{h}{2\lambda_e} = \frac{p_e}{2}\). Therefore, the photon energy is \(E_p = p_p c = \frac{1}{2}p_e c\). Taking the energy ratio gives \(\frac{E_e}{E_p} = \frac{\frac{1}{2}p_e v_e}{\frac{1}{2}p_e c} = \frac{v_e}{c} = \frac{1}{100} = 10^{-2}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both ratios are dimensionless and equal to \(\frac{v_e}{c} = 10^{-2}\). Hence, \(\frac{E_e}{E_p} = 10^{-2}\) and \(\frac{p_e}{m_e c} = 10^{-2}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_12 - Melting ice by photon absorption

questiontext.text: 11.12 Photons absorbed in matter are converted to heat. A source emitting \(n\) photon/sec of frequency \(\nu\) is used to convert \(1\text{ kg}\) of ice at \(0^\circ\text{C}\) to water at \(0^\circ\text{C}\). Then, the time \(T\) taken for the conversion

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of ice \(m = 1 ext{ kg}\) at \(0^\circ ext{C}\) is converted to water at \(0^\circ ext{C}\) by a source emitting \(n\) photons per second, each of frequency \( u\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
All emitted photons are absorbed and converted completely into latent heat of fusion \(L\) of ice.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Heat required to melt mass \(m\) of ice is \(Q = mL\). Energy of one photon is \(E = h u\), so the total energy delivered in time \(T\) is \(E_{ ext{total}} = n T h u\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Equating heat required to energy supplied gives \(mL = n T h u\), so \(T = rac{mL}{n h u}\). Since \(m\), \(L\), and \(h\) are constants, \(T \propto rac{1}{n u}\). Thus:
- With \( u\) fixed, \(T \propto rac{1}{n}\), so \(T\) decreases as \(n\) increases.
- With \(n\) fixed, \(T \propto rac{1}{ u}\), so \(T\) decreases as \( u\) increases.
- If \(n\) and \( u\) change such that \(n u = ext{constant}\), then \(T\) remains constant.
- If the product \(n u\) increases, \(T\) decreases rather than increases.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Higher power \(P = nh u\) melts the ice faster. Therefore, \(T\) decreases with increasing \(n\) (at fixed \( u\)), decreases with increasing \( u\) (at fixed \(n\)), and remains constant when \(n u = ext{constant}\).

answer.text: remains constant with \(n\) and \(\nu\) changing such that \(n\nu = \text{constant}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQ_Q11_13 - De Broglie wavelength in central force orbit

questiontext.text: 11.13 A particle moves in a closed orbit around the origin, due to a force which is directed towards the origin. The de Broglie wavelength of the particle varies cyclically between two values \(\lambda_1\), \(\lambda_2\) with \(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\). Which of the following statement are true?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A particle moving in a closed orbit under a central force directed towards the origin conserves angular momentum \(\mathbf{L} = \mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{p}\), and its de Broglie wavelength \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\) is inversely proportional to its speed \(v\).

Step 2: Evaluation
In a circular orbit with the origin at the centre, the distance \(r\) and speed \(v\) are constant everywhere, so \(\lambda\) would remain constant rather than varying cyclically between \(\lambda_1\) and \(\lambda_2\). Thus, the orbit cannot be circular with the origin as centre, and instead can be an elliptical orbit with the origin as a focus.

Step 3: Application
At the nearest point (perihelion) and farthest point (aphelion) of an elliptical orbit, the velocity is perpendicular to the radius vector, so angular momentum magnitude is \(L = mvr = \text{constant}\). Hence \(v \propto \frac{1}{r}\), which implies \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv} \propto r\). Since \(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\), the smaller wavelength \(\lambda_2\) corresponds to the higher speed and therefore the smaller distance \(r\) from the origin.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the particle could be moving in an elliptic orbit with the origin as its focus, and when the de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_2\), the particle is nearer the origin than when its value is \(\lambda_1\).

answer.text: The particle could be moving in a circular orbit with origin as centre
The particle could be moving in an elliptic orbit with origin as its focus.
When the de Broglie wave length is \(\lambda_1\), the particle is nearer the origin than when its value is \(\lambda_2\).
When the de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_2\), the particle is nearer the origin than when its value is \(\lambda_1\).

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQI_Q111 - de Broglie wavelength of a falling particle

questiontext.text:
11.1 A particle is dropped from a height \(H\). The de Broglie wavelength of the particle as a function of height is proportional to

১১.১ একটি কণাকে \(H\) উচ্চতা থেকে ফেলা হলো। উচ্চতার অপেক্ষক হিসেবে কণাটির ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য সমানুপাতিক হবে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A particle of mass \(m\) is dropped from rest (\(u = 0\)) from a height \(H\) under uniform gravitational acceleration \(g\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Air resistance is neglected, and the motion is non-relativistic near the Earth's surface so \(g\) is constant.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The speed acquired after falling through height \(H\) is \(v = \sqrt{2gH}\). The de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{mv}\), where \(h\) is Planck's constant.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting \(v = \sqrt{2gH}\) into the de Broglie relation gives: \[\lambda = \frac{h}{m\sqrt{2gH}} = \left(\frac{h}{m\sqrt{2g}}\right) H^{-1/2}\] Since \(h\), \(m\), and \(g\) are constants for a given particle, \(\lambda \propto H^{-1/2}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
As \(H\) increases, the speed \(v\) increases, so momentum increases and wavelength decreases, which is consistent with \(H^{-1/2}\). Therefore, the de Broglie wavelength is proportional to \(H^{-1/2}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
\(m\) ভরের একটি কণাকে স্থির অবস্থা (\(u = 0\)) থেকে \(g\) সুষম অভিকর্ষজ ত্বরণের অধীনে \(H\) উচ্চতা থেকে ফেলা হলো।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
বায়ুর বাধা উপেক্ষা করা হয়েছে এবং পৃথিবীর পৃষ্ঠের নিকটে গতিটি অ-আপেক্ষিক হওয়ায় \(g\) ধ্রুবক।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\(H\) উচ্চতা অতিক্রম করার পর অর্জিত বেগ \(v = \sqrt{2gH}\)। ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{mv}\), যেখানে \(h\) হলো প্ল্যাঙ্কের ধ্রুবক।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
ডি ব্রগলি সম্পর্কে \(v = \sqrt{2gH}\) বসালে পাওয়া যায়: \[\lambda = \frac{h}{m\sqrt{2gH}} = \left(\frac{h}{m\sqrt{2g}}\right) H^{-1/2}\] যেহেতু একটি নির্দিষ্ট কণার জন্য \(h\), \(m\) এবং \(g\) ধ্রুবক, তাই \(\lambda \propto H^{-1/2}\)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(H\) বাড়লে বেগ \(v\) বাড়ে, ফলে ভরবেগ বাড়ে এবং তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য কমে, যা \(H^{-1/2}\)-এর সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ। সুতরাং, ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য \(H^{-1/2}\)-এর সমানুপাতিক।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQI_Q112 - Photon wavelength to eject bound proton

questiontext.text:
11.2 The wavelength of a photon needed to remove a proton from a nucleus which is bound to the nucleus with \(1\text{ MeV}\) energy is nearly

১১.২ নিউক্লিয়াসের সাথে \(1\text{ MeV}\) শক্তিতে আবদ্ধ একটি প্রোটনকে নিউক্লিয়াস থেকে অপসারণ করতে প্রয়োজনীয় ফোটনের তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য প্রায় কত?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Binding energy of the proton in the nucleus, \(E = 1\text{ MeV} = 10^{6}\text{ eV}\). Planck's constant \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\), speed of light \(c = 3 \times 10^{8}\text{ m/s}\), and \(1\text{ eV} = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}\text{ J}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
To just remove the proton, the minimum photon energy equals the binding energy \(E\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Photon energy is related to wavelength by \(E = \frac{hc}{\lambda}\), so \(\lambda = \frac{hc}{E}\). Using standard units, \(hc \approx 1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting \(E = 10^{6}\text{ eV}\): \[\lambda = \frac{1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}}{10^{6}\text{ eV}} = 1.24 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm} \approx 1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Nuclear energies of the order of \(\text{MeV}\) correspond to gamma-ray wavelengths in the picometre (\(10^{-3}\text{ nm}\)) range. Thus, the required wavelength is nearly \(1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
নিউক্লিয়াসে প্রোটনের বন্ধন শক্তি, \(E = 1\text{ MeV} = 10^{6}\text{ eV}\)। প্ল্যাঙ্কের ধ্রুবক \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\), আলোর বেগ \(c = 3 \times 10^{8}\text{ m/s}\), এবং \(1\text{ eV} = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}\text{ J}\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
প্রোটনটিকে সবেমাত্র অপসারণ করতে ন্যূনতম ফোটনের শক্তি বন্ধন শক্তি \(E\)-এর সমান হতে হবে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ফোটনের শক্তি ও তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যের সম্পর্ক হলো \(E = \frac{hc}{\lambda}\), অর্থাৎ \(\lambda = \frac{hc}{E}\)। প্রমাণ এককে, \(hc \approx 1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(E = 10^{6}\text{ eV}\) বসিয়ে পাই: \[\lambda = \frac{1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}}{10^{6}\text{ eV}} = 1.24 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm} \approx 1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(\text{MeV}\) ক্রমের নিউক্লীয় শক্তি পিকোমিটার (\(10^{-3}\text{ nm}\)) পাল্লার গামা-রশ্মির তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যের সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ। সুতরাং, প্রয়োজনীয় তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য প্রায় \(1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\)।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQI_Q113 - Electron beam incident on metal surface

questiontext.text:
11.3 Consider a beam of electrons (each electron with energy \(E_0\)) incident on a metal surface kept in an evacuated chamber. Then

১১.৩ একটি বায়ুশূন্য প্রকোষ্ঠে রাখা ধাতব পৃষ্ঠের উপর আপতিত ইলেকট্রন রশ্মি (প্রতিটি ইলেকট্রনের শক্তি \(E_0\)) বিবেচনা করো। সেক্ষেত্রে

generalfeedback.text:
Conceptual Principle
When an energetic beam of electrons strikes a metal surface in vacuum, electrons can undergo elastic scattering at the surface as well as inelastic collisions inside the metal, transferring part or all of their energy to other electrons (secondary emission).

Evaluation
An incident electron may suffer multiple collisions and lose varying amounts of energy before escaping, or it may collide elastically without losing energy. In an elastic collision with the surface, the reflected electron retains its full initial energy \(E_0\). If it transfers energy to a conduction electron inside the metal, the emitted electron can have any energy between \(0\) and \(E_0\) (actually up to \(E_0 - \phi\) for secondary electrons, while elastically scattered electrons have energy \(E_0\)).

Application
Because both inelastic energy-loss processes and elastic scattering occur, electrons emerge with a continuous distribution of energies ranging from zero up to a maximum of \(E_0\).

Final Conclusion
Therefore, electrons can be emitted with any energy, with a maximum of \(E_0\).

ধারণাগত নীতি
বায়ুশূন্য স্থানে রাখা কোনো ধাতব পৃষ্ঠে শক্তিশালী ইলেকট্রন রশ্মি আপতিত হলে ইলেকট্রনগুলো পৃষ্ঠে স্থিতিস্থাপক বিক্ষেপণের পাশাপাশি ধাতুর অভ্যন্তরে অস্থিতিস্থাপক সংঘর্ষের মাধ্যমে অন্য ইলেকট্রনে আংশিক বা সম্পূর্ণ শক্তি স্থানান্তর করতে পারে (গৌণ নিঃসরণ)।

মূল্যায়ন
একটি আপতিত ইলেকট্রন নির্গত হওয়ার আগে একাধিক সংঘর্ষের মাধ্যমে বিভিন্ন পরিমাণ শক্তি হারাতে পারে, অথবা শক্তি না হারিয়ে স্থিতিস্থাপক সংঘর্ষে লিপ্ত হতে পারে। পৃষ্ঠের সাথে স্থিতিস্থাপক সংঘর্ষে প্রতিফলিত ইলেকট্রন তার সম্পূর্ণ প্রাথমিক শক্তি \(E_0\) বজায় রাখে। যদি এটি ধাতুর ভেতরের পরিবাহী ইলেকট্রনে শক্তি স্থানান্তর করে, তবে নির্গত ইলেকট্রনের শক্তি \(0\) থেকে \(E_0\)-এর মধ্যে যেকোনো মানের হতে পারে।

প্রয়োগ
অস্থিতিস্থাপক শক্তি-ক্ষয় প্রক্রিয়া এবং স্থিতিস্থাপক বিক্ষেপণ উভয়ই ঘটে বলে নির্গত ইলেকট্রনগুলোর শক্তির বণ্টন শূন্য থেকে সর্বোচ্চ \(E_0\) পর্যন্ত যেকোনো মানের হতে পারে।

চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, ইলেকট্রনগুলো যেকোনো শক্তিতে নির্গত হতে পারে, যার সর্বোচ্চ মান \(E_0\)।

answer.text: no electrons will be emitted as only photons can emit electrons.
electrons can be emitted but all with an energy, \(E_0\).
electrons can be emitted with any energy, with a maximum of \(E_{0} - \phi\) (\(\phi\) is the work function).
electrons can be emitted with any energy, with a maximum of \(E_{0}\).

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQI_Q114 - Davisson Germer diffraction angle on increasing voltage

questiontext.text:
11.4 Consider Fig. 11.7 in the NCERT text book of physics for Class XII. Suppose the voltage applied to A is increased. The diffracted beam will have the maximum at a value of \(\theta\) that

১১.৪ দ্বাদশ শ্রেণির এনসিইআরটি (NCERT) পদার্থবিজ্ঞান পাঠ্যবইয়ের চিত্র ১১.৭ বিবেচনা করো। মনে করো A-তে প্রযুক্ত বিভব বৃদ্ধি করা হলো। অপবর্তিত রশ্মির চরম মান পাওয়া যাবে \(\theta\)-এর এমন এক মানে যা

generalfeedback.text:
Conceptual Principle
In the Davisson–Germer experiment (Fig. 11.7 of NCERT Class XII Physics), electrons are accelerated by an accelerating voltage \(V\) and diffracted by a nickel crystal. The de Broglie wavelength of the accelerated electrons is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2meV}}\).

Evaluation
When the voltage \(V\) applied to the anode A is increased, the kinetic energy and momentum of the electrons increase, so their de Broglie wavelength \(\lambda\) decreases (\(\lambda \propto V^{-1/2}\)).

Application
According to the diffraction condition for a crystal lattice of spacing \(d\) (e.g., \(d\sin\theta = n\lambda\) or \(2d\sin\phi = n\lambda\)), the diffraction angle \(\theta\) decreases as the wavelength \(\lambda\) decreases.

Final Conclusion
Therefore, the diffracted beam will have the maximum at a value of \(\theta\) that will be less than the earlier value.

ধারণাগত নীতি
ডেভিসন–জার্মার পরীক্ষায় (দ্বাদশ শ্রেণির এনসিইআরটি পদার্থবিজ্ঞান বইয়ের চিত্র ১১.৭), ইলেকট্রনগুলোকে \(V\) ত্বরক বিভব দ্বারা ত্বরান্বিত করে একটি নিকেল কেলাস দ্বারা অপবর্তিত করা হয়। ত্বরান্বিত ইলেকট্রনের ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য হলো \(\lambda = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2meV}}\)।

মূল্যায়ন
অ্যানোড A-তে প্রযুক্ত বিভব \(V\) বৃদ্ধি করলে ইলেকট্রনের গতিশক্তি ও ভরবেগ বৃদ্ধি পায়, ফলে তাদের ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য \(\lambda\) হ্রাস পায় (\(\lambda \propto V^{-1/2}\))।

প্রয়োগ
\(d\) ব্যবধানবিশিষ্ট কেলাস জালকের অপবর্তনের শর্ত অনুসারে (যেমন \(d\sin\theta = n\lambda\) বা \(2d\sin\phi = n\lambda\)), তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য \(\lambda\) কমলে অপবর্তন কোণ \(\theta\)-এর মানও কমে যায়।

চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, অপবর্তিত রশ্মির চরম মান \(\theta\)-এর পূর্বের মানের চেয়ে কম মানে পাওয়া যাবে।

answer.text: will be larger than the earlier value.
will be the same as the earlier value.
will be less than the earlier value.

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQI_Q115 - Comparison of de Broglie wavelengths for same energy

questiontext.text:
11.5 A proton, a neutron, an electron and an \(\alpha\)-particle have same energy. Then their de Broglie wavelengths compare as

১১.৫ একটি প্রোটন, একটি নিউট্রন, একটি ইলেকট্রন এবং একটি \(\alpha\)-কণার শক্তি সমান। তবে তাদের ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যের তুলনামূলক সম্পর্ক হবে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A proton, a neutron, an electron, and an \(\alpha\)-particle all have the same kinetic energy \(E\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The masses are ordered as \(m_{\alpha} > m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}} > m_{\mathrm{e}}\), and non-relativistic mechanics is assumed.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The de Broglie wavelength in terms of kinetic energy \(E\) and mass \(m\) is: \[\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2mE}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(h\) and \(E\) are the same for all four particles, \(\lambda \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{m}}\). Because \(m_{\alpha} > m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}} > m_{\mathrm{e}}\), the inverse relation gives: \[\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The heaviest particle (\(\alpha\)-particle) has the shortest wavelength, while the lightest particle (electron) has the longest wavelength. Hence, \(\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
একটি প্রোটন, একটি নিউট্রন, একটি ইলেকট্রন এবং একটি \(\alpha\)-কণার প্রত্যেকের গতিশক্তি \(E\) সমান।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
কণাগুলোর ভরের ক্রম হলো \(m_{\alpha} > m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}} > m_{\mathrm{e}}\), এবং অ-আপেক্ষিক গতিবিদ্যা ধরা হয়েছে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
গতিশক্তি \(E\) এবং ভর \(m\)-এর সাপেক্ষে ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য হলো: \[\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2mE}}\]

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
যেহেতু চারটি কণার ক্ষেত্রেই \(h\) এবং \(E\) একই, তাই \(\lambda \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{m}}\)। যেহেতু \(m_{\alpha} > m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}} > m_{\mathrm{e}}\), ব্যস্তানুপাতিক সম্পর্ক থেকে পাই: \[\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
সবচেয়ে ভারী কণার (\(\alpha\)-কণা) তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য সবচেয়ে কম এবং সবচেয়ে হালকা কণার (ইলেকট্রন) তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য সবচেয়ে বেশি। অতএব, \(\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\)।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQI_Q116 - Electron de Broglie wavelength in magnetic field

questiontext.text:
11.6 An electron is moving with an initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) and is in a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0\mathbf{j}\). Then it's de Broglie wavelength

১১.৬ একটি ইলেকট্রন \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) প্রাথমিক বেগে \(\mathbf{B} = B_0\mathbf{j}\) চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্রে গতিশীল। তবে এর ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Initial velocity of the electron \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) and uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0\mathbf{j}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Only the magnetic Lorentz force acts on the electron of charge \(-e\) and mass \(m\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnetic force is \(\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B}) = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\), which is always perpendicular to the velocity \(\mathbf{v}\). The de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\), where \(v = |\mathbf{v}|\) is the speed.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(\mathbf{F} \perp \mathbf{v}\), the work done by the magnetic force is zero (\(dW = \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = 0\)). By the work–energy theorem, the kinetic energy and hence the speed \(v = v_0\) remain constant, even though the direction of velocity changes continuously. Therefore, the magnitude of momentum \(p = mv_0\) stays constant, and \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv_0}\) does not change with time.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Because a magnetic field only deflects a charged particle without changing its speed, the de Broglie wavelength remains constant.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
ইলেকট্রনের প্রাথমিক বেগ \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) এবং সুষম চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{B} = B_0\mathbf{j}\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
\(-e\) আধান ও \(m\) ভরের ইলেকট্রনটির উপর কেবল চৌম্বক লরেঞ্জ বল ক্রিয়া করছে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
চৌম্বক বল \(\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B}) = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\), যা সর্বদা বেগ \(\mathbf{v}\)-এর সাথে লম্ব। ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\), যেখানে \(v = |\mathbf{v}|\) হলো দ্রুতি।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
যেহেতু \(\mathbf{F} \perp \mathbf{v}\), চৌম্বক বল দ্বারা কৃতকার্য শূন্য (\(dW = \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = 0\))। কার্য–শক্তি উপপাদ্য অনুসারে, বেগের দিক ক্রমাগত পরিবর্তিত হলেও গতিশক্তি এবং দ্রুতি \(v = v_0\) ধ্রুবক থাকে। ফলে ভরবেগের মান \(p = mv_0\) অপরিবর্তিত থাকে এবং \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv_0}\) সময়ের সাথে পরিবর্তিত হয় না।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
চৌম্বক ক্ষেত্র আধানযুক্ত কণার দ্রুতির পরিবর্তন না ঘটিয়ে কেবল গতির দিক পরিবর্তন করে বলে ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য ধ্রুবক থাকে।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQI_Q117 - Electron de Broglie wavelength in antiparallel electric field

questiontext.text:
11.7 An electron (mass \(m\)) with an initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)) is in an electric field \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 = \text{constant} > 0\)). It's de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is given by

১১.৭ \(m\) ভরের একটি ইলেকট্রন \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)) প্রাথমিক বেগে \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 = \text{ধ্রুবক} > 0\)) তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্রে রয়েছে। \(t\) সময়ে এর ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য হবে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An electron of mass \(m\) and charge \(-e\) has initial velocity \(\mathbf{v}_i = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)) at \(t = 0\) and moves in a uniform electric field \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 > 0\)). Its initial de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Motion is one-dimensional along the \(x\)-axis (unit vector \(\mathbf{i}\)) and non-relativistic.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Electrostatic force: \(\mathbf{F} = q\mathbf{E} = (-e)(-E_0\mathbf{i}) = eE_0\mathbf{i}\). Acceleration: \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{\mathbf{F}}{m} = \frac{eE_0}{m}\mathbf{i}\). Velocity at time \(t\): \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{v}_i + \mathbf{a}t\), and \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv(t)}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The velocity at time \(t\) is: \[\mathbf{v}(t) = \left(v_0 + \frac{eE_0}{m}t\right)\mathbf{i} = v_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)\mathbf{i}\] Substituting into the de Broglie wavelength formula: \[\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At \(t = 0\), \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\); as \(t\) increases, the electron accelerates in the \(+\mathbf{i}\) direction, so its speed increases and \(\lambda(t)\) decreases. Thus, the de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is \(\frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
\(m\) ভর ও \(-e\) আধানবিশিষ্ট একটি ইলেকট্রন \(t = 0\) সময়ে \(\mathbf{v}_i = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)) প্রাথমিক বেগে \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 > 0\)) সুষম তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্রে গতিশীল। এর প্রাথমিক ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
গতিটি \(x\)-অক্ষ বরাবর (একক ভেক্টর \(\mathbf{i}\)) একমাত্রিক এবং অ-আপেক্ষিক।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
স্থিরতড়িৎ বল: \(\mathbf{F} = q\mathbf{E} = (-e)(-E_0\mathbf{i}) = eE_0\mathbf{i}\)। ত্বরণ: \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{\mathbf{F}}{m} = \frac{eE_0}{m}\mathbf{i}\)। \(t\) সময়ে বেগ: \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{v}_i + \mathbf{a}t\), এবং \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv(t)}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(t\) সময়ে বেগ হলো: \[\mathbf{v}(t) = \left(v_0 + \frac{eE_0}{m}t\right)\mathbf{i} = v_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)\mathbf{i}\] ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যের সূত্রে বসিয়ে পাই: \[\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(t = 0\) সময়ে \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\); \(t\) বাড়ার সাথে সাথে ইলেকট্রনটি \(+\mathbf{i}\) দিকে ত্বরান্বিত হয়, ফলে এর দ্রুতি বাড়ে এবং \(\lambda(t)\) কমে। সুতরাং, \(t\) সময়ে ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য হলো \(\frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\)।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQI_Q118 - Electron de Broglie wavelength in perpendicular electric field

questiontext.text:
11.8 An electron (mass \(m\)) with an initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0 \hat{\mathbf{i}}\) is in an electric field \(\mathbf{E} = E_0 \hat{\mathbf{j}}\). If \(\lambda_0 = h/mv_0\), it's de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is given by

১১.৮ \(m\) ভরের একটি ইলেকট্রন \(\mathbf{v} = v_0 \hat{\mathbf{i}}\) প্রাথমিক বেগে \(\mathbf{E} = E_0 \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্রে রয়েছে। যদি \(\lambda_0 = h/mv_0\) হয়, তবে \(t\) সময়ে এর ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য হবে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An electron of mass \(m\) and charge \(-e\) has initial velocity \(\mathbf{v}_i = v_0 \hat{\mathbf{i}}\) at \(t = 0\), in an electric field \(\mathbf{E} = E_0 \hat{\mathbf{j}}\), with \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Motion takes place in the \(x\)–\(y\) plane under a constant electrostatic force, treated non-relativistically.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The force is \(\mathbf{F} = -eE_0\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), giving acceleration \(\mathbf{a} = -\frac{eE_0}{m}\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). The speed at time \(t\) is \(v = \sqrt{v_x^2 + v_y^2}\), and \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since there is no force along \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\), \(v_x = v_0\). Along \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), \(v_y = -\frac{eE_0}{m}t\). The magnitude of velocity at time \(t\) is: \[v = \sqrt{v_0^2 + \left(-\frac{eE_0 t}{m}\right)^2} = v_0 \sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}\] Substituting into \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv}\): \[\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0 \sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At \(t = 0\), \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\), and as \(t\) increases, the speed increases so \(\lambda(t)\) decreases. Therefore, the de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is \(\frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
\(m\) ভর ও \(-e\) আধানবিশিষ্ট একটি ইলেকট্রনের \(t = 0\) সময়ে প্রাথমিক বেগ \(\mathbf{v}_i = v_0 \hat{\mathbf{i}}\), তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্র \(\mathbf{E} = E_0 \hat{\mathbf{j}}\), এবং \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
গতিটি ধ্রুব স্থিরতড়িৎ বলের প্রভাবে \(x\)–\(y\) তলে ঘটছে এবং এটি অ-আপেক্ষিক।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
বল \(\mathbf{F} = -eE_0\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), ফলে ত্বরণ \(\mathbf{a} = -\frac{eE_0}{m}\hat{\mathbf{j}}\)। \(t\) সময়ে দ্রুতি \(v = \sqrt{v_x^2 + v_y^2}\), এবং \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) বরাবর কোনো বল না থাকায় \(v_x = v_0\)। \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) বরাবর, \(v_y = -\frac{eE_0}{m}t\)। \(t\) সময়ে বেগের মান: \[v = \sqrt{v_0^2 + \left(-\frac{eE_0 t}{m}\right)^2} = v_0 \sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}\] \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv}\) সূত্রে বসিয়ে পাই: \[\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0 \sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(t = 0\) সময়ে \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\), এবং \(t\) বাড়লে দ্রুতি বাড়ে বলে \(\lambda(t)\) কমে। সুতরাং, \(t\) সময়ে ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য হলো \(\frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\)।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQII_Q119 - Relativistic corrections for electron de Broglie wavelength

questiontext.text:
11.9 Relativistic corrections become necessary when the expression for the kinetic energy \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2\), becomes comparable with \(mc^2\), where \(m\) is the mass of the particle. At what de Broglie wavelength will relativistic corrections become important for an electron?

১১.৯ যখন কোনো কণার গতিশক্তির রাশিমালা \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2\) এর মান \(mc^2\)-এর সাথে তুলনীয় হয়ে ওঠে (যেখানে \(m\) হলো কণাটির ভর), তখন আপেক্ষিকতাবাদী সংশোধনের প্রয়োজন হয়। একটি ইলেকট্রনের ক্ষেত্রে কোন ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যে আপেক্ষিকতাবাদী সংশোধন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হয়ে উঠবে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
For an electron, mass \(m = 9.11 \times 10^{-31}\text{ kg}\), Planck's constant \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\), and speed of light \(c = 3 \times 10^{8}\text{ m/s}\). Relativistic corrections are needed when \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2 \sim mc^2\), i.e., \(v \sim c\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
We use the de Broglie relation \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\) to estimate the speed \(v\) corresponding to each wavelength and compare it with \(c\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\[v = \frac{h}{m\lambda}\] The Compton wavelength of an electron is \(\lambda_C = \frac{h}{mc} \approx 2.42 \times 10^{-12}\text{ m} = 2.42 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Computing \(v = \frac{h}{m\lambda}\) for each wavelength: 1. For \(\lambda = 10\text{ nm} = 10^{-8}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx \frac{6.626 \times 10^{-34}}{9.11 \times 10^{-31} \times 10^{-8}} \approx 7.3 \times 10^{4}\text{ m/s} \ll c\) (non-relativistic). 2. For \(\lambda = 10^{-3}\text{ nm} = 10^{-12}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{8}\text{ m/s} > c\) (relativistic). 3. For \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm} = 10^{-13}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{9}\text{ m/s} \gg c\) (relativistic). 4. For \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm} = 10^{-15}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{11}\text{ m/s} \gg c\) (relativistic).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Whenever \(\lambda \lesssim 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\), the non-relativistic speed estimate approaches or exceeds \(c\), so relativistic corrections are essential. Hence, relativistic corrections become important at \(\lambda = 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\), \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm}\), and \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
ইলেকট্রনের ভর \(m = 9.11 \times 10^{-31}\text{ kg}\), প্ল্যাঙ্কের ধ্রুবক \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\), এবং আলোর বেগ \(c = 3 \times 10^{8}\text{ m/s}\)। যখন \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2 \sim mc^2\) হয়, অর্থাৎ \(v \sim c\) হয়, তখন আপেক্ষিকতাবাদী সংশোধনের প্রয়োজন হয়।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
প্রতিটি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যের জন্য বেগ \(v\) নির্ণয় করতে ডি ব্রগলি সম্পর্ক \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\) ব্যবহার করে তাকে \(c\)-এর সাথে তুলনা করা হলো।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\[v = \frac{h}{m\lambda}\] ইলেকট্রনের কম্পটন তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য \(\lambda_C = \frac{h}{mc} \approx 2.42 \times 10^{-12}\text{ m} = 2.42 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
প্রতিটি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যের জন্য \(v = \frac{h}{m\lambda}\) হিসাব করে পাই: ১. \(\lambda = 10\text{ nm} = 10^{-8}\text{ m}\)-এর জন্য: \(v \approx \frac{6.626 \times 10^{-34}}{9.11 \times 10^{-31} \times 10^{-8}} \approx 7.3 \times 10^{4}\text{ m/s} \ll c\) (অ-আপেক্ষিক)। ২. \(\lambda = 10^{-3}\text{ nm} = 10^{-12}\text{ m}\)-এর জন্য: \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{8}\text{ m/s} > c\) (আপেক্ষিক)। ৩. \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm} = 10^{-13}\text{ m}\)-এর জন্য: \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{9}\text{ m/s} \gg c\) (আপেক্ষিক)। ৪. \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm} = 10^{-15}\text{ m}\)-এর জন্য: \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{11}\text{ m/s} \gg c\) (আপেক্ষিক)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
যখনই \(\lambda \lesssim 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\) হয়, অ-আপেক্ষিক দ্রুতির মান \(c\)-এর কাছাকাছি বা তার চেয়ে বেশি হয়ে যায়, ফলে আপেক্ষিকতাবাদী সংশোধন অপরিহার্য হয়ে ওঠে। অতএব, \(\lambda = 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\), \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm}\), এবং \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm}\) তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যগুলোতে আপেক্ষিকতাবাদী সংশোধন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হবে।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQII_Q1110 - Two particles of different masses with same wavelength

questiontext.text:
11.10 Two particles \(A_1\), and \(A_2\) of masses \(m_1, m_2\) (\(m_1 > m_2\)) have the same de Broglie wavelength. Then

১১.১০ \(m_1, m_2\) (\(m_1 > m_2\)) ভরের দুটি কণা \(A_1\) ও \(A_2\)-এর ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য সমান। সেক্ষেত্রে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two particles \(A_1\) and \(A_2\) have masses \(m_1\) and \(m_2\) with \(m_1 > m_2\), and equal de Broglie wavelengths: \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = \lambda\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Non-relativistic kinetic energy \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m}\) is used.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Momentum \(p = \frac{h}{\lambda}\) and kinetic energy \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m} = \frac{h^2}{2m\lambda^2}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Since \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2\), their momenta are \(p_1 = \frac{h}{\lambda_1} = \frac{h}{\lambda_2} = p_2\). Thus, their momenta are the same. 2. Since \(p_1 = p_2 = p\), their kinetic energies are \(E_1 = \frac{p^2}{2m_1}\) and \(E_2 = \frac{p^2}{2m_2}\). Because \(m_1 > m_2\), it follows that \(\frac{1}{m_1} < \frac{1}{m_2}\), so \(E_1 < E_2\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, both statements hold: their momenta are the same, and the energy of \(A_1\) is less than the energy of \(A_2\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
দুটি কণা \(A_1\) ও \(A_2\)-এর ভর যথাক্রমে \(m_1\) ও \(m_2\) যেখানে \(m_1 > m_2\), এবং তাদের ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য সমান: \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = \lambda\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
অ-আপেক্ষিক গতিশক্তি \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m}\) ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ভরবেগ \(p = \frac{h}{\lambda}\) এবং গতিশক্তি \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m} = \frac{h^2}{2m\lambda^2}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
১. যেহেতু \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2\), তাদের ভরবেগ \(p_1 = \frac{h}{\lambda_1} = \frac{h}{\lambda_2} = p_2\)। অর্থাৎ তাদের ভরবেগ সমান। ২. যেহেতু \(p_1 = p_2 = p\), তাদের গতিশক্তি \(E_1 = \frac{p^2}{2m_1}\) এবং \(E_2 = \frac{p^2}{2m_2}\)। যেহেতু \(m_1 > m_2\), তাই \(\frac{1}{m_1} < \frac{1}{m_2}\), অর্থাৎ \(E_1 < E_2\)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
সুতরাং, দুটি তথ্যই সত্য: তাদের ভরবেগ সমান, এবং \(A_1\)-এর শক্তি \(A_2\)-এর শক্তির চেয়ে কম।

answer.text: energy of \(A_1\) is less than the energy of \(A_2\).
energy of \(A_1\) is more than the energy of \(A_2\).

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQII_Q1111 - Photon and electron de Broglie wavelength ratio

questiontext.text:
11.11 The de Broglie wavelength of a photon is twice the de Broglie wavelength of an electron. The speed of the electron is \(v_e = \frac{c}{100}\). Then

১১.১১ একটি ফোটনের ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য একটি ইলেকট্রনের ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যের দ্বিগুণ। ইলেকট্রনটির দ্রুতি \(v_e = \frac{c}{100}\)। তবে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e\), where \(\lambda_p\) is the photon wavelength and \(\lambda_e\) is the electron de Broglie wavelength. Speed of the electron is \(v_e = \frac{c}{100} = 10^{-2}c\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Since \(v_e \ll c\), the non-relativistic expressions \(p_e = m_e v_e\) and \(E_e = \frac{1}{2} m_e v_e^2\) apply to the electron.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For the electron: \(\lambda_e = \frac{h}{p_e}\), \(p_e = m_e v_e\), \(E_e = \frac{1}{2} m_e v_e^2\). For the photon: \(E_p = \frac{hc}{\lambda_p}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Dividing \(p_e = m_e v_e\) by \(m_e c\): \[\frac{p_e}{m_e c} = \frac{v_e}{c} = \frac{1}{100} = 10^{-2}\] 2. Using \(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e = \frac{2h}{p_e}\), the photon energy is: \[E_p = \frac{hc}{\lambda_p} = \frac{hc}{2h/p_e} = \frac{1}{2} p_e c = \frac{1}{2} m_e v_e c\] Taking the ratio of energies: \[\frac{E_e}{E_p} = \frac{\frac{1}{2} m_e v_e^2}{\frac{1}{2} m_e v_e c} = \frac{v_e}{c} = 10^{-2}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both dimensionless ratios \(\frac{E_e}{E_p}\) and \(\frac{p_e}{m_e c}\) equal \(10^{-2}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
\(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e\), যেখানে \(\lambda_p\) হলো ফোটনের তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য এবং \(\lambda_e\) হলো ইলেকট্রনের ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য। ইলেকট্রনের দ্রুতি \(v_e = \frac{c}{100} = 10^{-2}c\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
যেহেতু \(v_e \ll c\), ইলেকট্রনের জন্য অ-আপেক্ষিক রাশিমালা \(p_e = m_e v_e\) এবং \(E_e = \frac{1}{2} m_e v_e^2\) প্রযোজ্য।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ইলেকট্রনের জন্য: \(\lambda_e = \frac{h}{p_e}\), \(p_e = m_e v_e\), \(E_e = \frac{1}{2} m_e v_e^2\)। ফোটনের জন্য: \(E_p = \frac{hc}{\lambda_p}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
১. \(p_e = m_e v_e\)-কে \(m_e c\) দিয়ে ভাগ করে পাই: \[\frac{p_e}{m_e c} = \frac{v_e}{c} = \frac{1}{100} = 10^{-2}\] ২. \(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e = \frac{2h}{p_e}\) ব্যবহার করে ফোটনের শক্তি: \[E_p = \frac{hc}{\lambda_p} = \frac{hc}{2h/p_e} = \frac{1}{2} p_e c = \frac{1}{2} m_e v_e c\] শক্তির অনুপাত নিয়ে পাই: \[\frac{E_e}{E_p} = \frac{\frac{1}{2} m_e v_e^2}{\frac{1}{2} m_e v_e c} = \frac{v_e}{c} = 10^{-2}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
উভয় মাত্রাহীন অনুপাত \(\frac{E_e}{E_p}\) এবং \(\frac{p_e}{m_e c}\)-এর মান \(10^{-2}\)।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQII_Q1112 - Melting ice by photon absorption

questiontext.text:
11.12 Photons absorbed in matter are converted to heat. A source emitting \(n\) photon/sec of frequency \(\nu\) is used to convert \(1\text{ kg}\) of ice at \(0^\circ\text{C}\) to water at \(0^\circ\text{C}\). Then, the time \(T\) taken for the conversion

১১.১২ পদার্থে শোষিত ফোটন তাপে রূপান্তরিত হয়। \(\nu\) কম্পাঙ্কের প্রতি সেকেন্ডে \(n\) সংখ্যক ফোটন নিঃসরণকারী একটি উৎস ব্যবহার করে \(0^\circ\text{C}\) উষ্ণতার \(1\text{ kg}\) বরফকে \(0^\circ\text{C}\) উষ্ণতার জলে পরিণত করা হচ্ছে। তবে এই রূপান্তরে গৃহীত সময় \(T\)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A source emits \(n\) photons per second, each of frequency \( u\). Mass of ice \(m = 1 ext{ kg}\) at \(0^\circ ext{C}\) is melted to water at \(0^\circ ext{C}\) in time \(T\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
All emitted photons are absorbed and completely converted into latent heat \(Q = mL\), where \(L\) is the specific latent heat of fusion of ice.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Energy of each photon is \(h u\), so total power delivered is \(P = n h u\). Total energy supplied in time \(T\) is \(P T = n h u T = mL\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Solving for \(T\): \[T = rac{mL}{nh u}\] Since \(m\), \(L\), and \(h\) are constants, \(T \propto rac{1}{n u}\): - With \( u\) fixed, increasing \(n\) decreases \(T\). - With \(n\) fixed, increasing \( u\) decreases \(T\). - If \(n\) and \( u\) vary such that \(n u = ext{constant}\), \(T\) remains constant. - When \(n u\) increases, \(T\) decreases (not increases).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, \(T\) decreases with increasing \(n\) (for fixed \( u\)), decreases with increasing \( u\) (for fixed \(n\)), and remains constant when \(n u\) is kept constant.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
