একটি উৎস প্রতি সেকেন্ডে \( u\) কম্পাঙ্কের \(n\) সংখ্যক ফোটন নিঃসরণ করে। \(0^\circ ext{C}\) উষ্ণতার \(m = 1 ext{ kg}\) বরফকে \(0^\circ ext{C}\) উষ্ণতার জলে পরিণত করতে \(T\) সময় লাগে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমিত শর্ত ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
নিঃসৃত সমস্ত ফোটন শোষিত হয়ে সম্পূর্ণরূপে গলনের লীন তাপ \(Q = mL\)-এ রূপান্তরিত হয়, যেখানে \(L\) হলো বরফ গলনের আপেক্ষিক লীন তাপ।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
প্রতিটি ফোটনের শক্তি \(h u\), তাই প্রদত্ত মোট ক্ষমতা \(P = n h u\)। \(T\) সময়ে সরবরাহকৃত মোট শক্তি \(P T = n h u T = mL\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(T\)-এর জন্য সমাধান করে পাই: \[T = rac{mL}{nh u}\] যেহেতু \(m\), \(L\), এবং \(h\) ধ্রুবক, তাই \(T \propto rac{1}{n u}\): - \( u\) স্থির রেখে \(n\) বাড়ালে \(T\) কমে। - \(n\) স্থির রেখে \( u\) বাড়ালে \(T\) কমে। - \(n u = ext{ধ্রুবক}\) রেখে \(n\) ও \( u\) পরিবর্তিত হলে \(T\) অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। - \(n u\)-এর গুণফল বাড়লে \(T\) কমে (বাড়ে না)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
সুতরাং, \( u\) স্থির রেখে \(n\) বাড়ালে \(T\) কমে, \(n\) স্থির রেখে \( u\) বাড়ালে \(T\) কমে, এবং \(n u = ext{ধ্রুবক}\) থাকলে \(T\) অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

answer.text: remains constant with \(n\) and \(\nu\) changing such that \(n\nu = \text{constant}\).

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_DUALNATUREOFRADIATIONANDMATTER_MCQII_Q1113 - Particle in closed central-force orbit de Broglie wavelength

questiontext.text:
11.13 A particle moves in a closed orbit around the origin, due to a force which is directed towards the origin. The de Broglie wavelength of the particle varies cyclically between two values \(\lambda_1, \lambda_2\) with \(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\). Which of the following statement are true?

১১.১৩ মূলবিন্দু অভিমুখী একটি বলের প্রভাবে একটি কণা মূলবিন্দুর চারপাশে একটি বদ্ধ কক্ষপথে আবর্তন করছে। কণাটির ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য পর্যায়ক্রমে \(\lambda_1\) ও \(\lambda_2\) (\(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\)) মান দুটির মধ্যে পরিবর্তিত হয়। নিচের কোন বিবৃতিগুলো সত্য?

generalfeedback.text:
Conceptual Principle
A force directed towards the origin is a central force, so the angular momentum \(\mathbf{L} = \mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{p}\) of the particle about the origin is conserved. The de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\).

Evaluation
1. In a circular orbit centred at the origin, the distance \(r\) and speed \(v\) remain constant, so \(\lambda\) would remain constant rather than varying cyclically between \(\lambda_1\) and \(\lambda_2\). 2. In an elliptical orbit with the origin at one focus, the distance \(r\) varies cyclically between perihelion (closest approach) and aphelion (farthest point), causing speed \(v\) and hence \(\lambda\) to vary cyclically between two extreme values. 3. By conservation of angular momentum (\(mvr = \text{constant}\) at apsides), speed \(v\) is greater when \(r\) is smaller (nearer the origin) and smaller when \(r\) is larger. Since \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\), a larger speed corresponds to a smaller de Broglie wavelength. Because \(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\), the particle has greater speed and is nearer the origin when its wavelength is \(\lambda_2\) than when its wavelength is \(\lambda_1\).

Final Conclusion
Thus, the particle could be moving in an elliptic orbit with the origin as its focus, and when the de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_2\), the particle is nearer the origin than when its value is \(\lambda_1\).

ধারণাগত নীতি
মূলবিন্দু অভিমুখী বল একটি কেন্দ্রীয় বল, তাই মূলবিন্দুর সাপেক্ষে কণাটির কৌণিক ভরবেগ \(\mathbf{L} = \mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{p}\) সংরক্ষিত থাকে। ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য হলো \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\)।

মূল্যায়ন
১. মূলবিন্দুকে কেন্দ্র করে বৃত্তাকার কক্ষপথে দূরত্ব \(r\) ও দ্রুতি \(v\) ধ্রুবক থাকে, ফলে \(\lambda_1\) ও \(\lambda_2\)-এর মধ্যে পর্যায়ক্রমে পরিবর্তিত না হয়ে \(\lambda\) ধ্রুবক থাকত। ২. মূলবিন্দুকে একটি ফোকাস (নাভি) ধরে উপবৃত্তাকার কক্ষপথে ঘোরার সময় দূরত্ব \(r\) নিকটতম ও দূরতম অবস্থানের মধ্যে পর্যায়ক্রমে পরিবর্তিত হয়, যার ফলে দ্রুতি \(v\) এবং \(\lambda\) দুটি চরম মানের মধ্যে পর্যায়ক্রমে পরিবর্তিত হয়। ৩. কৌণিক ভরবেগের সংরক্ষণ সূত্র অনুযায়ী (শীর্ষ বিন্দুগুলোতে \(mvr = \text{ধ্রুবক}\)), কণাটি মূলবিন্দুর কাছে থাকলে (\(r\) কম হলে) দ্রুতি \(v\) বেশি হয় এবং দূরে থাকলে দ্রুতি কম হয়। যেহেতু \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\), বেশি দ্রুতি মানে কম ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য। যেহেতু \(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\), তাই তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য \(\lambda_2\) হলে কণাটি \(\lambda_1\) অবস্থার তুলনায় মূলবিন্দুর বেশি কাছে অবস্থান করে।

চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, কণাটি মূলবিন্দুকে ফোকাস হিসেবে রেখে একটি উপবৃত্তাকার কক্ষপথে ঘুরতে পারে, এবং যখন ডি ব্রগলি তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য \(\lambda_2\) হয়, তখন কণাটি \(\lambda_1\) অবস্থার চেয়ে মূলবিন্দুর অধিক নিকটে থাকে।

answer.text: The particle could be moving in a circular orbit with origin as centre
The particle could be moving in an elliptic orbit with origin as its focus.
When the de Broglie wave length is \(\lambda_1\), the particle is nearer the origin than when its value is \(\lambda_2\).
When the de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_2\), the particle is nearer the origin than when its value is \(\lambda_1\).

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQI_Q11_1 - de Broglie wavelength of a falling particle

questiontext.text:
A particle is dropped from a height \(H\). The de Broglie wavelength of the particle as a function of height is proportional to

किसी कण को \(H\) ऊँचाई से गिराया जाता है। ऊँचाई के फलन के रूप में कण की दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य किसके समानुपाती होती है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A particle of mass \(m\) is dropped from rest (initial velocity \(u = 0\)) from a height \(H\) under uniform gravitational acceleration \(g\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Air resistance is neglected, and the motion is non-relativistic. Downward direction is taken as positive.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
From kinematics, the speed \(v\) after falling through a height \(H\) is \(v = \sqrt{2gH}\). According to the de Broglie relation, the wavelength is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{mv}\), where \(h\) is Planck's constant.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting \(v = \sqrt{2gH}\) into the de Broglie wavelength formula gives:
\(\lambda = \frac{h}{m\sqrt{2gH}} = \frac{h}{m\sqrt{2g}} H^{-1/2}\)
Since \(h\), \(m\), and \(g\) are constants for the given particle, \(\lambda \propto H^{-1/2}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
As the height \(H\) increases, the speed at the bottom increases, so the momentum increases and the de Broglie wavelength decreases. Thus, the de Broglie wavelength is proportional to \(H^{-1/2}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
\(m\) द्रव्यमान के एक कण को एकसमान गुरुत्वीय त्वरण \(g\) के अंतर्गत \(H\) ऊँचाई से विरामावस्था (प्रारंभिक वेग \(u = 0\)) से गिराया जाता है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
वायु के प्रतिरोध को नगण्य माना गया है और गति अन-आपेक्षिकीय है। नीचे की दिशा को धनात्मक माना गया है।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
शुद्धगतिकी से, \(H\) ऊँचाई तक गिरने के बाद चाल \(v = \sqrt{2gH}\) होती है। दे ब्रॉग्ली संबंध के अनुसार, तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{mv}\) होती है, जहाँ \(h\) प्लांक स्थिरांक है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य के सूत्र में \(v = \sqrt{2gH}\) प्रतिस्थापित करने पर:
\(\lambda = \frac{h}{m\sqrt{2gH}} = \frac{h}{m\sqrt{2g}} H^{-1/2}\)
चूँकि दिए गए कण के लिए \(h\), \(m\), और \(g\) नियतांक हैं, इसलिए \(\lambda \propto H^{-1/2}\)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
जैसे-जैसे ऊँचाई \(H\) बढ़ती है, नीचे पहुँचने पर चाल बढ़ती है, जिससे संवेग बढ़ता है और दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य घटती है। अतः दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(H^{-1/2}\) के समानुपाती होती है।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQI_Q11_2 - Photon wavelength to remove a bound proton

questiontext.text:
The wavelength of a photon needed to remove a proton from a nucleus which is bound to the nucleus with \(1\text{ MeV}\) energy is nearly

किसी नाभिक से \(1\text{ MeV}\) ऊर्जा से बँधे हुए प्रोटॉन को बाहर निकालने के लिए आवश्यक फोटॉन की तरंगदैर्ध्य लगभग कितनी होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Binding energy of the proton to the nucleus, \(E = 1\text{ MeV} = 10^6\text{ eV}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The entire energy of the incident photon is used to overcome the binding energy of the proton. Standard constants: \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\), \(c = 3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\), and \(1\text{ eV} = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}\text{ J}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The energy of a photon of wavelength \(\lambda\) is given by \(E = \frac{hc}{\lambda}\), so \(\lambda = \frac{hc}{E}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Using \(hc \approx 1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}\):
\(\lambda = \frac{1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}}{10^6\text{ eV}} = 1.24 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm} \approx 1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Checking with SI units: \(E = 10^6 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19} = 1.6 \times 10^{-13}\text{ J}\), so \(\lambda = \frac{6.626 \times 10^{-34} \times 3 \times 10^8}{1.6 \times 10^{-13}} \approx 1.24 \times 10^{-12}\text{ m} = 1.24 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\). Thus, the required wavelength is nearly \(1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
नाभिक से प्रोटॉन की बंधन ऊर्जा, \(E = 1\text{ MeV} = 10^6\text{ eV}\) है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
आपतित फोटॉन की संपूर्ण ऊर्जा प्रोटॉन की बंधन ऊर्जा को पार करने में प्रयुक्त होती है। मानक नियतांक: \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\), \(c = 3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\), तथा \(1\text{ eV} = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}\text{ J}\)।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
\(\lambda\) तरंगदैर्ध्य वाले फोटॉन की ऊर्जा \(E = \frac{hc}{\lambda}\) होती है, अतः \(\lambda = \frac{hc}{E}\)।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
\(hc \approx 1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}\) का उपयोग करने पर:
\(\lambda = \frac{1240\text{ eV}\cdot\text{nm}}{10^6\text{ eV}} = 1.24 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm} \approx 1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
SI मात्रकों से जाँच करने पर: \(E = 10^6 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19} = 1.6 \times 10^{-13}\text{ J}\), जिससे \(\lambda = \frac{6.626 \times 10^{-34} \times 3 \times 10^8}{1.6 \times 10^{-13}} \approx 1.24 \times 10^{-12}\text{ m} = 1.24 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\) प्राप्त होता है। अतः आवश्यक तरंगदैर्ध्य लगभग \(1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\) है।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQI_Q11_3 - Electron beam incident on a metal surface

questiontext.text:
Consider a beam of electrons (each electron with energy \(E_0\)) incident on a metal surface kept in an evacuated chamber. Then

निर्वतित कक्ष में रखे किसी धातु के पृष्ठ पर आपतित इलेक्ट्रॉनों के एक पुंज (प्रत्येक इलेक्ट्रॉन की ऊर्जा \(E_0\)) पर विचार कीजिए। तब

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When a beam of energetic electrons, each having energy \(E_0\), strikes a metal surface, the incident electrons can undergo both elastic and inelastic collisions with the atoms and electrons of the metal.

Step 2: Evaluation
In an elastic collision with the metal surface, an incident electron can be reflected back with no loss of kinetic energy, retaining its full energy \(E_0\). In inelastic collisions, an incident electron loses varying amounts of energy to the lattice or to metal electrons (producing secondary electrons), so electrons leave the surface with any energy less than \(E_0\).

Step 3: Application
Because both elastic scattering (maximum energy \(E_0\)) and inelastic scattering (energies between \(0\) and \(E_0\)) occur, emitted electrons are not restricted to a single energy \(E_0\), nor is their maximum energy limited to \(E_0 - \phi\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, electrons can be emitted with any energy, with a maximum of \(E_0\).

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
जब \(E_0\) ऊर्जा वाले ऊर्जावान इलेक्ट्रॉनों का एक पुंज किसी धातु के पृष्ठ से टकराता है, तो आपतित इलेक्ट्रॉन धातु के परमाणुओं और इलेक्ट्रॉनों के साथ प्रत्यास्थ तथा अप्रत्यास्थ दोनों प्रकार के संघट्ट कर सकते हैं।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
धातु के पृष्ठ के साथ प्रत्यास्थ संघट्ट में, एक आपतित इलेक्ट्रॉन गतिज ऊर्जा की किसी हानि के बिना वापस परावर्तित हो सकता है, जिससे उसकी पूर्ण ऊर्जा \(E_0\) बनी रहती है। अप्रत्यास्थ संघट्टों में, आपतित इलेक्ट्रॉन जालक या धातु के इलेक्ट्रॉनों को भिन्न-भिन्न मात्रा में ऊर्जा खो देते हैं (जिससे द्वितीयक इलेक्ट्रॉन उत्पन्न होते हैं), अतः इलेक्ट्रॉन \(E_0\) से कम किसी भी ऊर्जा के साथ पृष्ठ से बाहर निकलते हैं।

चरण 3: अनुप्रयोग
चूँकि प्रत्यास्थ प्रकीर्णन (अधिकतम ऊर्जा \(E_0\)) और अप्रत्यास्थ प्रकीर्णन (\(0\) से \(E_0\) के बीच की ऊर्जाएँ) दोनों होते हैं, इसलिए उत्सर्जित इलेक्ट्रॉन न तो केवल \(E_0\) ऊर्जा तक सीमित होते हैं और न ही उनकी अधिकतम ऊर्जा \(E_0 - \phi\) तक सीमित होती है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, इलेक्ट्रॉन किसी भी ऊर्जा के साथ उत्सर्जित हो सकते हैं, जिसकी अधिकतम सीमा \(E_0\) है।

answer.text: no electrons will be emitted as only photons can emit electrons.
electrons can be emitted but all with an energy, \(E_0\).
electrons can be emitted with any energy, with a maximum of \(E_0 - \phi\) (\(\phi\) is the work function).
electrons can be emitted with any energy, with a maximum of \(E_0\).

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQI_Q11_4 - Effect of accelerating voltage on electron diffraction

questiontext.text:
Consider Fig. 11.7 in the NCERT text book of physics for Class XII. Suppose the voltage applied to A is increased. The diffracted beam will have the maximum at a value of \(\theta\) that

कक्षा XII की NCERT भौतिकी पाठ्यपुस्तक के चित्र 11.7 पर विचार कीजिए। मान लीजिए A पर अनुप्रयुक्त वोल्टता बढ़ा दी जाती है। विवर्तित पुंज का उच्चिष्ठ \(\theta\) के किस मान पर प्राप्त होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In the Davisson–Germer electron diffraction experiment, electrons are accelerated through a potential difference \(V\) applied to the anode A and then diffracted by a nickel crystal.

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Relationships
The de Broglie wavelength of an electron accelerated through voltage \(V\) is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2meV}} \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{V}}\). According to Bragg's law for diffraction maxima, \(2d\sin\theta = n\lambda\) (or \(d\sin\theta = n\lambda\) for surface grating), where \(d\) is the interplanar spacing and \(n\) is the order of diffraction.

Step 3: Evaluation
When the accelerating voltage \(V\) is increased, the de Broglie wavelength \(\lambda\) decreases. From the diffraction condition \(\sin\theta \propto \lambda\), a decrease in \(\lambda\) causes \(\sin\theta\) to decrease, which means the angle \(\theta\) for the diffraction maximum decreases.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the diffracted beam will have the maximum at a value of \(\theta\) that is less than the earlier value.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
डेविसन–जर्मर इलेक्ट्रॉन विवर्तन प्रयोग में, इलेक्ट्रॉनों को एनोड A पर अनुप्रयुक्त विभवांतर \(V\) द्वारा त्वरित किया जाता है और फिर वे निकल क्रिस्टल द्वारा विवर्तित होते हैं।

चरण 2: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और संबंध
\(V\) वोल्टता से त्वरित इलेक्ट्रॉन की दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2meV}} \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{V}}\) होती है। विवर्तन उच्चिष्ठ के लिए ब्रैग के नियम के अनुसार, \(2d\sin\theta = n\lambda\), जहाँ \(d\) अंतरा-तलीय दूरी है और \(n\) विवर्तन की कोटि है।

चरण 3: मूल्यांकन
जब त्वरक वोल्टता \(V\) बढ़ाई जाती है, तो दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda\) घटती है। विवर्तन शर्त \(\sin\theta \propto \lambda\) से, \(\lambda\) में कमी होने पर \(\sin\theta\) घटता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि विवर्तन उच्चिष्ठ का कोण \(\theta\) घट जाता है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, विवर्तित पुंज का उच्चिष्ठ \(\theta\) के उस मान पर होगा जो पहले वाले मान से कम होगा।

answer.text: will be larger than the earlier value.
will be the same as the earlier value.
will be less than the earlier value.

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQI_Q11_5 - Comparison of de Broglie wavelengths at equal energy

questiontext.text:
A proton, a neutron, an electron and an \(\alpha\)-particle have same energy. Then their de Broglie wavelengths compare as

एक प्रोटॉन, एक न्यूट्रॉन, एक इलेक्ट्रॉन तथा एक \(\alpha\)-कण की ऊर्जा समान है। उनकी दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य की तुलना किस प्रकार होती है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A proton (\(\mathrm{p}\)), a neutron (\(\mathrm{n}\)), an electron (\(\mathrm{e}\)), and an \(\alpha\)-particle (\(\alpha\)) all have the same kinetic energy \(E\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
All particles are treated non-relativistically, and the mass of a proton is taken approximately equal to the mass of a neutron (\(m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}}\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The de Broglie wavelength in terms of kinetic energy \(E\) and mass \(m\) is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2mE}}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(h\) and \(E\) are the same for all four particles, \(\lambda \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{m}}\).
Comparing their masses: \(m_{\mathrm{e}} \ll m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}} < m_{\alpha}\) (since \(m_{\alpha} \approx 4m_{\mathrm{p}}\)).
Because \(\lambda\) is inversely proportional to \(\sqrt{m}\), the wavelengths follow the reverse order:
\(\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The lightest particle (the electron) has the largest de Broglie wavelength, the proton and neutron have nearly equal intermediate wavelengths, and the heaviest particle (the \(\alpha\)-particle) has the smallest wavelength: \(\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
एक प्रोटॉन (\(\mathrm{p}\)), एक न्यूट्रॉन (\(\mathrm{n}\)), एक इलेक्ट्रॉन (\(\mathrm{e}\)), तथा एक \(\alpha\)-कण (\(\alpha\)) सभी की गतिज ऊर्जा \(E\) समान है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
सभी कणों को अन-आपेक्षिकीय माना गया है, तथा प्रोटॉन का द्रव्यमान लगभग न्यूट्रॉन के द्रव्यमान के बराबर लिया गया है (\(m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}}\))।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
गतिज ऊर्जा \(E\) और द्रव्यमान \(m\) के पदों में दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p} = \frac{h}{\sqrt{2mE}}\) होती है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
चूँकि चारों कणों के लिए \(h\) और \(E\) समान हैं, इसलिए \(\lambda \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{m}}\) होगा।
द्रव्यमानों की तुलना करने पर: \(m_{\mathrm{e}} \ll m_{\mathrm{p}} \approx m_{\mathrm{n}} < m_{\alpha}\) (क्योंकि \(m_{\alpha} \approx 4m_{\mathrm{p}}\))।
चूँकि \(\lambda\), \(\sqrt{m}\) के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती है, अतः तरंगदैर्ध्य का क्रम विपरीत होगा:
\(\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
सबसे हल्के कण (इलेक्ट्रॉन) की दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य सबसे अधिक, प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन की तरंगदैर्ध्य लगभग बराबर, तथा सबसे भारी कण (\(\alpha\)-कण) की तरंगदैर्ध्य सबसे कम होती है: \(\lambda_{\alpha} < \lambda_{\mathrm{p}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{n}} < \lambda_{\mathrm{e}}\)।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQI_Q11_6 - de Broglie wavelength of electron in magnetic field

questiontext.text:
An electron is moving with an initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) and is in a magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0\mathbf{j}\). Then its de Broglie wavelength

एक इलेक्ट्रॉन प्रारंभिक वेग \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) से गतिमान है तथा एक चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{B} = B_0\mathbf{j}\) में स्थित है। तब इसकी दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An electron of mass \(m\) and charge \(-e\) has initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) in a uniform magnetic field \(\mathbf{B} = B_0\mathbf{j}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
No electric or gravitational fields are present; only the magnetic Lorentz force acts on the electron.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnetic force is \(\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B}) = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\). The de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\), where \(v = |\mathbf{v}|\) is the speed.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Initially, \(\mathbf{F} = -e(v_0\mathbf{i} \times B_0\mathbf{j}) = -ev_0B_0\mathbf{k}\), which is perpendicular to \(\mathbf{v}\). At all times, \(\mathbf{F} \perp \mathbf{v}\), so the instantaneous power delivered by the magnetic force is \(P = \mathbf{F} \cdot \mathbf{v} = 0\). By the work-energy theorem, the kinetic energy and speed \(v = v_0\) remain constant in time. Therefore, \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv_0}\) remains constant.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Although the direction of velocity changes as the electron moves in a circular path, its speed remains unchanged, so its de Broglie wavelength remains constant.

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
\(m\) द्रव्यमान और \(-e\) आवेश वाला एक इलेक्ट्रॉन एकसमान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{B} = B_0\mathbf{j}\) में प्रारंभिक वेग \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) से गतिमान है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
कोई विद्युत या गुरुत्वीय क्षेत्र उपस्थित नहीं है; इलेक्ट्रॉन पर केवल चुंबकीय लॉरेंज बल कार्य करता है।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
चुंबकीय बल \(\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B}) = -e(\mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})\) है। दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\) है, जहाँ \(v = |\mathbf{v}|\) चाल है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
प्रारंभ में, \(\mathbf{F} = -e(v_0\mathbf{i} \times B_0\mathbf{j}) = -ev_0B_0\mathbf{k}\) है, जो \(\mathbf{v}\) के लंबवत है। प्रत्येक क्षण \(\mathbf{F} \perp \mathbf{v}\) होने के कारण चुंबकीय बल द्वारा प्रदत्त तात्क्षणिक शक्ति \(P = \mathbf{F} \cdot \mathbf{v} = 0\) होती है। कार्य-ऊर्जा प्रमेय से, गतिज ऊर्जा और चाल \(v = v_0\) समय के साथ नियत रहते हैं। अतः, \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv_0}\) नियत रहती है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
यद्यपि वृत्ताकार पथ में गति के कारण वेग की दिशा बदलती है, परंतु इसकी चाल अपरिवर्तित रहती है, इसलिए इसकी दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य नियत रहती है।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQI_Q11_7 - de Broglie wavelength of electron in parallel electric field

questiontext.text:
An electron (mass \(m\)) with an initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)) is in an electric field \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 = \text{constant} > 0\)). Its de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is given by

द्रव्यमान \(m\) तथा प्रारंभिक वेग \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)) वाला एक इलेक्ट्रॉन एक विद्युत क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 = \text{नियतांक} > 0\)) में है। समय \(t\) पर इसकी दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य किसके द्वारा दी जाती है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Electron mass \(= m\), charge \(= -e\), initial velocity \(\mathbf{v}(0) = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)), and uniform electric field \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 > 0\)). Initial de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Motion is along the \(x\)-axis (unit vector \(\mathbf{i}\)) and non-relativistic.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Electric force on the electron: \(\mathbf{F} = -e\mathbf{E}\). Acceleration: \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{\mathbf{F}}{m}\). Velocity at time \(t\): \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{v}(0) + \mathbf{a}t\). de Broglie wavelength: \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv(t)}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The force on the electron is \(\mathbf{F} = -e(-E_0\mathbf{i}) = eE_0\mathbf{i}\).
Acceleration is \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{eE_0}{m}\mathbf{i}\).
Velocity at time \(t\) is:
\(\mathbf{v}(t) = v_0\mathbf{i} + \frac{eE_0}{m}t\,\mathbf{i} = v_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)\mathbf{i}\).
Therefore, the de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is:
\(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At \(t = 0\), \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\), and as \(t\) increases, the electron accelerates and \(\lambda(t)\) decreases. Thus, \(\lambda(t) = \frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
इलेक्ट्रॉन का द्रव्यमान \(= m\), आवेश \(= -e\), प्रारंभिक वेग \(\mathbf{v}(0) = v_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(v_0 > 0\)), और एकसमान विद्युत क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{E} = -E_0\mathbf{i}\) (\(E_0 > 0\)) है। प्रारंभिक दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\) है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
गति \(x\)-अक्ष (एकांक सदिश \(\mathbf{i}\)) के अनुदिश तथा अन-आपेक्षिकीय है।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
इलेक्ट्रॉन पर विद्युत बल: \(\mathbf{F} = -e\mathbf{E}\)। त्वरण: \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{\mathbf{F}}{m}\)। समय \(t\) पर वेग: \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{v}(0) + \mathbf{a}t\)। दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य: \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv(t)}\)।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
इलेक्ट्रॉन पर बल \(\mathbf{F} = -e(-E_0\mathbf{i}) = eE_0\mathbf{i}\) है।
त्वरण \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{eE_0}{m}\mathbf{i}\) है।
समय \(t\) पर वेग:
\(\mathbf{v}(t) = v_0\mathbf{i} + \frac{eE_0}{m}t\,\mathbf{i} = v_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)\mathbf{i}\)।
अतः समय \(t\) पर दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य:
\(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
\(t = 0\) पर \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\) है, और जैसे-जैसे \(t\) बढ़ता है, इलेक्ट्रॉन त्वरित होता है तथा \(\lambda(t)\) घटती है। अतः \(\lambda(t) = \frac{\lambda_0}{\left(1 + \frac{eE_0}{m}\frac{t}{v_0}\right)}\)।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQI_Q11_8 - de Broglie wavelength of electron in perpendicular electric field

questiontext.text:
An electron (mass \(m\)) with an initial velocity \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) is in an electric field \(\mathbf{E} = E_0\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). If \(\lambda_0 = h/mv_0\), its de Broglie wavelength at time \(t\) is given by

द्रव्यमान \(m\) तथा प्रारंभिक वेग \(\mathbf{v} = v_0\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) वाला एक इलेक्ट्रॉन एक विद्युत क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{E} = E_0\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) में है। यदि \(\lambda_0 = h/mv_0\) है, तो समय \(t\) पर इसकी दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य किसके द्वारा दी जाती है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Electron mass \(= m\), charge \(= -e\), initial velocity \(\mathbf{v}(0) = v_0\hat{\mathbf{i}}\), electric field \(\mathbf{E} = E_0\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), and \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Motion is two-dimensional in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane and non-relativistic.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Force \(\mathbf{F} = -e\mathbf{E}\), acceleration \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{\mathbf{F}}{m}\), velocity \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{v}(0) + \mathbf{a}t\), speed \(v(t) = \sqrt{v_x^2 + v_y^2}\), and \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv(t)}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The acceleration is \(\mathbf{a} = -\frac{eE_0}{m}\hat{\mathbf{j}}\).
At time \(t\), the velocity vector is \(\mathbf{v}(t) = v_0\hat{\mathbf{i}} - \frac{eE_0 t}{m}\hat{\mathbf{j}}\).
The speed is:
\(v(t) = \sqrt{v_0^2 + \left(\frac{eE_0 t}{m}\right)^2} = v_0\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}\).
Substituting into the de Broglie wavelength relation:
\(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At \(t = 0\), \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\), and for \(t > 0\), the speed increases so \(\lambda(t) < \lambda_0\). Thus, \(\lambda(t) = \frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
इलेक्ट्रॉन का द्रव्यमान \(= m\), आवेश \(= -e\), प्रारंभिक वेग \(\mathbf{v}(0) = v_0\hat{\mathbf{i}}\), विद्युत क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{E} = E_0\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), तथा \(\lambda_0 = \frac{h}{mv_0}\) है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
गति \(x\)-\(y\) तल में द्विविमीय तथा अन-आपेक्षिकीय है।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
बल \(\mathbf{F} = -e\mathbf{E}\), त्वरण \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{\mathbf{F}}{m}\), वेग \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{v}(0) + \mathbf{a}t\), चाल \(v(t) = \sqrt{v_x^2 + v_y^2}\), तथा \(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv(t)}\) है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
त्वरण \(\mathbf{a} = -\frac{eE_0}{m}\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) है।
समय \(t\) पर वेग सदिश \(\mathbf{v}(t) = v_0\hat{\mathbf{i}} - \frac{eE_0 t}{m}\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) है।
चाल का मान:
\(v(t) = \sqrt{v_0^2 + \left(\frac{eE_0 t}{m}\right)^2} = v_0\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}\)।
दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य के सूत्र में रखने पर:
\(\lambda(t) = \frac{h}{mv_0\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}} = \frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\).

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
\(t = 0\) पर \(\lambda(0) = \lambda_0\) है, तथा \(t > 0\) के लिए चाल बढ़ने के कारण \(\lambda(t) < \lambda_0\) होती है। अतः \(\lambda(t) = \frac{\lambda_0}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{e^2 E_0^2 t^2}{m^2 v_0^2}}}\).

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQII_Q11_9 - Relativistic corrections for electron de Broglie wavelength

questiontext.text:
Relativistic corrections become necessary when the expression for the kinetic energy \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2\), becomes comparable with \(mc^2\), where \(m\) is the mass of the particle. At what de Broglie wavelength will relativistic corrections become important for an electron?

आपेक्षिकीय संशोधन तब आवश्यक हो जाते हैं जब गतिज ऊर्जा का व्यंजक \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2\), \(mc^2\) के तुलनीय हो जाता है, जहाँ \(m\) कण का द्रव्यमान है। किसी इलेक्ट्रॉन के लिए किस दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य पर आपेक्षिकीय संशोधन महत्वपूर्ण हो जाएँगे?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of an electron \(m = 9.1 \times 10^{-31}\text{ kg}\), \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\), \(c = 3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\). Relativistic corrections become necessary when \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2 \sim mc^2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
We use the non-relativistic momentum-wavelength relation \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\) as a diagnostic criterion to check when \(v\) approaches or exceeds \(c\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv} \implies v = \frac{h}{m\lambda}\). Relativistic corrections are important when \(v \sim c\) or larger, i.e., when \(\lambda \lesssim \frac{h}{mc}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
First, compute the critical (Compton) wavelength scale:
\(\frac{h}{mc} = \frac{6.626 \times 10^{-34}}{9.1 \times 10^{-31} \times 3 \times 10^8} \approx 2.4 \times 10^{-12}\text{ m} = 2.4 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\).
Now check the speeds for the given wavelengths:
1. For \(\lambda = 10\text{ nm} = 10^{-8}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx \frac{6.626 \times 10^{-34}}{9.1 \times 10^{-31} \times 10^{-8}} \approx 7.3 \times 10^4\text{ m/s} \ll c\) (non-relativistic).
2. For \(\lambda = 10^{-3}\text{ nm} = 10^{-12}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s} > c\) (relativistic).
3. For \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm} = 10^{-13}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^9\text{ m/s} \gg c\) (relativistic).
4. For \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm} = 10^{-15}\text{ m}\): \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{11}\text{ m/s} \gg c\) (relativistic).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Relativistic corrections become important for all wavelengths comparable to or smaller than \(10^{-3}\text{ nm}\), namely \(\lambda = 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\), \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm}\), and \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
इलेक्ट्रॉन का द्रव्यमान \(m = 9.1 \times 10^{-31}\text{ kg}\), \(h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J}\cdot\text{s}\), \(c = 3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\)। आपेक्षिकीय संशोधन तब आवश्यक होते हैं जब \(\frac{1}{2}mv^2 \sim mc^2\) हो।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
यह जाँचने के लिए कि \(v\) कब \(c\) के समीप या उससे अधिक होता है, हम अन-आपेक्षिकीय संबंध \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\) का उपयोग करते हैं।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
\(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv} \implies v = \frac{h}{m\lambda}\)। आपेक्षिकीय संशोधन तब महत्वपूर्ण होते हैं जब \(v \sim c\) या उससे अधिक हो, अर्थात् जब \(\lambda \lesssim \frac{h}{mc}\) हो।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
सर्वप्रथम क्रांतिक तरंगदैर्ध्य की गणना करने पर:
\(\frac{h}{mc} = \frac{6.626 \times 10^{-34}}{9.1 \times 10^{-31} \times 3 \times 10^8} \approx 2.4 \times 10^{-12}\text{ m} = 2.4 \times 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\)।
दी गई तरंगदैर्ध्य के लिए चाल की जाँच करने पर:
1. \(\lambda = 10\text{ nm} = 10^{-8}\text{ m}\) के लिए: \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^4\text{ m/s} \ll c\) (अन-आपेक्षिकीय)।
2. \(\lambda = 10^{-3}\text{ nm} = 10^{-12}\text{ m}\) के लिए: \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s} > c\) (आपेक्षिकीय)।
3. \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm} = 10^{-13}\text{ m}\) के लिए: \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^9\text{ m/s} \gg c\) (आपेक्षिकीय)।
4. \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm} = 10^{-15}\text{ m}\) के लिए: \(v \approx 7.3 \times 10^{11}\text{ m/s} \gg c\) (आपेक्षिकीय)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
\(10^{-3}\text{ nm}\) के तुलनीय या उससे कम सभी तरंगदैर्ध्यों, अर्थात् \(\lambda = 10^{-3}\text{ nm}\), \(\lambda = 10^{-4}\text{ nm}\), तथा \(\lambda = 10^{-6}\text{ nm}\) के लिए आपेक्षिकीय संशोधन महत्वपूर्ण हो जाते हैं।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQII_Q11_10 - Momenta and energies of particles with equal wavelength

questiontext.text:
Two particles \(A_1\), and \(A_2\) of masses \(m_1, m_2\) (\(m_1 > m_2\)) have the same de Broglie wavelength. Then

\(m_1, m_2\) (\(m_1 > m_2\)) द्रव्यमान के दो कणों \(A_1\) और \(A_2\) की दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य समान है। तब

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two particles \(A_1\) and \(A_2\) have masses \(m_1 > m_2\) and equal de Broglie wavelengths \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = \lambda\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Both particles are non-relativistic, and their kinetic energies are denoted by \(E_1\) and \(E_2\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p}\), so momentum \(p = \frac{h}{\lambda}\). Kinetic energy is \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2\), their momenta are \(p_1 = \frac{h}{\lambda_1} = \frac{h}{\lambda_2} = p_2\). Thus, their momenta are the same.
Using \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m}\) with \(p_1 = p_2 = p\):
\(\frac{E_1}{E_2} = \frac{m_2}{m_1}\).
Since \(m_1 > m_2\), we have \(E_1 < E_2\), meaning the energy of \(A_1\) is less than the energy of \(A_2\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both particles have the same momentum, and the heavier particle \(A_1\) has less kinetic energy than the lighter particle \(A_2\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
दो कणों \(A_1\) और \(A_2\) के द्रव्यमान \(m_1 > m_2\) हैं तथा उनकी दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य समान (\(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = \lambda\)) हैं।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
दोनों कण अन-आपेक्षिकीय हैं, तथा उनकी गतिज ऊर्जाएँ क्रमशः \(E_1\) और \(E_2\) हैं।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p}\) होती है, अतः संवेग \(p = \frac{h}{\lambda}\) है। गतिज ऊर्जा \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m}\) है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
चूँकि \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2\) है, इसलिए उनके संवेग \(p_1 = \frac{h}{\lambda_1} = \frac{h}{\lambda_2} = p_2\) हैं। अतः उनके संवेग समान हैं।
\(p_1 = p_2 = p\) के साथ \(E = \frac{p^2}{2m}\) का उपयोग करने पर:
\(\frac{E_1}{E_2} = \frac{m_2}{m_1}\)।
चूँकि \(m_1 > m_2\) है, इसलिए \(E_1 < E_2\), अर्थात् \(A_1\) की ऊर्जा \(A_2\) की ऊर्जा से कम है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
दोनों कणों का संवेग समान है, और भारी कण \(A_1\) की गतिज ऊर्जा हल्के कण \(A_2\) की ऊर्जा से कम है।

answer.text: energy of \(A_1\) is less than the energy of \(A_2\).
energy of \(A_1\) is more than the energy of \(A_2\).

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQII_Q11_11 - Comparing photon and electron energies and momenta

questiontext.text:
The de Broglie wavelength of a photon is twice the de Broglie wavelength of an electron. The speed of the electron is \(v_e = \frac{c}{100}\). Then

एक फोटॉन की दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य एक इलेक्ट्रॉन की दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य की दोगुनी है। इलेक्ट्रॉन की चाल \(v_e = \frac{c}{100}\) है। तब

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e\), and the speed of the electron is \(v_e = \frac{c}{100} = 10^{-2}c\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Since \(v_e \ll c\), the electron's momentum and kinetic energy are treated non-relativistically: \(p_e = m_e v_e\) and \(E_e = \frac{1}{2}m_e v_e^2\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For the electron: \(\lambda_e = \frac{h}{p_e} = \frac{h}{m_e v_e}\). For the photon: \(E_p = \frac{hc}{\lambda_p}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
First, compute the dimensionless momentum ratio:
\(\frac{p_e}{m_e c} = \frac{m_e v_e}{m_e c} = \frac{v_e}{c} = \frac{1}{100} = 10^{-2}\).
Next, find \(\lambda_p\) in terms of \(m_e\) and \(c\):
\(\lambda_e = \frac{h}{m_e (c/100)} = \frac{100h}{m_e c}\), so \(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e = \frac{200h}{m_e c}\).
Therefore, the photon energy is:
\(E_p = \frac{hc}{\lambda_p} = \frac{hc}{200h/(m_e c)} = \frac{m_e c^2}{200}\).
The electron kinetic energy is:
\(E_e = \frac{1}{2}m_e v_e^2 = \frac{1}{2}m_e \left(\frac{c}{100}\right)^2 = \frac{m_e c^2}{2 \times 10^4}\).
Taking the ratio of energies:
\(\frac{E_e}{E_p} = \frac{m_e c^2 / (2 \times 10^4)}{m_e c^2 / 200} = \frac{200}{2 \times 10^4} = 10^{-2}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both \(\frac{E_e}{E_p} = 10^{-2}\) and \(\frac{p_e}{m_e c} = 10^{-2}\) hold true.

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
\(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e\), और इलेक्ट्रॉन की चाल \(v_e = \frac{c}{100} = 10^{-2}c\) है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
चूँकि \(v_e \ll c\) है, इलेक्ट्रॉन के संवेग और गतिज ऊर्जा को अन-आपेक्षिकीय माना जाता है: \(p_e = m_e v_e\) और \(E_e = \frac{1}{2}m_e v_e^2\)।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
इलेक्ट्रॉन के लिए: \(\lambda_e = \frac{h}{p_e} = \frac{h}{m_e v_e}\)। फोटॉन के लिए: \(E_p = \frac{hc}{\lambda_p}\)।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
सर्वप्रथम विमाहीन संवेग अनुपात की गणना करने पर:
\(\frac{p_e}{m_e c} = \frac{m_e v_e}{m_e c} = \frac{v_e}{c} = \frac{1}{100} = 10^{-2}\)।
अब \(m_e\) और \(c\) के पदों में \(\lambda_p\) ज्ञात करने पर:
\(\lambda_e = \frac{h}{m_e (c/100)} = \frac{100h}{m_e c}\), अतः \(\lambda_p = 2\lambda_e = \frac{200h}{m_e c}\)।
इसलिए फोटॉन की ऊर्जा:
\(E_p = \frac{hc}{\lambda_p} = \frac{hc}{200h/(m_e c)} = \frac{m_e c^2}{200}\)।
इलेक्ट्रॉन की गतिज ऊर्जा:
\(E_e = \frac{1}{2}m_e v_e^2 = \frac{1}{2}m_e \left(\frac{c}{100}\right)^2 = \frac{m_e c^2}{2 \times 10^4}\)।
ऊर्जाओं का अनुपात लेने पर:
\(\frac{E_e}{E_p} = \frac{m_e c^2 / (2 \times 10^4)}{m_e c^2 / 200} = \frac{200}{2 \times 10^4} = 10^{-2}\)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
\(\frac{E_e}{E_p} = 10^{-2}\) तथा \(\frac{p_e}{m_e c} = 10^{-2}\) दोनों सत्य हैं।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQII_Q11_12 - Time to melt ice using a photon source

questiontext.text:
Photons absorbed in matter are converted to heat. A source emitting \(n\) photon/sec of frequency \(\nu\) is used to convert \(1\text{ kg}\) of ice at \(0^\circ\text{C}\) to water at \(0^\circ\text{C}\). Then, the time \(T\) taken for the conversion

पदार्थ में अवशोषित फोटॉन ऊष्मा में परिवर्तित हो जाते हैं। \(\nu\) आवृत्ति के \(n\) फोटॉन/सेकंड उत्सर्जित करने वाले एक स्रोत का उपयोग \(0^\circ\text{C}\) पर \(1\text{ kg}\) बर्फ को \(0^\circ\text{C}\) पर जल में बदलने के लिए किया जाता है। तब, इस रूपांतरण में लगने वाला समय \(T\)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of ice \(M = 1 ext{ kg}\) at \(0^\circ ext{C}\), latent heat of fusion of ice \(= L\), photon emission rate \(= n ext{ s}^{-1}\), frequency of each photon \(= u\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
All emitted photons are absorbed by the ice and converted completely into latent heat without heat loss to the surroundings.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Heat required to melt the ice: \(Q = ML\). Energy of one photon: \(E = h u\). Power of the source: \(P = nE = nh u\). Total energy supplied in time \(T\): \(Q = PT\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Equating heat required to energy supplied:
\(ML = nh u T \implies T = rac{ML}{nh u}\).
Since \(M\), \(L\), and \(h\) are constants, \(T \propto rac{1}{n u}\).
- When \( u\) is fixed and \(n\) increases, \(T\) decreases.
- When \(n\) is fixed and \( u\) increases, \(T\) decreases.
- When \(n u\) is constant, \(T\) remains constant.
- When \(n u\) increases, \(T\) decreases (so it does not increase).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Thus, \(T\) decreases with increasing \(n\) at fixed \( u\), decreases with increasing \( u\) at fixed \(n\), and remains constant when \(n u = ext{constant}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
\(0^\circ ext{C}\) पर बर्फ का द्रव्यमान \(M = 1 ext{ kg}\), बर्फ के गलन की गुप्त ऊष्मा \(= L\), फोटॉन उत्सर्जन दर \(= n ext{ s}^{-1}\), तथा प्रत्येक फोटॉन की आवृत्ति \(= u\) है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
सभी उत्सर्जित फोटॉन बर्फ द्वारा अवशोषित कर लिए जाते हैं और परिवेश में किसी ऊष्मा हानि के बिना पूर्णतः गुप्त ऊष्मा में परिवर्तित हो जाते हैं।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
बर्फ को पिघलाने के लिए आवश्यक ऊष्मा: \(Q = ML\)। एक फोटॉन की ऊर्जा: \(E = h u\)। स्रोत की शक्ति: \(P = nE = nh u\)। समय \(T\) में दी गई कुल ऊर्जा: \(Q = PT\)।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण गणना
आवश्यक ऊष्मा को प्रदत्त ऊर्जा के बराबर रखने पर:
\(ML = nh u T \implies T = rac{ML}{nh u}\)।
चूँकि \(M\), \(L\), और \(h\) नियतांक हैं, अतः \(T \propto rac{1}{n u}\)।
- जब \( u\) नियत हो और \(n\) बढ़े, तो \(T\) घटता है।
- जब \(n\) नियत हो और \( u\) बढ़े, तो \(T\) घटता है।
- जब \(n u\) नियत हो, तो \(T\) नियत रहता है।
- जब \(n u\) बढ़ता है, तो \(T\) घटता है (अतः यह बढ़ता नहीं है)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
अतः, नियत \( u\) पर \(n\) बढ़ने से \(T\) घटता है, नियत \(n\) पर \( u\) बढ़ने से \(T\) घटता है, तथा \(n u = ext{नियतांक}\) होने पर \(T\) नियत रहता है।

answer.text: remains constant with \(n\) and \(\nu\) changing such that \(n\nu = \text{constant}\).

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_CH11_MCQII_Q11_13 - de Broglie wavelength in a closed central orbit

questiontext.text:
A particle moves in a closed orbit around the origin, due to a force which is directed towards the origin. The de Broglie wavelength of the particle varies cyclically between two values \(\lambda_1, \lambda_2\) with \(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\). Which of the following statement are true?

एक कण मूल बिंदु की ओर दिष्ट किसी बल के कारण मूल बिंदु के चारों ओर एक बंद कक्षा में गति करता है। कण की दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य दो मानों \(\lambda_1, \lambda_2\) (\(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\)) के बीच चक्रीय रूप से परिवर्तित होती है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सत्य हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A central force directed towards the origin produces zero torque about the origin, so the angular momentum of the particle about the origin is conserved.

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Relationships
The de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\). For a closed orbit under a central force, angular momentum conservation gives \(L = mvr\sin\theta = \text{constant}\) (and at the turning points of the orbit, \(L = mvr\)).

Step 3: Evaluation
If the particle moved in a circular orbit with the origin as its centre, its distance \(r\) from the origin and its speed \(v\) would remain constant, making \(\lambda\) constant rather than varying between \(\lambda_1\) and \(\lambda_2\). However, in an elliptical orbit with the origin at one focus, the distance \(r\) and speed \(v\) vary cyclically between aphelion and perihelion.
Since \(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\), we have \(v_1 < v_2\) (because \(\lambda \propto 1/v\)). By conservation of angular momentum at the turning points (\(v_1 r_1 = v_2 r_2\)), \(v_1 < v_2\) implies \(r_1 > r_2\). Thus, when the de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_2\), the particle is faster and nearer the origin than when its wavelength is \(\lambda_1\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the particle could be moving in an elliptic orbit with the origin as its focus, and when the de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_2\), the particle is nearer the origin than when its value is \(\lambda_1\).

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
मूल बिंदु की ओर दिष्ट केंद्रीय बल मूल बिंदु के परितः शून्य बल आघूर्ण उत्पन्न करता है, इसलिए मूल बिंदु के परितः कण का कोणीय संवेग संरक्षित रहता है।

चरण 2: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और संबंध
दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}\) होती है। केंद्रीय बल के अंतर्गत बंद कक्षा के लिए, कोणीय संवेग संरक्षण से \(L = mvr\sin\theta = \text{नियतांक}\) (तथा कक्षा के चरम बिंदुओं पर \(L = mvr\)) प्राप्त होता है।

चरण 3: मूल्यांकन
यदि कण मूल बिंदु को केंद्र मानकर वृत्ताकार कक्षा में गति करता, तो मूल बिंदु से उसकी दूरी \(r\) और चाल \(v\) नियत रहती, जिससे \(\lambda\) भी नियत रहती और \(\lambda_1\) व \(\lambda_2\) के बीच परिवर्तित नहीं होती। परंतु, मूल बिंदु को एक नाभि (फोकस) मानकर दीर्घवृत्ताकार कक्षा में गति करने पर दूरी \(r\) और चाल \(v\) चक्रीय रूप से परिवर्तित होती है।
चूँकि \(\lambda_1 > \lambda_2\) है, इसलिए \(v_1 < v_2\) होगा (क्योंकि \(\lambda \propto 1/v\))। चरम बिंदुओं पर कोणीय संवेग संरक्षण (\(v_1 r_1 = v_2 r_2\)) से, \(v_1 < v_2\) का अर्थ है \(r_1 > r_2\)। अतः, जब दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda_2\) होती है, तब कण अधिक तीव्र गति से चलता है और \(\lambda_1\) की तुलना में मूल बिंदु के अधिक निकट होता है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः, कण मूल बिंदु को नाभि मानकर एक दीर्घवृत्ताकार कक्षा में गति कर सकता है, और जब दे ब्रॉग्ली तरंगदैर्ध्य \(\lambda_2\) होती है, तो कण \(\lambda_1\) मान की तुलना में मूल बिंदु के अधिक निकट होता है।

answer.text: The particle could be moving in a circular orbit with origin as centre
The particle could be moving in an elliptic orbit with origin as its focus.
When the de Broglie wave length is \(\lambda_1\), the particle is nearer the origin than when its value is \(\lambda_2\).
When the de Broglie wavelength is \(\lambda_2\), the particle is nearer the origin than when its value is \(\lambda_1\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_1 - Radius of doubly ionised lithium ion

questiontext.text: Taking the Bohr radius as \(a_0 = 53\,\mathrm{pm}\), the radius of \(\mathrm{Li^{++}}\) ion in its ground state, on the basis of Bohr's model, will be about

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Bohr radius for a hydrogen atom, \(a_0 = 53\,\mathrm{pm}\).
The ion is doubly ionised lithium, \(\mathrm{Li^{++}}\), which is a hydrogen-like single-electron system with atomic number \(Z = 3\).
The electron is in the ground state, so the principal quantum number is \(n = 1\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
According to Bohr's model for hydrogen-like species, the nucleus is assumed to be stationary and massive compared to the electron, and the electron revolves in a circular orbit under the central Coulomb attraction of the nucleus.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The radius of the \(n^{\text{th}}\) Bohr orbit for a hydrogen-like ion of atomic number \(Z\) is given by:
\[r_n = \frac{n^2 a_0}{Z}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute \(n = 1\), \(Z = 3\), and \(a_0 = 53\,\mathrm{pm}\) into the formula:
\[r_1 = \frac{1^2 \times 53\,\mathrm{pm}}{3} = \frac{53}{3}\,\mathrm{pm} \approx 17.67\,\mathrm{pm}\]
Rounding to the nearest integer gives \(18\,\mathrm{pm}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The units are in picometres (\(\mathrm{pm}\)), and since \(Z = 3 > 1\), the stronger nuclear attraction pulls the ground-state orbit closer to the nucleus than in hydrogen (\(r_1 < a_0\)), which is physically consistent. Therefore, the radius of the \(\mathrm{Li^{++}}\) ion in its ground state is about \(18\,\mathrm{pm}\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_2 - Binding energy in electron rest frame

questiontext.text:
The binding energy of a H-atom, considering an electron moving around a fixed nuclei (proton), is \(B = -\frac{me^4}{8n^2\varepsilon_0^2h^2}\) (\(m =\) electron mass).

If one decides to work in a frame of reference where the electron is at rest, the proton would be moving around it. By similar arguments, the binding energy would be

\[B = -\frac{Me^4}{8n^2\varepsilon_0^2h^2} \quad (M = \text{proton mass})\]

This last expression is not correct because

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Newton's laws of motion and the standard Bohr model derivations (which balance the electrostatic centripetal force with \(mv^2/r\) and apply angular momentum quantisation) are valid only in an inertial frame of reference.

Step 2: Evaluation
In a hydrogen atom, the electron experiences a large centripetal acceleration due to the Coulomb attraction of the proton. Therefore, a frame of reference attached to the electron (in which the electron is permanently at rest) is an accelerating, non-inertial frame of reference.

Step 3: Application
In a non-inertial frame, pseudo-forces must be accounted for, and one cannot simply interchange the roles and masses of the electron and proton in the standard Bohr energy formula. In a proper inertial (centre-of-mass) frame, the finite nuclear mass is accounted for by using the reduced mass \(\mu = \frac{mM}{m+M} \approx m\), rather than replacing \(m\) with the proton mass \(M\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The given expression with \(M\) in the numerator is incorrect because the frame in which the electron is at rest is not inertial.

answer.text: the frame in which the electron is at rest is not inertial.
the motion of the proton would not be in circular orbits, even approximately.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_3 - Limitation of simple Bohr model

questiontext.text: The simple Bohr model cannot be directly applied to calculate the energy levels of an atom with many electrons. This is because

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The simple Bohr model is derived for a single-electron (hydrogen-like) atom where the electron moves exclusively under a central inverse-square Coulomb force directed towards the fixed nucleus.

Step 2: Evaluation
In a multi-electron atom, each electron experiences not only the attractive central force from the positively charged nucleus, but also repulsive electrostatic forces from all the other electrons in the atom.

Step 3: Application
Because of these electron–electron repulsions, the net force acting on any given electron is no longer directed solely towards the nucleus, meaning the electrons are not subject to a simple central force. Consequently, the simple Bohr model cannot be directly applied to calculate their energy levels.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The simple Bohr model fails for multi-electron atoms because of the electrons not being subject to a central force.

answer.text: of the electrons not being subject to a central force.
of the electrons colliding with each other
the force between the nucleus and an electron will no longer be given by Coulomb's law.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_4 - Ground state angular momentum in Bohr model

questiontext.text: For the ground state, the electron in the H-atom has an angular momentum \(= \hbar\), according to the simple Bohr model. Angular momentum is a vector and hence there will be infinitely many orbits with the vector pointing in all possible directions. In actuality, this is not true.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In the simple Bohr model, the orbital angular momentum of an electron in the \(n^{\text{th}}\) orbit is quantised as \(L = n\hbar\), which gives \(L = \hbar\) for the ground state (\(n = 1\)).

Step 2: Evaluation
According to quantum mechanics (the Schrödinger wave mechanical model of the hydrogen atom), the orbital angular momentum magnitude is given by \(L = \sqrt{l(l+1)}\,\hbar\), where the azimuthal quantum number \(l\) can take values from \(0\) to \(n - 1\).

Step 3: Application
For the ground state (\(n = 1\)), the only allowed value is \(l = 0\), which gives an actual orbital angular momentum of \(L = 0\) (a spherically symmetric \(s\)-orbital, with no preferred orbital plane or direction). Thus, the paradox of infinitely many directional orbits in the ground state does not arise in reality.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
In actuality, the scenario described does not occur because the Bohr model gives incorrect values of angular momentum.

answer.text: because Bohr model gives incorrect values of angular momentum.
because only one of these would have a minimum energy.
angular momentum must be in the direction of spin of electron.
because electrons go around only in horizontal orbits.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_5 - Nuclear force in oxygen molecule

questiontext.text: \(\mathrm{O}_2\) molecule consists of two oxygen atoms. In the molecule, nuclear force between the nuclei of the two atoms

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The strong nuclear force is an extremely short-ranged force that acts only over distances of the order of a few femtometres (\(10^{-15}\,\mathrm{m}\)), i.e., within the dimensions of an atomic nucleus.

Step 2: Evaluation
In an \(\mathrm{O}_2\) molecule, the two oxygen atoms are bound by covalent (electrostatic) forces, and the separation between their nuclei is of the order of an angstrom (\(\sim 10^{-10}\,\mathrm{m}\)).

Step 3: Application
Since the inter-nuclear separation (\(\sim 10^{-10}\,\mathrm{m}\)) is about five orders of magnitude larger than the range of the nuclear force (\(\sim 10^{-15}\,\mathrm{m}\)), the nuclear force between the two oxygen nuclei is essentially zero and plays no role in molecular bonding.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
In the \(\mathrm{O}_2\) molecule, the nuclear force between the nuclei of the two atoms is not important because nuclear forces are short-ranged.

answer.text: is not important because nuclear forces are short-ranged.
is as important as electrostatic force for binding the two atoms.
cancels the repulsive electrostatic force between the nuclei.
is not important because oxygen nucleus have equal number of neutrons and protons.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_6 - Inelastic collision of two hydrogen atoms

questiontext.text: Two H atoms in the ground state collide inelastically. The maximum amount by which their combined kinetic energy is reduced is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two hydrogen atoms are initially in the ground state (\(n = 1\)).
Energy of a hydrogen atom in the \(n^{\text{th}}\) state is \(E_n = -\frac{13.6}{n^2}\,\mathrm{eV}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
During an inelastic collision, part of the combined kinetic energy of the colliding atoms is converted into internal excitation energy of the atom. In the standard ground-state excitation process, an atom is excited from the ground state (\(n = 1\)) to the first excited state (\(n = 2\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By conservation of total energy, the reduction in combined kinetic energy equals the energy absorbed for excitation:
\[\Delta K = \Delta E = E_2 - E_1\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate the energies of the ground state and the first excited state:
\[E_1 = -\frac{13.6}{1^2}\,\mathrm{eV} = -13.6\,\mathrm{eV}\]
\[E_2 = -\frac{13.6}{2^2}\,\mathrm{eV} = -3.40\,\mathrm{eV}\]
Thus, the energy required to excite one hydrogen atom from \(n = 1\) to \(n = 2\) is:
\[\Delta E = -3.40\,\mathrm{eV} - (-13.6\,\mathrm{eV}) = 10.20\,\mathrm{eV}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The units are in electron-volts (\(\mathrm{eV}\)), and the positive value \(10.20\,\mathrm{eV}\) represents the energy absorbed from the kinetic energy of the colliding system. Therefore, the maximum amount by which their combined kinetic energy is reduced is \(10.20\,\mathrm{eV}\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_7 - Decay of atoms in excited state

questiontext.text: A set of atoms in an excited state decays.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Atoms in an excited state undergo spontaneous emission to reach states of lower energy without requiring any external electric field or collision.

Step 2: Evaluation
Spontaneous decay is a probabilistic quantum process: individual atoms in an ensemble decay independently at random times, rather than all together simultaneously.

Step 3: Application
When an atom is in a higher excited state (for example, \(n = 3\) or higher), there may be multiple lower-energy states available (such as \(n = 2\) or \(n = 1\)). Consequently, the set of excited atoms can decay to any of the allowed states with lower energy.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
A set of atoms in an excited state decays in general to any of the states with lower energy.

answer.text: in general to any of the states with lower energy.
into a lower state only when excited by an external electric field.
all together simultaneously into a lower state.
to emit photons only when they collide.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQII_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_8 - Ionised hydrogen molecule ground state

questiontext.text: An ionised H-molecule consists of an electron and two protons. The protons are separated by a small distance of the order of angstrom. In the ground state,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
An ionised hydrogen molecule (\(\mathrm{H}_2^+\)) consists of two protons separated by a small distance (\(\sim 1\,\text{\AA}\)) and a single electron shared between them.

Step 2: Evaluation
Because there are two positive centres separated in space, the electrostatic force acting on the electron is not a central force directed towards a single fixed point. Hence, the electron cannot move in simple circular orbits as in a single hydrogen atom.

Step 3: Application
In the ground state of \(\mathrm{H}_2^+\), the electron's orbital/probability distribution encloses both protons, binding them together into a stable molecular ion rather than decaying into a proton and a hydrogen atom. Furthermore, the ground-state energy is not \((2)^4\) times that of a hydrogen atom because the two protons are separated rather than coinciding as a single \(Z = 2\) nucleus.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
In the ground state of an ionised H-molecule, the electron would not move in circular orbits, and the electron's orbit would go around both protons.

answer.text: the electron would not move in circular orbits.
the energy would be \((2)^4\) times that of a H-atom.
the electrons, orbit would go around the protons.
the molecule will soon decay in a proton and a H-atom.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQII_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_9 - Scattering of free electrons and protons

questiontext.text: Consider aiming a beam of free electrons towards free protons. When they scatter, an electron and a proton cannot combine to produce a H-atom,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A free electron and a free proton have positive total energy (\(E > 0\)) when far apart, whereas a bound hydrogen atom has negative total energy (\(E = -13.6\,\mathrm{eV}\) in the ground state).

Step 2: Evaluation
By the law of conservation of energy, a free electron and proton cannot transition from a state of positive total energy to a bound state of negative total energy unless the excess energy (their initial kinetic energy plus the binding energy) is carried away.

Step 3: Application
If no third body is present to absorb this excess energy, the electron and proton cannot combine to form a stable hydrogen atom without simultaneously releasing energy in the form of electromagnetic radiation (a photon).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
A free electron and a free proton cannot combine to produce a H-atom because of energy conservation, and without simultaneously releasing energy in the form of radiation.

answer.text: without simultaneously releasing energy in the form of radiation.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQII_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_10 - Applicability of Bohr model spectra

questiontext.text: The Bohr model for the spectra of a H-atom

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The Bohr model is formulated strictly for single-electron (hydrogenic) atomic systems where one electron orbits a single nucleus under a central Coulomb force, and it predicts discrete energy levels and discrete spectral lines independent of temperature.

Step 2: Evaluation
Hydrogen in molecular form (\(\mathrm{H}_2\)) contains two nuclei and two electrons, and a neutral helium atom (\(\mathrm{He}\)) contains two electrons. In both cases, inter-electronic repulsion and non-central forces are present.

Step 3: Application
Therefore, the Bohr model for the spectra of a H-atom will not be applicable to hydrogen in the molecular form, nor will it be applicable as it is for a He-atom. Moreover, it does not depend on room temperature and predicts only discrete spectral lines, not continuous spectra.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The Bohr model for the spectra of a H-atom will not be applicable to hydrogen in the molecular form and will not be applicable as it is for a He-atom.

answer.text: will not be applicable to hydrogen in the molecular form.
will not be applicable as it is for a He-atom.
predicts continuous as well as discrete spectral lines.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQII_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_11 - Balmer series of hydrogen atom

questiontext.text: The Balmer series for the H-atom can be observed

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In the hydrogen atom emission spectrum, the Balmer series consists of spectral lines emitted when an electron transitions from higher excited states (\(n_i = 3, 4, 5, \dots\)) to the first excited state (\(n_f = 2\)). (Transitions ending at the ground state \(n_f = 1\) form the Lyman series.)

Step 2: Evaluation
The frequency \( u\) of an emitted photon in the Balmer series is given by:
\[ u = Rc\left( rac{1}{2^2} - rac{1}{n_i^2} ight), \quad n_i = 3, 4, 5, \dots\]

Step 3: Application
As \(n_i\) increases towards infinity, \( rac{1}{n_i^2} o 0\), so the energy levels become progressively closer together. Consequently, the higher frequencies of the Balmer series get more and more closely packed, approaching the series limit \( u_\infty = rac{Rc}{4}\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The Balmer series for the H-atom can be observed if we measure the frequencies of light emitted due to transitions between excited states and the first excited state, and it appears as a sequence of frequencies with the higher frequencies getting closely packed.

answer.text: if we measure the frequencies of light emitted when an excited atom falls to the ground state.
if we measure the frequencies of light emitted due to transitions between excited states and the first excited state.
as a sequence of frequencies with the higher frequencies getting closely packed.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQII_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_12 - Absorption of radiation by ground state

questiontext.text: Let \(E_n = \frac{-1}{8\varepsilon_0^2} \frac{me^4}{n^2h^2}\) be the energy of the \(n^{\text{th}}\) level of H-atom. If all the H-atoms are in the ground state and radiation of frequency \((E_2 - E_1)/h\) falls on it,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to Bohr's frequency condition, an atom in a lower energy state \(E_1\) can absorb a photon of energy \(h u\) only if \(h u\) matches the energy difference \(E_n - E_1\) to a higher allowed energy state \(E_n\).

Step 2: Evaluation
The incident radiation has frequency \( u = rac{E_2 - E_1}{h}\), so each photon carries an energy of \(h u = E_2 - E_1\). This matches the exact energy gap between the ground state (\(n = 1\)) and the first excited state (\(n = 2\)).

Step 3: Application
When this radiation falls on a collection of ground-state H-atoms, some of the atoms will absorb photons and move to the first excited state (\(n = 2\)), though not all atoms will necessarily be excited. Moreover, since \(E_2 - E_1 < E_3 - E_1\), the photon energy is insufficient to excite any atom from \(n = 1\) to \(n = 3\), so no atoms will make a transition to the \(n = 3\) state.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Some of the atoms will move to the first excited state, and no atoms will make a transition to the \(n = 3\) state.

answer.text: it will not be absorbed at all
some of atoms will move to the first excited state.
all atoms will be excited to the \(n = 2\) state.
no atoms will make a transition to the \(n = 3\) state.

name.text: PHYSICS_MCQII_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_13 - Simple Bohr model for helium atom

questiontext.text: The simple Bohr model is not applicable to \(\mathrm{He}^4\) atom because

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The simple Bohr model applies only to single-electron (hydrogen-like) systems in which the lone electron experiences a purely central Coulomb force from the nucleus.

Step 2: Evaluation
A neutral \(\mathrm{He}^4\) atom contains two electrons instead of one. Each electron interacts not only with the nucleus but also repulsively with the other electron.

Step 3: Application
Because \(\mathrm{He}^4\) has one more electron than a hydrogen-like system, the mutual electrostatic repulsion between the two electrons means that the electrons are not subject to purely central forces. Being an inert gas or having neutrons in the nucleus does not prevent the Bohr model from applying (for instance, \(\mathrm{He}^+\) has neutrons and follows the Bohr model).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The simple Bohr model is not applicable to \(\mathrm{He}^4\) atom because \(\mathrm{He}^4\) has one more electron, and its electrons are not subject to central forces.

answer.text: electrons are not subject to central forces.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_1 - Radius of doubly ionised lithium ground state

questiontext.text:
12.1 Taking the Bohr radius as \(a_0 = 53\text{ pm}\), the radius of \(\mathrm{Li}^{++}\) ion in its ground state, on the basis of Bohr's model, will be about

১২.১ বোর ব্যাসার্ধ \(a_0 = 53\text{ pm}\) ধরে নিলে, বোরের মডেলের ভিত্তিতে ভূমিস্তরে \(\mathrm{Li}^{++}\) আয়নের ব্যাসার্ধ প্রায় কত হবে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Bohr radius for hydrogen atom, \(a_0 = 53\text{ pm}\). The ion is doubly ionised lithium, \(\mathrm{Li}^{++}\), which is a hydrogen-like single-electron system with atomic number \(Z = 3\). We need the radius in the ground state, so principal quantum number \(n = 1\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
According to Bohr's atomic model, the electron revolves in a stable circular orbit around a stationary nucleus of charge \(+Ze\) under electrostatic Coulomb attraction, with quantised orbital angular momentum.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The radius of the \(n^{\text{th}}\) Bohr orbit for a hydrogen-like ion of atomic number \(Z\) is given by:
\[r_n = \frac{n^2 a_0}{Z}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting \(n = 1\), \(Z = 3\), and \(a_0 = 53\text{ pm}\):
\[r_1 = \frac{1^2 \times 53\text{ pm}}{3} = \frac{53}{3}\text{ pm} \approx 17.67\text{ pm} \approx 18\text{ pm}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since the nuclear charge \(Z = 3\) is three times that of hydrogen, the stronger electrostatic pull shrinks the ground-state orbit to one-third of the Bohr radius. The units are in picometres (\(\text{pm}\)), matching the given data. Therefore, the radius is about \(18\text{ pm}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণুর বোর ব্যাসার্ধ \(a_0 = 53\text{ pm}\)। প্রদত্ত আয়নটি হলো দ্বি-আয়নিত লিথিয়াম \(\mathrm{Li}^{++}\), যা একটি হাইড্রোজেন-সদৃশ এক-ইলেকট্রন বিশিষ্ট ব্যবস্থা এবং এর পারমাণবিক সংখ্যা \(Z = 3\)। ভূমিস্তরের ব্যাসার্ধ নির্ণয় করতে হবে, তাই মুখ্য কোয়ান্টাম সংখ্যা \(n = 1\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
বোরের পরমাণু মডেল অনুযায়ী, ইলেকট্রন \(+Ze\) আধানযুক্ত স্থির নিউক্লিয়াসের চারদিকে স্থির তড়িৎ আকর্ষণ বলের প্রভাবে কোয়ান্টায়িত কৌণিক ভরবেগসহ বৃত্তাকার কক্ষপথে আবর্তন করে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\(Z\) পারমাণবিক সংখ্যা বিশিষ্ট হাইড্রোজেন-সদৃশ আয়নের \(n\)-তম বোর কক্ষপথের ব্যাসার্ধের সূত্র হলো:
\[r_n = \frac{n^2 a_0}{Z}\]

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে গণনা
\(n = 1\), \(Z = 3\) এবং \(a_0 = 53\text{ pm}\) বসিয়ে পাই:
\[r_1 = \frac{1^2 \times 53\text{ pm}}{3} = \frac{53}{3}\text{ pm} \approx 17.67\text{ pm} \approx 18\text{ pm}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
নিউক্লীয় আধান \(Z = 3\) হওয়ায় হাইড্রোজেনের তুলনায় তিনগুণ বেশি আকর্ষণ বল কক্ষপথকে বোর ব্যাসার্ধের এক-তৃতীয়াংশে সংকুচিত করে। একক পিকোমিটারে (\(\text{pm}\)) রয়েছে। সুতরাং, ব্যাসার্ধ প্রায় \(18\text{ pm}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_2 - Electron rest frame in Bohr H-atom

questiontext.text:
12.2 The binding energy of a H-atom, considering an electron moving around a fixed nuclei (proton), is \(B = -\frac{me^4}{8n^2\varepsilon_0^2h^2}\). (\(m =\) electron mass).

If one decides to work in a frame of reference where the electron is at rest, the proton would be moving around it. By similar arguments, the binding energy would be

\[B = -\frac{Me^4}{8n^2\varepsilon_0^2h^2} \quad (M = \text{proton mass})\]

This last expression is not correct because

১২.২ একটি স্থির নিউক্লিয়াস (প্রোটন)-এর চারদিকে ঘূর্ণায়মান ইলেকট্রনের কথা বিবেচনা করে হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণুর বন্ধন শক্তি হলো \(B = -\frac{me^4}{8n^2\varepsilon_0^2h^2}\) (\(m =\) ইলেকট্রনের ভর)।

কেউ যদি এমন একটি নির্দেশতন্ত্রে কাজ করার সিদ্ধান্ত নেয় যেখানে ইলেকট্রন স্থির থাকে, তবে প্রোটন তার চারদিকে ঘুরবে। অনুরূপ যুক্তিতে বন্ধন শক্তি হবে

\[B = -\frac{Me^4}{8n^2\varepsilon_0^2h^2} \quad (M = \text{প্রোটনের ভর})\]

এই শেষের রাশিমালাটি সঠিক নয় কারণ

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Newton's laws of motion and the standard Bohr model derivations (equating centripetal force to electrostatic Coulomb attraction) are valid only in an inertial frame of reference.

Step 2: Evaluation
In a hydrogen atom, the proton has mass \(M \approx 1836\,m\). Because \(M \gg m\), the centre of mass of the atom lies very close to the proton, so the proton is nearly at rest in an inertial frame. However, the electron undergoes large centripetal acceleration as it orbits the proton. Therefore, a frame of reference attached to the electron is an accelerating, non-inertial frame.

Step 3: Application
In a non-inertial frame where the electron is at rest, pseudo-forces act on the proton and cannot be ignored; thus, simply replacing the electron mass \(m\) with the proton mass \(M\) in the inertial-frame Bohr formula is invalid. (When nuclear motion is properly accounted for in the centre-of-mass frame, one uses the reduced mass \(\mu = \frac{mM}{m+M} \approx m\), not \(M\).)

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The given expression with \(M\) is incorrect because the frame in which the electron is at rest is not inertial.

ধাপ ১: তাত্ত্বিক নীতি
নিউটনের গতিসূত্র এবং বোর মডেলের প্রচলিত সমীকরণসমূহ (যেখানে অভিকেন্দ্র বল স্থির তড়িৎ কুলম্ব আকর্ষণ বলের সমান হয়) শুধুমাত্র জড় নির্দেশতন্ত্রেই প্রযোজ্য।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণুতে প্রোটনের ভর \(M \approx 1836\,m\)। যেহেতু \(M \gg m\), তাই পরমাণুর ভরকেন্দ্র প্রোটনের খুব কাছে অবস্থান করে এবং জড় নির্দেশতন্ত্রে প্রোটন প্রায় স্থির থাকে। কিন্তু ইলেকট্রন প্রোটনের চারদিকে আবর্তনকালে বিশাল অভিকেন্দ্র ত্বরণ লাভ করে। ফলে ইলেকট্রনের সাথে যুক্ত নির্দেশতন্ত্রটি একটি ত্বরণযুক্ত অ-জড় নির্দেশতন্ত্র।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ
যে অ-জড় নির্দেশতন্ত্রে ইলেকট্রন স্থির, সেখানে প্রোটনের ওপর অলীক বল ক্রিয়া করে যা উপেক্ষা করা যায় না; তাই জড় নির্দেশতন্ত্রের বোর সূত্রে \(m\)-এর পরিবর্তে সরাসরি \(M\) বসানো বৈধ নয়। (ভরকেন্দ্রের সাপেক্ষে নিউক্লীয় গতি সঠিকভাবে হিসাব করলে লঘু ভর \(\mu = \frac{mM}{m+M} \approx m\) ব্যবহৃত হয়, \(M\) নয়।)

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
\(M\) যুক্ত রাশিমালাটি সঠিক নয় কারণ যে নির্দেশতন্ত্রে ইলেকট্রন স্থির থাকে সেটি জড় নির্দেশতন্ত্র নয়।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_3 - Limitation of simple Bohr model for multi-electron atoms

questiontext.text:
12.3 The simple Bohr model cannot be directly applied to calculate the energy levels of an atom with many electrons. This is because

১২.৩ বহু-ইলেকট্রন বিশিষ্ট পরমাণুর শক্তিস্তর গণনা করার জন্য সরল বোর মডেল সরাসরি প্রয়োগ করা যায় না। এর কারণ হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The simple Bohr model assumes that the electron moves in a circular orbit under a purely central force—specifically, the radial Coulomb attraction from a fixed point-like nucleus alone.

Step 2: Evaluation
In a multi-electron atom, each electron experiences not only the radial attraction toward the nucleus but also electrostatic repulsive forces from all the other electrons. Because the other electrons are not located at the nucleus, these electron-electron repulsion forces do not point along the line joining the given electron to the nucleus.

Step 3: Application
Consequently, the net force acting on each electron is no longer a central force directed solely toward the nucleus. Without a central force, orbital angular momentum of individual electrons about the nucleus is not conserved, and the simple Bohr quantisation and circular-orbit energy formula break down.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The simple Bohr model cannot be directly applied to multi-electron atoms because the electrons are not subject to a central force.

ধাপ ১: তাত্ত্বিক নীতি
সরল বোর মডেলে ধরে নেওয়া হয় যে ইলেকট্রন শুধুমাত্র একটি কেন্দ্রীয় বলের প্রভাবে বৃত্তাকার কক্ষপথে ঘোরে—অর্থাৎ শুধুমাত্র স্থির নিউক্লিয়াসের ব্যাসার্ধ বরাবর কুলম্ব আকর্ষণ বলের প্রভাবে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
বহু-ইলেকট্রন বিশিষ্ট পরমাণুতে প্রতিটি ইলেকট্রন নিউক্লিয়াসের আকর্ষণ বলের পাশাপাশি অন্যান্য সব ইলেকট্রনের তড়িৎ বিকর্ষণ বলও অনুভব করে। যেহেতু অন্য ইলেকট্রনগুলি নিউক্লিয়াসে অবস্থিত নয়, তাই এই ইলেকট্রন-ইলেকট্রন বিকর্ষণ বলগুলি নিউক্লিয়াস অভিমুখী নয়।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ
ফলস্বরূপ, প্রতিটি ইলেকট্রনের ওপর ক্রিয়াশীল লব্ধি বল আর নিউক্লিয়াস অভিমুখী কেন্দ্রীয় বল থাকে না। কেন্দ্রীয় বল না থাকায় নিউক্লিয়াসের সাপেক্ষে একক ইলেকট্রনের কৌণিক ভরবেগ সংরক্ষিত থাকে না এবং সরল বোর মডেল কাজ করে না।

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
বহু-ইলেকট্রন পরমাণুতে সরল বোর মডেল সরাসরি প্রয়োগ করা যায় না কারণ ইলেকট্রনগুলি কোনো কেন্দ্রীয় বলের অধীনে থাকে না।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_4 - Ground state angular momentum in Bohr model vs reality

questiontext.text:
12.4 For the ground state, the electron in the H-atom has an angular momentum \(=\hbar\), according to the simple Bohr model. Angular momentum is a vector and hence there will be infinitely many orbits with the vector pointing in all possible directions. In actuality, this is not true,

১২.৪ সরল বোর মডেল অনুসারে, ভূমিস্তরে হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণুর ইলেকট্রনের কৌণিক ভরবেগ \(=\hbar\)। কৌণিক ভরবেগ একটি ভেক্টর রাশি এবং তাই সম্ভাব্য সব দিকে নির্দেশিত ভেক্টরসহ অসংখ্য কক্ষপথ থাকার কথা। কিন্তু বাস্তবে এটি সত্য নয়,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In the simple Bohr model, orbital angular momentum is quantised as \(L = n\hbar\), which predicts \(L = \hbar\) for the ground state (\(n = 1\)). Because \(\vec{L}\) is a vector of non-zero magnitude, this would imply infinitely many possible orientations of the orbital plane.

Step 2: Evaluation
According to modern quantum mechanics (solving the Schrödinger equation for the hydrogen atom), the magnitude of the orbital angular momentum is given by \(L = \sqrt{\ell(\ell + 1)}\hbar\), where the azimuthal quantum number \(\ell\) takes values from \(0\) to \(n - 1\).

Step 3: Application
For the ground state (\(n = 1\)), the only allowed value is \(\ell = 0\) (the \(1s\) state). Therefore, the actual orbital angular momentum in the ground state is \(L = 0\), not \(\hbar\). Since the zero vector has no direction, the ground state is spherically symmetric with no infinite directional multiplicity.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
In actuality, the infinite directional multiplicity does not occur because the Bohr model gives incorrect values of angular momentum.

ধাপ ১: তাত্ত্বিক নীতি
সরল বোর মডেলে কক্ষীয় কৌণিক ভরবেগ \(L = n\hbar\) রূপে কোয়ান্টায়িত ধরা হয়, যা ভূমিস্তরের (\(n = 1\)) জন্য \(L = \hbar\) নির্দেশ করে। যেহেতু \(\vec{L}\) একটি অশূন্য ভেক্টর, তাই কক্ষপথের তলের অসংখ্য সম্ভাব্য অভিমুখ থাকার কথা।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
আধুনিক কোয়ান্টাম বলবিজ্ঞান অনুসারে, কক্ষীয় কৌণিক ভরবেগের মান হলো \(L = \sqrt{\ell(\ell + 1)}\hbar\), যেখানে গৌণ কোয়ান্টাম সংখ্যা \(\ell\)-এর মান \(0\) থেকে \(n - 1\) পর্যন্ত হতে পারে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ
ভূমিস্তরের (\(n = 1\)) জন্য একমাত্র অনুমোদিত মান হলো \(\ell = 0\) (\(1s\) কক্ষক)। সুতরাং, ভূমিস্তরে প্রকৃত কক্ষীয় কৌণিক ভরবেগ \(L = 0\), \(\hbar\) নয়। শূন্য ভেক্টরের কোনো দিক না থাকায় ভূমিস্তরটি গোলীয়ভাবে প্রতিসম এবং অসীম সংখ্যক দিকনির্দেশক কক্ষপথের অস্তিত্ব থাকে না।

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
বাস্তবে এটি সত্য নয় কারণ বোর মডেল কৌণিক ভরবেগের ভুল মান প্রদান করে।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_ATOMS_MCQ_Q12_5 - Nuclear force between nuclei in O2 molecule

questiontext.text:
12.5 \(\text{O}_2\) molecule consists of two oxygen atoms. In the molecule, nuclear force between the nuclei of the two atoms

১২.৫ \(\text{O}_2\) অণু দুটি অক্সিজেন পরমাণু নিয়ে গঠিত। এই অণুতে দুটি পরমাণুর নিউক্লিয়াসের মধ্যকার নিউক্লীয় বল

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The strong nuclear force is a short-range force that acts only over distances of the order of a few femtometres (\(\sim 10^{-15}\text{ m}\)), dropping rapidly to zero beyond nuclear dimensions.

Step 2: Evaluation
In an \(\text{O}_2\) molecule, the two oxygen nuclei are separated by the molecular bond length, which is of the order of \(1\,\text{\AA} = 10^{-10}\text{ m}\). This separation is about \(10^5\) times larger than the effective range of the nuclear force.

Step 3: Application
Because the inter-nuclear separation far exceeds the range of nuclear forces, the nuclear force between the two oxygen nuclei is negligibly small and plays no role in molecular binding, which is governed entirely by electromagnetic (electrostatic) interactions.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
In the \(\text{O}_2\) molecule, the nuclear force between the nuclei of the two atoms is not important because nuclear forces are short-ranged.

ধাপ ১: তাত্ত্বিক নীতি
সবল নিউক্লীয় বল একটি ক্ষুদ্র-পাল্লার বল যা শুধুমাত্র কয়েক ফেমটোমিটার (\(\sim 10^{-15}\text{ m}\)) দূরত্বের মধ্যে ক্রিয়া করে এবং নিউক্লিয়াসের আকারের বাইরে দ্রুত শূন্য হয়ে যায়।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
\(\text{O}_2\) অণুতে দুটি অক্সিজেন নিউক্লিয়াসের মধ্যকার দূরত্ব আণবিক বন্ধন দৈর্ঘ্যের সমান, যা প্রায় \(1\,\text{\AA} = 10^{-10}\text{ m}\) ক্রমের। এই দূরত্ব নিউক্লীয় বলের কার্যকর পাল্লার চেয়ে প্রায় \(10^5\) গুণ বেশি।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ
যেহেতু দুটি নিউক্লিয়াসের মধ্যকার দূরত্ব নিউক্লীয় বলের পাল্লার চেয়ে অনেক বেশি, তাই এদের মধ্যে নিউক্লীয় বল নগণ্য এবং অণুর বন্ধনে এর কোনো ভূমিকা নেই; আণবিক বন্ধন সম্পূর্ণরূপে তড়িৎচুম্বকীয় (স্থির তড়িৎ) মিথস্ক্রিয়া দ্বারা নিয়ন্ত্রিত হয়।

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
\(\text{O}_2\) অণুতে দুটি পরমাণুর নিউক্লিয়াসের মধ্যকার নিউক্লীয় বল গুরুত্বপূর্ণ নয় কারণ নিউক্লীয় বল ক্ষুদ্র-পাল্লার বল।
